question_en: Based on the passage, what is the most likely reason rescue efforts are being delayed until next week?
mc_answer1_en: The sealers have agreed to postpone the rescue themselves.
mc_answer2_en: Pittman is waiting for official permission from authorities.
mc_answer3_en: Extreme weather and thick pack ice are preventing immediate action.
mc_answer4_en: Rescue teams are too far away to reach the site by boat.
flores_passage: ଚାପିଦେଉଥିବା ବରଫ ବ୍ୟତୀତ, ଚରମ ପ୍ରତିକୂଳ ପାଣିପାଗ ଉଦ୍ଧାର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟରେ ବାଧା ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରୁଛି। ପିଟମ୍ୟାନ୍ ସୂଚାଇଛନ୍ତି ଯେ ଆସନ୍ତା ସପ୍ତାହର କୌଣସି ସମୟ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିରେ ସୁଧାର ଆସିବ ନାହିଁ। ପିଟମ୍ୟାନ୍‌ଙ୍କ ଅନୁସାରେ, ଗତ ୧୫ ବର୍ଷ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସିଲ୍ ଶିକାରୀମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ୟାକ୍ ବରଫର ପରିମାଣ ଏବଂ ମୋଟେଇ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଖରାପ ସ୍ଥିତିରେ ରହିଛି।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, କେଉଁ କାରଣ ପାଇଁ ଉଦ୍ଧାର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଆସନ୍ତା ସପ୍ତାହ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ବିଳମ୍ବିତ ହେବାର ସର୍ବାଧିକ ସମ୍ଭାବନା ରହିଛି?
mc_answer1: ସିଲ୍ ଶିକାରୀମାନେ ନିଜେ ଉଦ୍ଧାର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକୁ ସ୍ଥଗିତ ରଖିବାକୁ ରାଜି ହୋଇଛନ୍ତି।
mc_answer2: ପିଟମ୍ୟାନ୍ କର୍ତ୍ତୃପକ୍ଷଙ୍କଠାରୁ ଆନୁଷ୍ଠାନିକ ଅନୁମତି ପାଇଁ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରିଛନ୍ତି।

question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements is true regarding the selection of a Frequent Flyer airline within an alliance?
mc_answer1_en: Frequent flyer points are guaranteed to be identical across all airlines in the same alliance, regardless of the carrier chosen.
mc_answer2_en: Joining the airline you fly most is always the best choice because it maximizes travel convenience.
mc_answer3_en: Privileges and point generosity can vary between airlines in the same alliance, so the best choice may not be the one you fly most.
mc_answer4_en: Alliances ensure that all member airlines offer identical privileges, making the choice of airline irrelevant to rewards.

flores_passage_en: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed. Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation. Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
question_en: According to the passage, how does selection affect the relationship between the two pools of genetic variation?
mc_answer1_en: Selection removes variation from the pool of expressed variation, which indirectly alters the balance between hidden and expressed pools over generations.
mc_answer2_en: Selection shuffles variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
mc_answer3_en: Selection eliminates mutation, stopping the creation of new genetic variation entirely.
mc_answer4_en: Selection adds new genetic variation to the hidden pool, preventing it from being expressed.

flores_passage_en: Mutations can have a variety of different effects depending on the type of mutation, the significance of the piece of genetic material affected and whether the cells affected are germ-line cells. Only mutations in germ-line cells can be passed on to children, while mutations elsewhere can cause cell-death or cancer.
question_en: If a mutation occurs in a somatic cell and leads to cancer, which of the following statements accurately describes why this mutation cannot be inherited by the individual's offspring?
mc_answer1_en: Because all mutations, regardless of cell type, are eliminated by the body's immune system before reproduction.
mc_answer2_en: Because mutations in somatic cells do not affect germ-line cells, which are required for inheritance.
mc_answer3_en: Because somatic cell mutations typically result in immediate cell death rather than cancer.
mc_answer4_en: Because cancer-causing mutations are too rare to be transmitted to the next generation.
flores_passage: ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନର ପ୍ରକାର, ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ଜେନେଟିକ ପଦାର୍ଥର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ କୋଷଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଜର୍ମ-ଲାଇନ୍ କୋଷ କି ନୁହେଁ ତାହା ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରି ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନର ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପ୍ରକାରର ପ୍ରଭାବ ପଡ଼ିପାରେ। କେବଳ ଜର୍ମ-ଲାଇନ୍ କୋଷରେ ହେଉଥିବା ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ୍ ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କ ପାଖକୁ ଯାଇପାରେ, ଯେତେବେଳେ କି ଅନ୍ୟ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଘଟୁଥିବା ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ୍ କୋଷ-ମୃତ୍ୟୁ କିମ୍ବା କର୍କଟ ରୋଗର କାରଣ ହୋଇପାରେ।
question: ଯଦି ଏକ ସୋମାଟିକ୍ କୋଷରେ ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ୍ ଘଟେ ଏବଂ କର୍କଟ ରୋଗର କାରଣ ହୁଏ, ତେବେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ବିବୃତିଟି ସଠିକ୍ ଭାବରେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ ଯେ କାହିଁକି ଏହି ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ୍ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ସନ୍ତାନମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ବଂଶଗତ ହୋଇପାରିବ ନାହିଁ?
mc_answer1: କାରଣ କୋଷର ପ୍ରକାର ନିର୍ବିଶେଷରେ, ସମସ୍ତ ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ୍ ପ୍ରଜନନ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଶରୀରର ରୋଗ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧକ ପ୍ରଣାଳୀ ଦ୍ୱାରା ନଷ୍ଟ ହୋଇଯାଏ।
mc_answer2: କାରଣ ସୋମାଟିକ୍ କୋଷରେ ହେଉଥିବା ମ୍ୟୁଟେସନ୍ ଜର୍ମ-ଲାଇନ୍ କୋଷଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ କରେ ନାହିଁ, ଯାହା ବଂଶାନୁକ୍ରମ ପାଇଁ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ।

mc_answer1_en: It was a routine prosecution under the 2003 legislation, and the case was moved to Virginia because it is a federal court state.

mc_answer3_en: It was the first conviction using the 2003 legislation, but the prosecution occurred in Virginia due to the defendant's residency.
mc_answer4_en: It was the first conviction using the 2003 legislation, and the prosecution occurred in Virginia because AOL, the instigator, is based there.
flores_passage: ଏହି ମାମଲାଟି ଭର୍ଜିନିଆରେ ଚାଲିଥିଲା କାରଣ ଏହା ପ୍ରମୁଖ ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ ସେବା ପ୍ରଦାନକାରୀ AOL ର ଘର (ମୁଖ୍ୟାଳୟ), ଯେଉଁ କମ୍ପାନୀ ଏହି ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଆଣିଥିଲା। ବ୍ୟବହାରକାରୀଙ୍କ ମେଲବକ୍ସରେ ଅଯାଚିତ ଭାବେ ବଣ୍ଟନ ହେଉଥିବା ବଲ୍କ ଇ-ମେଲ୍ ବା ସ୍ପାମ୍ ରୋକିବା ପାଇଁ ୨୦୦୩ ରେ ପ୍ରଣୟନ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଆଇନ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି ପ୍ରଥମ ଥର ପାଇଁ ଦୋଷୀ ସାବ୍ୟସ୍ତ କରାଯାଇଛି।
question: ପରିଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ବିବୃତ୍ତିଟି କେଉଁ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିରେ ଏହି ଦୋଷୀ ସାବ୍ୟସ୍ତ ହାସଲ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା ତାହା ସଠିକ୍ ଭାବରେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ?
mc_answer1: ୨୦୦୩ ଆଇନ ଅଧୀନରେ ଏହା ଏକ ନିୟମିତ ମକଦ୍ଦମା ଥିଲା, ଏବଂ ଏହି ମାମଲା ଭର୍ଜିନିଆକୁ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା କାରଣ ଏହା ଏକ ଫେଡେରାଲ୍ କୋର୍ଟ ଥିବା ରାଜ୍ୟ ଅଟେ।

flores_passage_en: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century. The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice. In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
question_en: Which of the following accurately describes the historical origin and early participants of cherry blossom viewing in Japan based on the passage?
mc_answer1_en: It was originally practiced in Japan with cherry blossoms before spreading to China, where it was adopted by the emperor.
mc_answer2_en: The tradition began in the 8th century in China and was immediately open to all classes in both countries.
mc_answer3_en: It originated in China with plum blossoms and was initially attended only by the emperor and aristocracy in Japan.
mc_answer4_en: Cherry blossom viewing started in Japan among commoners and later became exclusive to the Imperial Court.

flores_passage_en: "Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau. These plateaus are often referred to as ""vidde"" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse. In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called ""hei"" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather."
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement accurately describes the regional naming variations of the plateaus in Norway?
mc_answer1_en: Plateaus in Rogaland and Agder are typically called 'vidde,' while those elsewhere are called 'hei.'
mc_answer2_en: The plateaus are referred to as 'vidde' in general, but in Rogaland and Agder, they are usually called 'hei.'
mc_answer3_en: All Norwegian plateaus are called 'hei,' but in Rogaland and Agder, they are specifically referred to as 'vidde.'
mc_answer4_en: The term 'vidde' is used specifically for treeless moorlands covered in heather across all regions.

flores_passage_en: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday. No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center. The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following statements correctly combines information about the earthquake's location and the USGS's current assessment?
mc_answer1_en: The earthquake occurred north-northeast of Dillon, and the USGS has confirmed significant damage.
mc_answer2_en: The earthquake occurred south of Butte, and the USGS has received immediate reports of damage.
mc_answer3_en: The earthquake occurred north-northeast of Dillon, and the USGS has not received reports of damage.
mc_answer4_en: The earthquake occurred south of Butte, and the USGS has confirmed significant damage.

flores_passage_en: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made. The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals. Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following steps should a person take immediately after suspecting internal poisoning, given the general nature of symptoms like vomiting?
mc_answer1_en: Check the label of any open medication or toxic household chemical containers found to find first aid instructions.
mc_answer2_en: Wait until vomiting stops before attempting any diagnosis or treatment.

flores_passage_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness. Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best describes the relationship between proper nutritional practices and elite athletic performance?

mc_answer2_en: They can significantly affect overall wellness but are not sufficient on their own for elite performance.
mc_answer3_en: They are irrelevant to performance unless the athlete understands supplementation practices.
mc_answer4_en: They guarantee elite performance if an athlete maintains a healthy energy balance.

flores_passage_en: "Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450). King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded. He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means ""the correct sounds for the instruction of the people""."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements correctly identifies the original name of the Hangeul alphabet and the dynasty during which it was created?
mc_answer1_en: The Hangeul alphabet was originally named Hunmin Jeongeum and was created during the Ming Dynasty.
mc_answer2_en: The Hangeul alphabet was originally named Hunmin Jeongeum and was created during the reign of King Sejong's grandson.
mc_answer3_en: The Hangeul alphabet was originally named Hunmin Jeongeum and was created during the Joseon Dynasty.
mc_answer4_en: The Hangeul alphabet was originally named the correct sounds for the instruction of the people and was created during the Joseon Dynasty.

flores_passage_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate. However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars. It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.
question_en: According to the passage, what is the relationship between forming a group of four to six people and the pricing of tours?
mc_answer1_en: Forming a group guarantees a lower price per person, but tourists are often shuffled into groups by the tour company.
mc_answer2_en: Forming a group has no impact on the price per person, and tourists are shuffled to fill cars.
mc_answer3_en: Forming a group ensures a lower price per person, and tourists are always grouped by their own choice.
mc_answer4_en: Forming a group increases the price per person, and tourists are shuffled to avoid group discounts.

flores_passage_en: "Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti. While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint. However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and ""legal"" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags."
question_en: According to the passage, what distinguishes established graffiti artists' work from the common perception of graffiti?
mc_answer1_en: It can resemble legitimate artworks.
mc_answer2_en: It is often mistaken for simple vandalism.
mc_answer3_en: It is always created using spray paint.
mc_answer4_en: It is restricted to public property.

flores_passage_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole. It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies. These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why the South Pole Traverse cannot take a direct route to the Pole?
mc_answer1_en: The compacted snow surface requires the trail to avoid areas filled with crevasses at all costs.
mc_answer2_en: The flags marking the trail are only placed along the plateau, not near the Ross Sea.
mc_answer3_en: The distance of 1600 km forces the trail to take a longer path to conserve fuel for the sleds.
mc_answer4_en: The trail must navigate around the Transantarctic Mountains due to the limited maneuverability of the specialized tractors.

flores_passage_en: Pre-modern observatories are usually obsolete today, and remain as museums, or sites of education. As light pollution in their heyday was not the kind of problem it is today, they are usually located in cities or at campuses, easier to reach than those built in modern times. Most modern research telescopes are enormous facilities in remote areas with favorable atmospheric conditions.
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement best explains why modern research telescopes are typically situated in remote areas rather than in cities or campuses?
mc_answer1_en: Modern telescopes are smaller and more portable than pre-modern observatories, allowing them to be placed in remote locations without inconvenience.
mc_answer2_en: Pre-modern observatories were designed to be easily accessible, while modern ones prioritize ease of maintenance over observation quality.
mc_answer3_en: Light pollution was a significant concern for pre-modern observatories, making urban locations less desirable for modern telescopes.
mc_answer4_en: Modern telescopes require favorable atmospheric conditions that are often compromised by light pollution in urban areas.

flores_passage_en: "Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany. Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language. It was based on the German alphabet and one character ""Õ/õ"" was added. As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment."
question_en: At what time in history did Germany exert a strong cultural influence on Estonia?
mc_answer1_en: Around 200 years ago
mc_answer2_en: Around 400 years ago
mc_answer3_en: Around 600 years ago
mc_answer4_en: Around 800 years ago

flores_passage_en: "Parisians have a reputation for being egocentric, rude and arrogant. It will make getting about considerably easier. Parisians' abrupt exteriors will rapidly evaporate if you display some basic courtesies."

mc_answer2_en: Avoiding direct contact to prevent misunderstandings

flores_passage_en: If you visit the Arctic or Antarctic areas in the winter you will experience the polar night, which means that the sun doesn't rise above the horizon. This offers a good opportunity to see the Aurora borealis, as the sky will be dark more or less around the clock. As the areas are sparsely populated, and light pollution therefore often not a problem, you will also be able to enjoy the stars.
question_en: Based on the passage, why is the Aurora borealis more likely to be seen in the Arctic or Antarctic during winter?
mc_answer1_en: Because the sun does not rise above the horizon, resulting in prolonged darkness.
mc_answer2_en: Because the stars are more visible when the sun is below the horizon.
mc_answer3_en: Because light pollution is absent in these regions due to sparse population.
mc_answer4_en: Because the Aurora borealis only appears when the sky is completely black for 24 hours.

Why do transportation systems engender such complaints, why do they fail on a daily basis? Are transportation engineers just incompetent? Or is something more fundamental going on?
question_en: Based on the passage, what is the most likely reason for the high level of complaints about transportation systems compared to other infrastructure like water quality or bridges?

mc_answer2_en: Transportation engineers are generally less competent than engineers in other fields.
mc_answer3_en: Transportation systems are designed to be more complex than water systems.
mc_answer4_en: Transportation systems are more prone to daily failures than other infrastructure.

flores_passage_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches. The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest. Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best explains why an avalanche might be triggered after a period of stable snow conditions?
mc_answer1_en: Natural events like wind are the sole cause of avalanches, and human presence cannot act as a trigger.
mc_answer2_en: Avalanches only occur when the sun directly melts the snow, regardless of slope stability or volume.
mc_answer3_en: Sticky snow prevents any movement unless a large snowfall event occurs, making human activity irrelevant.

flores_passage_en: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system. Remains of sewage systems have been found in the houses of the Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini in Greece. There were also toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia and China. In Roman civilization, toilets were sometimes part of public bath houses where men and women were together in mixed company.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements accurately reflects the presence of flush toilets in ancient civilizations?
mc_answer1_en: Toilets in ancient Egypt, Persia, and China were part of public bath houses where men and women were together.
mc_answer2_en: Remains of sewage systems have been found only in the houses of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro.
mc_answer3_en: Flush toilets were present in Harappa and Mohenjo-daro, as well as in Minoan cities of Crete and Santorini.
mc_answer4_en: Flush toilets were exclusive to Roman civilization, as evidenced by their public bath houses.

flores_passage_en: "Felicia, once a Category 4 storm on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Scale, weakened to a tropical depression before dissipating Tuesday. Its remnants produced showers across most of the islands, though as of yet, no damage or flooding has been reported. The precipitation, reaching 6.34 inches at a gauge on Oahu, was described as ""beneficial"". Some of the rainfall was accompanied by thunderstorms and frequent lightning."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why the rainfall from Felicia was described as beneficial despite the storm's initial intensity?
mc_answer1_en: The precipitation caused significant flooding across the islands, but it was still considered beneficial for agriculture.
mc_answer2_en: Felicia weakened from a Category 4 storm to a tropical depression, meaning it was too weak to cause harm.
mc_answer3_en: The rainfall reached 6.34 inches on Oahu and no damage or flooding was reported, which likely contributed to its beneficial description.
mc_answer4_en: The rainfall was accompanied by thunderstorms and frequent lightning, which were seen as positive weather phenomena.

flores_passage_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important. Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol. Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.
question_en: Based on the passage, what is the potential consequence of consuming illegally produced alcohol that is NOT typically associated with legal alcoholic drinks consumed in moderation?
mc_answer1_en: Long-term health events from moderate consumption
mc_answer2_en: Blindness or death from impurities like methanol
mc_answer3_en: Increased risk due to personal tolerance levels
mc_answer4_en: Liver damage from excessive drinking of any alcohol

mc_answer1_en: 35 mm format, approximately 864 mm²
mc_answer2_en: 6x6 cm format, approximately 36 mm²

flores_passage_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so. If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it. Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

mc_answer4_en: Drone filming is always illegal near an airport, regardless of local laws.

flores_passage_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman. The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile. A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake. The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.
question_en: Which of the following actions is necessary for a visitor to successfully complete both a temple visit at Phnom Krom and a boat trip to Tonle Sap?
mc_answer1_en: Bring a passport to access the Angkor Pass required for the temple.
mc_answer2_en: Purchase a separate ticket for the boat trip since the Angkor Pass only covers the temple.
mc_answer3_en: Start the journey early in the morning to avoid the gloomy atmosphere inside the temple.
mc_answer4_en: Rent a boat at the temple since none are available on the lake shore.

flores_passage_en: While one experimental vaccine appears able to reduce Ebola mortality, up until now, no drugs have been clearly demonstrated suitable for treating existing infection. One antibody cocktail, ZMapp, initially showed promise in the field, but formal studies indicated it had less benefit than sought in preventing death. In the PALM trial, ZMapp served as a control, meaning scientists used it as a baseline and compared the three other treatments to it.
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement accurately reflects the role of ZMapp in the PALM trial and its demonstrated effectiveness?
mc_answer1_en: ZMapp was the most effective treatment in the PALM trial, demonstrating superior mortality reduction compared to the three other treatments tested.
mc_answer2_en: ZMapp was excluded from the PALM trial because previous studies proved it was completely ineffective at reducing Ebola mortality.
mc_answer3_en: ZMapp was the primary experimental vaccine used in the PALM trial to treat existing infections, leading to a reduction in mortality rates.
mc_answer4_en: ZMapp was used as a control treatment to serve as a baseline for comparison, but formal studies showed it had less benefit than hoped for in preventing death.

flores_passage_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees. The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking. The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges. Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.
question_en: Based on the passage, what can be inferred about the evolutionary shift in hand specialization among hominids compared to chimpanzees?
mc_answer1_en: Chimpanzees use their hands for bearing weight while humans use theirs for manipulation
mc_answer2_en: Both species use their hands primarily for locomotion
mc_answer3_en: The human foot is longer than the hand due to locomotion needs
mc_answer4_en: Hominids have longer hands than chimpanzees

flores_passage_en: The Mumbai attackers arrived via boat on Novemeber 26, 2008, bringing with them grenades, automatic weapons and hit multiple targets including the crowded Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus railway station and the famous Taj Mahal Hotel. David Headley's scouting and information gathering had helped to enable the operation by the 10 gunmen from the Pakistani militant group Laskhar-e-Taiba. The attack put a huge strain on relations between India and Pakistan.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best describes the sequence of events that led to the strain on India-Pakistan relations?
mc_answer1_en: David Headley gathered intelligence that enabled the Laskhar-e-Taiba gunmen to attack targets like Chhatrapati Shivaji Terminus, which subsequently strained India-Pakistan relations.
mc_answer2_en: Relations between India and Pakistan were strained before the attack due to David Headley's scouting, which prompted the attackers to arrive by boat on November 26, 2008.

flores_passage_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change. Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same. Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom. It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid. Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.
question_en: Based on the passage, how does the molecular structure of water behave when it transitions between physical states?

mc_answer2_en: It remains identical regardless of state
mc_answer3_en: It depends on the density of the substance
mc_answer4_en: It changes to match the new state

flores_passage_en: Many observed rhythms in physiology and behavior often crucially depend on the presence of endogenous cycles and their production through biological clocks. Periodic rhythms, which are not simply responses to external periodic cues, have been documented for most living beings, including bacteria, fungi, plants, and animals. Biological clocks are self sustaining oscillators which will continue a period of free-running cycling even in the absence of external cues.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why certain rhythms persist even without external environmental signals?
mc_answer1_en: They depend on the presence of bacteria, fungi, and plants which generate independent cycles
mc_answer2_en: They are primarily responses to subtle environmental fluctuations that are not easily observed

flores_passage_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism. Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically. The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish. Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters. Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement best explains why humans might experience health issues during a red tide event?
mc_answer1_en: Fish die because they breathe in toxins, which then spread to humans through water filtration.
mc_answer2_en: Humans are affected by neurotoxins released by Karenia brevis that enter the air through wind and waves.
mc_answer3_en: Natural factors cause the algae to multiply, but the toxins only harm marine life, not humans.
mc_answer4_en: Karenia brevis directly infects human skin upon contact with contaminated water.
flores_passage: ରେଡ୍ ଟାଇଡ୍ (Red tide) ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଥିବା କାରେନିଆ ବ୍ରେଭିସ୍ (Karenia brevis) ଯୋଗୁଁ ହୋଇଥାଏ, ଯାହା ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ଭାବରେ ଦେଖାଯାଉଥିବା ଏକ ଏକକୋଷୀ ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ଜୀବ ଅଟେ। ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ କାରକଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଏକତ୍ରିତ ହୋଇ ଅନୁକୂଳ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିପାରନ୍ତି, ଯାହା ଏହି ଶୈବାଳର ସଂଖ୍ୟାକୁ ଦ୍ରୁତ ଗତିରେ ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ। ଏହି ଶୈବାଳ ଏକ ନ୍ୟୁରୋଟକ୍ସିନ୍ ଉତ୍ପନ୍ନ କରେ ଯାହା ଉଭୟ ମଣିଷ ଏବଂ ମାଛଙ୍କ ସ୍ନାୟୁକୁ ଅକ୍ଷମ କରିପାରେ। ଜଳରେ ଏହି ବିଷାକ୍ତ ପଦାର୍ଥର ଉଚ୍ଚ ସାନ୍ଦ୍ରତା କାରଣରୁ ମାଛମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ମରିଯାଆନ୍ତି। ପବନ ଏବଂ ଢେଉ ଦ୍ୱାରା ବାୟୁମଣ୍ଡଳକୁ ଆସୁଥିବା ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ଜଳକୁ ଶ୍ୱାସକ୍ରିୟାରେ ନେବା ଦ୍ୱାରା ମଣିଷ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ହୋଇପାରନ୍ତି।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, କେଉଁ ବିବୃତିଟି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ବୁଝାଇଥାଏ ଯେ ରେଡ୍ ଟାଇଡ୍ ସମୟରେ ମଣିଷ କାହିଁକି ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ସମସ୍ୟାର ସମ୍ମୁଖୀନ ହୋଇପାରନ୍ତି?
mc_answer1: ମାଛମାନେ ମରିଯାଆନ୍ତି କାରଣ ସେମାନେ ବିଷାକ୍ତ ପଦାର୍ଥ ଶ୍ୱାସକ୍ରିୟାରେ ନିଅନ୍ତି, ଯାହା ପରେ ଜଳ ପରିଶ୍ରବଣ (ଫିଲ୍ଟରେସନ୍) ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ମଣିଷଙ୍କ ନିକଟକୁ ବ୍ୟାପିଥାଏ।
mc_answer2: କାରେନିଆ ବ୍ରେଭିସ୍ ଦ୍ୱାରା ନିର୍ଗତ ନ୍ୟୁରୋଟକ୍ସିନ୍ ଦ୍ୱାରା ମଣିଷ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ହୁଅନ୍ତି, ଯାହା ପବନ ଏବଂ ଢେଉ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ବାୟୁରେ ପ୍ରବେଶ କରେ।
mc_answer3: ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ କାରକଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଶୈବାଳର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରାଏ, କିନ୍ତୁ ବିଷାକ୍ତ ପଦାର୍ଥ କେବଳ ସାମୁଦ୍ରିକ ଜୀବମାନଙ୍କର କ୍ଷତି କରେ, ମଣିଷର ନୁହେଁ।
mc_answer4: ଦୂଷିତ ଜଳ ସଂସ୍ପର୍ଶରେ ଆସିବା ମାତ୍ରେ କାରେନିଆ ବ୍ରେଭିସ୍ ସିଧାସଳଖ ମଣିଷର ଚର୍ମକୁ ସଂକ୍ରମିତ କରେ।

There are no particular ""rainy"" and ""dry"" seasons: the amount of rain stays roughly the same throughout the year."

flores_passage_en: "The ""up bow"" mark looks like a V and the ""down bow mark"" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side. Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow. An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive. Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected."
question_en: Based on the passage, what is the correct bowing technique for producing a stronger sound when starting from the frog?
mc_answer1_en: Respect printed marks without changing
mc_answer2_en: Start at the frog and pull the bow
mc_answer3_en: Start at the tip and push the bow
mc_answer4_en: Pencil in a custom mark

flores_passage_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel. There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona. Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why the geographic origin of a selected phone number might impact the cost or experience of someone calling you via VoIP?
mc_answer1_en: A user in Arizona can select a number from Alaska while traveling in Chicken, but callers to that number may incur long-distance charges depending on where the number is registered.
mc_answer2_en: A satellite Internet connection allows users to bypass all local phone company requirements, ensuring free calls to any number selected.
mc_answer3_en: Because the Internet routes calls globally, the physical location of the user is irrelevant to callers, regardless of the number's origin.
mc_answer4_en: The passage states that PSTN phones can always call a global number without any geographic restrictions or costs.

question: ଏହି ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା କରେ ଯେ କାହିଁକି ଏକ ମନୋନୀତ ଫୋନ୍ ନମ୍ବରର ଭୌଗୋଳିକ ଉତ୍ପତ୍ତି VoIP ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ କଲ୍ କରୁଥିବା କାହାରି ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ କିମ୍ବା ଅନୁଭୂତି ଉପରେ ପ୍ରଭାବ ପକାଇପାରେ?

flores_passage_en: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience. If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music. Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night. Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
question_en: If an attendee wants to secure a camping spot near the main stages while also ensuring their young children have a suitable environment, what must they consider regarding timing and festival structure?
mc_answer1_en: Wait until after the main stages finish playing to camp, as this is when family areas become available.
mc_answer2_en: Avoid camping on site entirely and stay in nearby hotels to ensure children get rest.
mc_answer3_en: Arrive early to camp near the stages and check if the festival offers family-specific camping areas.
mc_answer4_en: Camp in the central area immediately upon arrival since all music stops at the same time.
flores_passage: କେତେକ ଉତ୍ସବରେ, ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ମହୋତ୍ସବରେ ଯୋଗ ଦେଉଥିବା ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଲୋକ ସେହି ସ୍ଥାନରେ ହିଁ କ୍ୟାମ୍ପ୍ କରିବାକୁ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନିଅନ୍ତି ଏବଂ ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଉପସ୍ଥିତ ଲୋକ ଏହାକୁ ଏହି ଅନୁଭୂତିର ଏକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଅଂଶ ବୋଲି ମନେ କରନ୍ତି। ଯଦି ଆପଣ ମୁଖ୍ୟ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମର ନିକଟତର ହେବାକୁ ଚାହାଁନ୍ତି, ତେବେ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ନିକଟରେ ଏକ କ୍ୟାମ୍ପିଂ ସ୍ଥାନ ପାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଆସିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ। ମନେରଖନ୍ତୁ ଯେ ଯଦିଓ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ମଞ୍ଚଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ଶେଷ ହୋଇଯାଇପାରେ, ତଥାପି ମହୋତ୍ସବର ଏପରି କିଛି ଅଂଶ ଥାଇପାରେ ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ବିଳମ୍ବିତ ରାତି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାଜିବା ଜାରି ରହିବ। କେତେକ ମହୋତ୍ସବରେ ଛୋଟ ପିଲା ଥିବା ପରିବାରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର କ୍ୟାମ୍ପିଂ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ଥାଏ।
question: ଯଦି ଜଣେ ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣକାରୀ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ମଞ୍ଚ ନିକଟରେ ଏକ କ୍ୟାମ୍ପିଂ ସ୍ଥାନ ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ କରିବା ସହିତ ନିଜ ଛୋଟ ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ପରିବେଶ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରିବାକୁ ଚାହାଁନ୍ତି, ତେବେ ସମୟ ଏବଂ ମହୋତ୍ସବର ସଂରଚନା ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ସେମାନେ କ’ଣ ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦେବା ଉଚିତ?
mc_answer1: କ୍ୟାମ୍ପ୍ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ମଞ୍ଚଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ଶେଷ ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରନ୍ତୁ, କାରଣ ଏହି ସମୟରେ ହିଁ ପାରିବାରିକ ଅଞ୍ଚଳଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ହୁଏ।
mc_answer2: ପିଲାମାନେ ବିଶ୍ରାମ ପାଇବା ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରିବାକୁ ଉତ୍ସବ ସ୍ଥଳରେ କ୍ୟାମ୍ପ୍ କରିବା ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ରୂପେ ଏଡ଼ାନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ନିକଟସ୍ଥ ହୋଟେଲଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ରୁହନ୍ତୁ।

mc_answer4: ପହଞ୍ଚିବା ମାତ୍ରେ ତୁରନ୍ତ କେନ୍ଦ୍ରୀୟ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ କ୍ୟାମ୍ପ୍ କରନ୍ତୁ କାରଣ ସମସ୍ତ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ଏକା ସମୟରେ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଯାଏ।

flores_passage_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand. Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years. We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past. Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events. You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.
question_en: According to the passage, how can a person mark the passing of time themselves without external measurement tools?
mc_answer1_en: By comparing the duration of different events
mc_answer2_en: By observing the repetition of a cyclical event
mc_answer3_en: By understanding how time affects everything we do
mc_answer4_en: By studying religious scholars from thousands of years ago

flores_passage_en: The Plitvice Lakes national park is heavily forested, mainly with beech, spruce, and fir trees, and features a mixture of Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation. It has a notably wide variety of plant communities, due to its range of microclimates, differing soils and varying levels of altitude. The area is also home to an extremely wide variety of animal and bird species. Rare fauna such as the European brown bear, wolf, eagle, owl, lynx, wild cat and capercaillie can be found there, along with many more common species
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements best describes the relationship between the microclimates in Plitvice Lakes National Park and the variety of species found there?
mc_answer1_en: The heavy forestation with beech, spruce, and fir trees is the only factor influencing the park's biodiversity.
mc_answer2_en: The park's altitude range alone determines the types of rare fauna that can be found there.
mc_answer3_en: The microclimates allow for a wide variety of plant communities, which in turn support diverse animal and bird species.
mc_answer4_en: The Alpine and Mediterranean vegetation types are unrelated to the microclimates and exist independently.
flores_passage: ପ୍ଲିଟଭିସ୍ ଲେକ୍ସ ଜାତୀୟ ଉଦ୍ୟାନରେ ପ୍ରଚୁର ଜଙ୍ଗଲ ରହିଛି, ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ବିଚ୍, ସ୍ପ୍ରୁସ୍ ଏବଂ ଫର୍ ଗଛ ସହିତ ଏବଂ ଏଥିରେ ଆଲପାଇନ୍ ତଥା ଭୂମଧ୍ୟସାଗରୀୟ ଉଦ୍ଭିଦର ଏକ ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମିଳେ। ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପ୍ରକାରର ମାଇକ୍ରୋକ୍ଲାଇମେଟ୍ (କ୍ଷୁଦ୍ର ଜଳବାୟୁ), ଭିନ୍ନ ଭିନ୍ନ ମୃତ୍ତିକା ଏବଂ ବିଭିନ୍ନ ଉଚ୍ଚତା ସ୍ତର ହେତୁ ଏଠାରେ ବିଶେଷ ଭାବରେ ବ୍ୟାପକ ବିବିଧତାର ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ ସମୁଦାୟ ରହିଛି। ଏହି ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଅତ୍ୟନ୍ତ ବିବିଧ ପ୍ରକାରର ପଶୁ ଏବଂ ପକ୍ଷୀ ପ୍ରଜାତି ମଧ୍ୟ ବାସ କରନ୍ତି। ଅନେକ ସାଧାରଣ ପ୍ରଜାତି ସହିତ ୟୁରୋପୀୟ ବାଦାମୀ ଭାଲୁ, ଗଧିଆ, ଇଗଲ୍, ପେଚା, ଲିଙ୍କ୍ସ, ବଣୁଆ ବିଲେଇ ଏବଂ କ୍ୟାପରକେଲି ଭଳି ବିରଳ ପ୍ରାଣୀ ଏଠାରେ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମିଳିପାରନ୍ତି।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ବିବୃତିଟି ପ୍ଲିଟଭିସ୍ ଲେକ୍ସ ଜାତୀୟ ଉଦ୍ୟାନର ମାଇକ୍ରୋକ୍ଲାଇମେଟ୍ ଏବଂ ସେଠାରେ ମିଳୁଥିବା ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପ୍ରଜାତି ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ?
mc_answer1: ବିଚ୍, ସ୍ପ୍ରୁସ୍ ଏବଂ ଫର୍ ଗଛ ସହିତ ଘଞ୍ଚ ଜଙ୍ଗଲ ରହିବା ହେଉଛି ଉଦ୍ୟାନର ଜୈବ ବିବିଧତାକୁ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ କରୁଥିବା ଏକମାତ୍ର କାରକ।
mc_answer2: କେବଳ ଉଦ୍ୟାନର ଉଚ୍ଚତାର ପରିସର ହିଁ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ କରେ ଯେ ସେଠାରେ କେଉଁ ପ୍ରକାରର ବିରଳ ପ୍ରାଣୀ ମିଳିପାରିବେ।
mc_answer3: ମାଇକ୍ରୋକ୍ଲାଇମେଟ୍ ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପ୍ରକାରର ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ ସମୁଦାୟ ପାଇଁ ଅନୁକୂଳ ପରିବେଶ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ, ଯାହାକି ବିବିଧ ପଶୁ ଏବଂ ପକ୍ଷୀ ପ୍ରଜାତିମାନଙ୍କୁ ସହାୟତା କରିଥାଏ।
mc_answer4: ଆଲପାଇନ୍ ଏବଂ ଭୂମଧ୍ୟସାଗରୀୟ ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ ପ୍ରକାରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମାଇକ୍ରୋକ୍ଲାଇମେଟ୍ ସହିତ ଅସମ୍ପୃକ୍ତ ଏବଂ ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର ଭାବରେ ବିଦ୍ୟମାନ ଅଟନ୍ତି।

flores_passage_en: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa. Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife. Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts. The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte. European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
question_en: Which two factors contributed to the presence of Islam in the Comoros and Mayotte?
mc_answer1_en: Madagascar's wildlife diversity and its status as a continent
mc_answer2_en: European colonialism and the Cape Route exploration

flores_passage_en: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used. Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict. In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country. Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations. The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
question_en: Which of the following best describes the political status of Transnistria in relation to Moldova and the international community?
mc_answer1_en: It is a self-proclaimed republic with its own government and currency, but not recognized by any UN member country.
mc_answer2_en: It is a region of Moldova that shares the same language and religion as the capital city but has no independent government.
mc_answer3_en: It is an officially recognized province of Moldova that uses the same currency as the rest of the country.
mc_answer4_en: It is a fully sovereign nation that is widely recognized by the United Nations and most member states.
flores_passage: ମୋଲଡୋଭାର ରାଜଧାନୀ ହେଉଛି ଚିସିନାଉ। ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ଭାଷା ହେଉଛି ରୋମାନିଆନ୍, କିନ୍ତୁ ରୁଷିୟ ଭାଷା ବହୁଳ ଭାବରେ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୁଏ। ମୋଲଡୋଭା ଏକ ବହୁ-ଜାତିବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ଗଣରାଜ୍ୟ ଯାହା ଜାତିଗତ ସଂଘର୍ଷର ଶିକାର ହୋଇଛି। ୧୯୯୪ ମସିହାରେ, ଏହି ସଂଘର୍ଷ ପୂର୍ବ ମୋଲଡୋଭାରେ ସ୍ୱୟଂ ଘୋଷିତ ଟ୍ରାନ୍ସନିଷ୍ଟ୍ରିଆ ଗଣରାଜ୍ୟର ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିଥିଲା, ଯାହାର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ସରକାର ଏବଂ ମୁଦ୍ରା ରହିଛି କିନ୍ତୁ କୌଣସି ଜାତିସଂଘ ସଦସ୍ୟ ଦେଶ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଏହା ସ୍ୱୀକୃତିପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ନୁହେଁ। ରାଜନୈତିକ ଆଲୋଚନା ବିଫଳ ହେବା ସତ୍ତ୍ୱେ ମୋଲଡୋଭାର ଏହି ଦୁଇଟି ଅଂଶ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଅର୍ଥନୈତିକ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ପୁନଃସ୍ଥାପିତ ହୋଇଛି। ମୋଲଡୋଭାର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଧର୍ମ ହେଉଛି ଅର୍ଥୋଡକ୍ସ ଖ୍ରୀଷ୍ଟିଆନ।
question: ମୋଲଡୋଭା ଏବଂ ଆନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ସମୁଦାୟ ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ଟ୍ରାନ୍ସନିଷ୍ଟ୍ରିଆର ରାଜନୈତିକ ସ୍ଥିତିକୁ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ?
mc_answer1: ଏହା ନିଜସ୍ୱ ସରକାର ଏବଂ ମୁଦ୍ରା ଥିବା ଏକ ସ୍ୱୟଂ ଘୋଷିତ ଗଣରାଜ୍ୟ, କିନ୍ତୁ କୌଣସି ଜାତିସଂଘ ସଦସ୍ୟ ଦେଶ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସ୍ୱୀକୃତିପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ନୁହେଁ।
mc_answer2: ଏହା ମୋଲଡୋଭାର ଏକ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ଯାହା ରାଜଧାନୀ ସହ ସମାନ ଭାଷା ଏବଂ ଧର୍ମ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ କିନ୍ତୁ ଏହାର କୌଣସି ସ୍ୱାଧୀନ ସରକାର ନାହିଁ।
mc_answer3: ଏହା ମୋଲଡୋଭାର ଏକ ସରକାରୀ ଭାବେ ସ୍ୱୀକୃତିପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ପ୍ରଦେଶ ଯାହା ଦେଶର ଅନ୍ୟ ଭାଗ ପରି ସମାନ ମୁଦ୍ରା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରେ।
mc_answer4: ଏହା ଏକ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସାର୍ବଭୌମ ରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର ଯାହା ଜାତିସଂଘ ଏବଂ ଅଧିକାଂଶ ସଦସ୍ୟ ରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର ଦ୍ୱାରା ବ୍ୟାପକ ଭାବରେ ସ୍ୱୀକୃତିପ୍ରାପ୍ତ।

flores_passage_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings. An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites. A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person. Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases. These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following statements correctly links the definition of a contagious disease with vaccination requirements for travelers?
mc_answer1_en: A contagious disease can be transmitted by proximity to an infected person, and vaccination may be required depending on the countries visited.
mc_answer2_en: Contagious diseases are always infectious, and all travelers must be vaccinated for contagious diseases before entering any country.
mc_answer3_en: An infectious disease is caused by a pathogen, and vaccination is only required for diseases that are not contagious.
mc_answer4_en: Vaccination requirements are based solely on the type of pathogen causing the disease, regardless of transmission method.
flores_passage: ଚିକିତ୍ସା ବିଜ୍ଞାନର ଭାଷା ସହିତ ଅପରିଚିତ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ, 'ଇନଫେକ୍ସିଅସ୍' (ସଂକ୍ରମଣକାରୀ) ଏବଂ 'କଣ୍ଟାଜିଅସ୍' (ଛୁଆଁ/ସଂସ୍ପର୍ଶଜନିତ) ଶବ୍ଦଗୁଡ଼ିକର ଅଲଗା ଅଲଗା ଅର୍ଥ ରହିଛି। ଏକ ଇନଫେକ୍ସିଅସ୍ ରୋଗ ହେଉଛି ଏପରି ଏକ ରୋଗ ଯାହା ଭୂତାଣୁ (ଭାଇରସ୍), ଜୀବାଣୁ (ବ୍ୟାକ୍ଟେରିଆ), ଫଙ୍ଗସ୍ କିମ୍ବା ଅନ୍ୟାନ୍ୟ ପରଜୀବୀ ପରି ରୋଗକାରକ ଜୀବ (ପାଥୋଜେନ୍) ଦ୍ୱାରା ସୃଷ୍ଟି ହୋଇଥାଏ। ଏକ କଣ୍ଟାଜିଅସ୍ ରୋଗ ହେଉଛି ଏପରି ଏକ ରୋଗ ଯାହା କୌଣସି ସଂକ୍ରମିତ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ନିକଟରେ ରହିବା ଦ୍ୱାରା ସହଜରେ ବ୍ୟାପିଥାଏ। ଅନେକ ସରକାର ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଦେଶକୁ ପ୍ରବେଶ କରୁଥିବା ପରିଦର୍ଶକ କିମ୍ବା ଦେଶ ଛାଡ଼ି ଯାଉଥିବା ନିଜ ବାସିନ୍ଦାମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ବିଭିନ୍ନ ରୋଗର ଟୀକା ନେବା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ କରନ୍ତି। ଏହି ଆବଶ୍ୟକତାଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଜଣେ ଯାତ୍ରୀ କେଉଁ ଦେଶ ଭ୍ରମଣ କରିଛନ୍ତି କିମ୍ବା ଭ୍ରମଣ କରିବାକୁ ଇଚ୍ଛା ରଖିଛନ୍ତି, ତାହା ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରିଥାଏ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ବିବୃତିଟି କଣ୍ଟାଜିଅସ୍ (ସଂସ୍ପର୍ଶଜନିତ) ରୋଗର ସଂଜ୍ଞାକୁ ଯାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଟୀକାକରଣ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ସହିତ ସଠିକ୍ ଭାବରେ ସଂଯୋଗ କରେ?
mc_answer1: ଜଣେ ସଂକ୍ରମିତ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ନିକଟରେ ରହିବା ଦ୍ୱାରା ଏକ କଣ୍ଟାଜିଅସ୍ ରୋଗ ବ୍ୟାପିପାରେ, ଏବଂ ଭ୍ରମଣ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଦେଶଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରି ଟୀକାକରଣ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ହୋଇପାରେ।
mc_answer2: କଣ୍ଟାଜିଅସ୍ ରୋଗଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସର୍ବଦା ଇନଫେକ୍ସିଅସ୍ ହୋଇଥାଏ, ଏବଂ ଯେକୌଣସି ଦେଶରେ ପ୍ରବେଶ କରିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସମସ୍ତ ଯାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କୁ କଣ୍ଟାଜିଅସ୍ ରୋଗ ପାଇଁ ଟୀକାକରଣ କରିବା ବାଧ୍ୟତାମୂଳକ।

flores_passage_en: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby. Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia. Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed. Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements best explains why South Africa was considered 'the team to beat' as the tournament progressed?
mc_answer1_en: They had a perfect weather day and comfortable win against Zambia, followed by improved performance and strong teamwork.
mc_answer2_en: They started the tournament with a heavy defeat against Zambia.
mc_answer3_en: They were the 5th seeded team and won against the top seeds.
mc_answer4_en: They played against their southern sisters and remained consistently rusty throughout the tournament.
flores_passage: ଉତ୍ତମ ପାଗ ସହିତ ସକାଳ ୧୦:୦୦ ଟାରେ ଖେଳ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥିଲା ଏବଂ ମଧ୍ୟାହ୍ନ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ହୋଇଥିବା ସାମାନ୍ୟ ବର୍ଷାକୁ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେଲେ, ଯାହା ଶୀଘ୍ର ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଯାଇଥିଲା, ଏହା ୭'ସ ରଗବୀ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ଦିନ ଥିଲା। ଟୁର୍ଣ୍ଣାମେଣ୍ଟର ଶୀର୍ଷ ସିଡ୍ ଦକ୍ଷିଣ ଆଫ୍ରିକା ସଠିକ୍ ଭାବରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିଥିଲା, ଯେତେବେଳେ ସେମାନେ ୫ମ ସିଡ୍ ଜାମ୍ବିଆ ବିପକ୍ଷରେ ୨୬ - ୦୦ ରେ ଏକ ସହଜ ବିଜୟ ହାସଲ କରିଥିଲେ। ସେମାନଙ୍କର ଦକ୍ଷିଣ ଭଗ୍ନୀ ଦଳ ବିପକ୍ଷ ଖେଳରେ କିଛିଟା ଧିମା ଜଣାପଡ଼ୁଥିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ, ଟୁର୍ଣ୍ଣାମେଣ୍ଟ ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ିବା ସହିତ ଦକ୍ଷିଣ ଆଫ୍ରିକା କ୍ରମାଗତ ଭାବରେ ଉନ୍ନତି କରିଥିଲା। ସେମାନଙ୍କର ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳିତ ପ୍ରତିରକ୍ଷା, ବଲ୍ ପରିଚାଳନା ଦକ୍ଷତା ଏବଂ ଉତ୍କୃଷ୍ଟ ଦଳଗତ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର କରିଥିଲା ଏବଂ ଏହା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଥିଲା ଯେ ଏହାକୁ ହିଁ ପରାସ୍ତ କରିବା ସବୁଠାରୁ ବଡ଼ ଆହ୍ୱାନ ଥିଲା।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ଟୁର୍ଣ୍ଣାମେଣ୍ଟ ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ିବା ସହିତ ଦକ୍ଷିଣ ଆଫ୍ରିକାକୁ କାହିଁକି 'ପରାସ୍ତ କରିବାକୁ ଥିବା ଦଳ' ଭାବରେ ବିବେଚନା କରାଯାଇଥିଲା ତାହା ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ କେଉଁ ବିବୃତି ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା କରେ?
mc_answer1: ସେମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ପାଗର ଦିନ ଥିଲା ଏବଂ ଜାମ୍ବିଆ ବିପକ୍ଷରେ ସହଜ ବିଜୟ ମିଳିଥିଲା, ଯାହା ପରେ ଉନ୍ନତ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ ଏବଂ ଦୃଢ଼ ଦଳଗତ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଦେଖିବାକୁ ମିଳିଥିଲା।
mc_answer2: ସେମାନେ ଜାମ୍ବିଆ ବିପକ୍ଷରେ ଏକ ବଡ଼ ପରାଜୟ ସହିତ ଟୁର୍ଣ୍ଣାମେଣ୍ଟ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିଥିଲେ।
mc_answer3: ସେମାନେ ୫ମ ସିଡ୍ ପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ଦଳ ଥିଲେ ଏବଂ ଶୀର୍ଷ ସିଡ୍ ପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ଦଳ ବିପକ୍ଷରେ ବିଜୟୀ ହୋଇଥିଲେ।
mc_answer4: ସେମାନେ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ଦକ୍ଷିଣ ଭଗ୍ନୀ ଦଳ ବିପକ୍ଷରେ ଖେଳିଥିଲେ ଏବଂ ସମଗ୍ର ଟୁର୍ଣ୍ଣାମେଣ୍ଟରେ କ୍ରମାଗତ ଭାବରେ ଧିମା ରହିଥିଲେ।

flores_passage_en: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures. On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt. During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time. Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows. On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
question_en: If a driver plans to travel through a mountain pass in a country where icy conditions are common year-round, what is the most critical safety consideration they must account for, based on the passage?
mc_answer1_en: They must ensure that visibility is never compromised by condensation on vehicle windows.
mc_answer2_en: They should avoid driving entirely if temperatures drop below freezing to prevent ice formation.
mc_answer3_en: They can drive at normal speeds because traffic remains mostly uninterrupted due to familiarity with the conditions.
mc_answer4_en: They should expect that snowfall can accumulate quickly enough to immobilize the vehicle even in regions accustomed to winter weather.
flores_passage: ଉଚ୍ଚ ଅକ୍ଷାଂଶରେ କିମ୍ବା ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ଘାଟି ରାସ୍ତା ଦେଇ ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳାଇବାକୁ ଯାଉଥିବା ଯେକୌଣସି ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ତୁଷାରପାତ, ବରଫ କିମ୍ବା ଅତ୍ୟଧିକ ଥଣ୍ଡା ତାପମାତ୍ରାର ସମ୍ଭାବନାକୁ ବିଚାର କରିବା ଉଚିତ। ବରଫାବୃତ ଏବଂ ତୁଷାରପାତ ହୋଇଥିବା ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଘର୍ଷଣ କମ୍ ଥାଏ ଏବଂ ଆପଣ ଖାଲି ପିଚୁ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଥିବା ପରି ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳାଇ ପାରିବେ ନାହିଁ। ତୁଷାରଝଡ଼ ସମୟରେ, ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ଅଟକାଇ ଦେବା ପାଇଁ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ବରଫ ବହୁତ କମ୍ ସମୟ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ପଡ଼ିପାରେ। ତୁଷାରପାତ କିମ୍ବା ପବନରେ ଉଡ଼ୁଥିବା ବରଫ ଯୋଗୁଁ କିମ୍ବା ଗାଡ଼ିର ଝରକାରେ ବାଷ୍ପ ବା ବରଫ ଜମିବା ଯୋଗୁଁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଦୃଶ୍ୟମାନତା ସୀମିତ ହୋଇପାରେ। ଅନ୍ୟପକ୍ଷରେ, ଅନେକ ଦେଶରେ ବରଫ ଓ ତୁଷାରପାତର ଏପରି ସ୍ଥିତି ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ଏବଂ ସେଠାରେ ବର୍ଷସାରା ଟ୍ରାଫିକ୍ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ନିରବଚ୍ଛିନ୍ନ ଭାବରେ ଚାଲିଥାଏ।
question: ଯଦି ଜଣେ ଚାଳକ ଏପରି ଏକ ଦେଶରେ ପାହାଡ଼ିଆ ଘାଟି ରାସ୍ତା ଦେଇ ଯାତ୍ରା କରିବାକୁ ଯୋଜନା କରନ୍ତି ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ବର୍ଷସାରା ବରଫାବୃତ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ଏକ ସାଧାରଣ କଥା, ତେବେ ପାଠ୍ୟ ଆଧାରରେ ସେମାନେ କେଉଁ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ବିଷୟ ପ୍ରତି ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦେବା ଉଚିତ?
mc_answer1: ସେମାନେ ନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରିବା ଉଚିତ ଯେ ଯାନର ଝରକାରେ ବାଷ୍ପ ଜମିବା ଦ୍ୱାରା ଦୃଶ୍ୟମାନତା କେବେ ବି ବାଧାପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ନ ହେଉ।
mc_answer2: ବରଫ ଜମିବାକୁ ରୋକିବା ପାଇଁ ଯଦି ତାପମାତ୍ରା ହିମାଙ୍କ ତଳକୁ ଖସିଯାଏ ତେବେ ସେମାନେ ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳାଇବା ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବେ ଏଡ଼ାଇବା ଉଚିତ।
mc_answer3: ସେମାନେ ସାଧାରଣ ବେଗରେ ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳାଇ ପାରିବେ କାରଣ ଏହି ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ସହିତ ପରିଚିତ ଥିବାରୁ ଟ୍ରାଫିକ୍ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ନିରବଚ୍ଛିନ୍ନ ରହିଥାଏ।
mc_answer4: ସେମାନେ ଏହା ଆଶା ରଖିବା ଉଚିତ ଯେ ଶୀତକାଳୀନ ପାଣିପାଗ ସହିତ ଅଭ୍ୟସ୍ତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଗାଡ଼ିକୁ ଅଚଳ କରିଦେବା ପାଇଁ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ବରଫ ଖୁବ୍ ଶୀଘ୍ର ଜମା ହୋଇପାରେ।

flores_passage_en: Please remember that you are essentially visiting a mass grave site, as well as a site that has an almost incalculable meaning to a significant portion of the world's population. There are still many men and women alive who survived their time here, and many more who had loved ones who were murdered or worked to death there, Jews and non-Jews alike. Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis. Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements best explains why visitors are instructed to avoid making jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis?
mc_answer1_en: Because the passage explicitly states that visitors must not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis.
mc_answer2_en: Because the site serves as both a mass grave and a place of deep meaning for many people worldwide.
mc_answer3_en: Because the Holocaust was primarily experienced by Jews and non-Jews who were either murdered or worked to death.
mc_answer4_en: Because defacing the site with graffiti would be considered disrespectful to the memory of the deceased.
flores_passage: ଦୟାକରି ମନେରଖନ୍ତୁ ଯେ ଆପଣ ମୂଳତଃ ଏକ ସାମୂହିକ କବରସ୍ଥଳ ପରିଦର୍ଶନ କରୁଛନ୍ତି, ଏବଂ ତାହା ସହିତ ଏପରି ଏକ ସ୍ଥାନ ଯାହା ବିଶ୍ୱ ଜନସଂଖ୍ୟାର ଏକ ବଡ଼ ଅଂଶ ପାଇଁ ଅତ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଅର୍ଥ ବହନ କରେ। ଏଠାରେ ଏପରି ଅନେକ ପୁରୁଷ ଓ ମହିଳା ଏବେ ବି ଜୀବିତ ଅଛନ୍ତି ଯେଉଁମାନେ ଏଠାରେ ନିଜ ସମୟରେ ବଞ୍ଚି ରହିଥିଲେ, ଏବଂ ଆହୁରି ଅନେକ ଲୋକ ଅଛନ୍ତି ଯେଉଁମାନଙ୍କର ପ୍ରିୟଜନଙ୍କୁ ଏଠାରେ ହତ୍ୟା କରାଯାଇଥିଲା କିମ୍ବା ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ କଠିନ ପରିଶ୍ରମ କରାଇ ମାରିଦିଆଯାଇଥିଲା, ସେମାନେ ଉଭୟ ଇହୁଦୀ ଏବଂ ଅଣ-ଇହୁଦୀ ଥିଲେ। ଦୟାକରି ଏହି ସ୍ଥାନର ଯୋଗ୍ୟ ମର୍ଯ୍ୟାଦା, ଗାମ୍ଭୀର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଏବଂ ସମ୍ମାନ ବଜାୟ ରଖନ୍ତୁ। ହୋଲୋକଷ୍ଟ କିମ୍ବା ନାଜିମାନଙ୍କ ବିଷୟରେ କୌଣସି ଥଟ୍ଟାମଜା କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ। କୋଠାବାଡ଼ି ବା ସଂରଚନାରେ କିଛି ଲେଖି ବା କୋରି ଗ୍ରାଫିଟି କରି ଏହି ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ବିକୃତ କରନ୍ତୁ ନାହିଁ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ବିବୃତ୍ତିଟି ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ବୁଝାଉଛି ଯେ ପରିଦର୍ଶକମାନଙ୍କୁ ହୋଲୋକଷ୍ଟ କିମ୍ବା ନାଜିମାନଙ୍କ ବିଷୟରେ ଥଟ୍ଟାମଜା ନକରିବାକୁ କାହିଁକି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶ ଦିଆଯାଇଛି?

flores_passage_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting. The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states. With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem. This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV. The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.
question_en: According to the passage, what is the primary consequence of frequently experiencing artificially induced lucid dreams?
mc_answer1_en: It increases the length of time between REM states without affecting sleep quality.
mc_answer2_en: It causes the dreamer to wake up every twenty to thirty minutes to watch TV.
mc_answer3_en: It enhances the brain's ability to recover during non-REM sleep.
mc_answer4_en: It reduces the frequency of REM states, leading to insufficient physical recovery.

flores_passage_en: Soon after the outbreak of hostilities, Britain initiated a naval blockade of Germany. The strategy proved effective, cutting off vital military and civilian supplies, although this blockade violated generally accepted international law codified by several international agreements of the past two centuries. Britain mined international waters to prevent any ships from entering entire sections of ocean, causing danger to even neutral ships. Since there was limited response to this tactic, Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare.
question_en: Which of the following best explains why Germany expected a similar response to its unrestricted submarine warfare after observing Britain's naval blockade tactics?
mc_answer1_en: Because Britain's mining of international waters received limited international response, leading Germany to anticipate comparable acceptance of its own aggressive naval strategies.
mc_answer2_en: Because Germany had previously signed international agreements that explicitly authorized unrestricted submarine warfare as a legitimate tactic during wartime.
mc_answer3_en: Because the British naval blockade was primarily designed to target civilian supplies rather than military assets, making it less controversial than submarine attacks.
mc_answer4_en: Because Germany had already established a superior naval mining strategy that Britain was forced to adopt in response to its initial blockade efforts.

mc_answer2: କାରଣ ଜର୍ମାନୀ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଆନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ଚୁକ୍ତିନାମାରେ ସ୍ୱାକ୍ଷର କରିଥିଲା ଯାହା ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ସମୟରେ ଅପ୍ରତିବନ୍ଧିତ ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ ଯୁଦ୍ଧକୁ ଏକ ବୈଧ କୌଶଳ ଭାବରେ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ ଅନୁମତି ଦେଇଥିଲା।
mc_answer3: କାରଣ ବ୍ରିଟିଶ ନୌସେନା ଅବରୋଧ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ସାମରିକ ସମ୍ପତ୍ତି ବଦଳରେ ବେସାମରିକ ଯୋଗାଣକୁ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଡିଜାଇନ୍ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା, ଯାହା ଏହାକୁ ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ ଆକ୍ରମଣ ତୁଳନାରେ କମ୍ ବିବାଦୀୟ କରିଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior. The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours. The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera. Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain. The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.
question_en: What can be inferred about the dark clouds reported at the base of the mountain in relation to the significant earthquake activity?
mc_answer1_en: The clouds were directly caused by the significant earthquake activity on the northeast side of the volcano.
mc_answer2_en: The clouds were unrelated to the volcanic activity and did not result from the March 10 earthquake.
mc_answer3_en: The clouds were a sign of an actual eruption that took place in the week prior.
mc_answer4_en: The clouds indicated that the earthquake activity was ongoing in the Hekla area.

flores_passage_en: "Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as ""King Tut"" or ""The Boy King"", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times. Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists. However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed. Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements accurately describes the relationship between the discovery of King Tutankhamun's tomb and his historical significance?
mc_answer1_en: The tomb's undisturbed state directly caused ancient Egyptians to revere him more than other kings.
mc_answer2_en: His inclusion on ancient king lists was a result of the tomb's discovery in the 20th century.
mc_answer3_en: The preservation of artefacts in the tomb was the primary reason he was considered important in ancient times.
mc_answer4_en: The discovery of the tomb in 1922 transformed him from a historically overlooked figure into a modern celebrity.
flores_passage: ହଁ! ରାଜା ତୁତାନଖାମୁନ, ଯାହାଙ୍କୁ ବେଳେବେଳେ "କିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଟଟ୍" କିମ୍ବା "ବାଳକ ରାଜା" କୁହାଯାଏ, ସେ ଆଧୁନିକ ଯୁଗରେ ପ୍ରାଚୀନ ମିଶରର ସବୁଠାରୁ ଜଣାଶୁଣା ରାଜାମାନଙ୍କ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଜଣେ ଅଟନ୍ତି। କୌତୂହଳର ବିଷୟ ହେଉଛି, ପ୍ରାଚୀନ କାଳରେ ତାଙ୍କୁ ବହୁତ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବୋଲି ବିବେଚନା କରାଯାଉନଥିଲା ଏବଂ ଅଧିକାଂଶ ପ୍ରାଚୀନ ରାଜାଙ୍କ ତାଲିକାରେ ତାଙ୍କ ନାମ ଲିପିବଦ୍ଧ ହୋଇନଥିଲା। ତଥାପି, ୧୯୨୨ ମସିହାରେ ତାଙ୍କ ସମାଧିର ଆବିଷ୍କାର ତାଙ୍କୁ ଜଣେ ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ବା ସେଲିବ୍ରିଟିରେ ପରିଣତ କରିଦେଲା। ଅତୀତର ଅନେକ ସମାଧି ଲୁଟ୍ ହୋଇଯାଇଥିବା ବେଳେ ଏହି ସମାଧିଟି ପ୍ରାୟ ଅକ୍ଷତ ଅବସ୍ଥାରେ ରହିଥିଲା। ତୁତାନଖାମୁନଙ୍କ ସହିତ ସମାଧିସ୍ଥ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଜିନିଷ ଉତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ସଂରକ୍ଷିତ ରହିଛି, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ମୂଲ୍ୟବାନ ଧାତୁ ଏବଂ ବିରଳ ପଥରରୁ ନିର୍ମିତ ହଜାର ହଜାର କଳାକୃତି ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ।

flores_passage_en: Sleep interruption is the process of purposefully awakening during your normal sleep period and falling asleep a short time later (10–60 minutes). This can be easily done by using a relatively quiet alarm clock to bring you to consciousness without fully waking you. If you find yourself resetting the clock in your sleep, it can be placed on the other side of the room, forcing you to get out of bed to turn it off. Other biorhythm-based options involve drinking lots of fluid (particularly water or tea, a known diuretic) prior to sleep, forcing one to get up to urinate.
question_en: After purposefully awakening during the normal sleep period, which of these would interfere with the sleep interruption process?
mc_answer1_en: Reading for an hour and half before falling back to sleep
mc_answer2_en: Using the bathroom and going right back to bed
mc_answer3_en: Shutting off the alarm on your nightstand and falling back to sleep twenty minutes later
mc_answer4_en: Waking up to drink water from a bottle on your nightstand

flores_passage_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others. That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire. Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions. For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car. He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.
question_en: Based on the passage, under what condition would a person breaking a car window be judged differently than if they were stealing a stranger's car?
mc_answer1_en: If the person had lost their own car keys and was trying to break into their own car
mc_answer2_en: If the person was trying to open a locked door to a public building
mc_answer3_en: If the person was trying to steal a stranger's car
mc_answer4_en: If the person was breaking the window to rescue someone trapped inside

flores_passage_en: "The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean. It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean. With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as ""Hawaii down under"". Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development. The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why some elderly visitors might find the Cook Islands reminiscent of Hawaii before statehood?
mc_answer1_en: Because it lacks large tourist hotels and development while still being in Polynesia.
mc_answer2_en: Because it has 15 cities with different cultural influences.

flores_passage_en: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair. On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem. If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs. The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.

mc_answer1_en: Because airline regulations require all cargo to be checked luggage
mc_answer2_en: Because larger courier companies own their own planes for all routes
mc_answer3_en: To avoid the delays caused by unloading and customs procedures
mc_answer4_en: To ensure that the documents are delivered by a passenger on every route
flores_passage: ଦ୍ରୁତ ଗତିରେ ଜିନିଷ ବିତରଣ କରିବା ପାଇଁ କୋରିଅର କମ୍ପାନୀଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଭଲ ଅର୍ଥ ମିଳିଥାଏ। ଅନେକ ସମୟରେ, ବ୍ୟବସାୟିକ ଦସ୍ତାବିଜ, ବ୍ୟବସାୟିକ ସାମଗ୍ରୀ କିମ୍ବା ଜରୁରୀ ମରାମତି ପାଇଁ ସ୍ପେୟାର ପାର୍ଟସ୍ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ସମୟ ଅତ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ହୋଇଥାଏ। କେତେକ ମାର୍ଗରେ, ବଡ଼ କମ୍ପାନୀଗୁଡ଼ିକର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ବିମାନ ଥାଏ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଅନ୍ୟ ମାର୍ଗ ଏବଂ ଛୋଟ କମ୍ପାନୀଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ସମସ୍ୟା ଥିଲା। ଯଦି ସେମାନେ ଏୟାର ଫ୍ରେଟ୍ (ବିମାନ ମାଲ ପରିବହନ) ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଜିନିଷ ପଠାଉଥିଲେ, ତେବେ କେତେକ ମାର୍ଗରେ ଅନଲୋଡିଂ ଏବଂ କଷ୍ଟମ୍ସ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ଶେଷ ହେବା ପାଇଁ ଅନେକ ଦିନ ଲାଗିଯାଉଥିଲା। ଏହାକୁ ଅଧିକ ଶୀଘ୍ର ପହଞ୍ଚାଇବାର ଏକମାତ୍ର ଉପାୟ ଥିଲା ଏହାକୁ ଚେକ୍‌ଡ୍ ଲଗେଜ୍ ଭାବରେ ପଠାଇବା। ବିମାନ ସେବା ନିୟମାବଳୀ ଯାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ବିନା ଲଗେଜ୍ ପଠାଇବାକୁ ଅନୁମତି ଦିଏ ନାହିଁ, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କର ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ପଡ଼ିଥାଏ।

flores_passage_en: We can start living more friendly to the environment, we can join to the environmental movement, and we can even be activists in order to reduce the future suffering in some degree. This is just like symptomatic treatment in many cases. However, if we do not only want a temporary solution, then we should find the root of the problems, and we should deactivate them. It is obvious enough that the world has changed much because of humankind's scientific and technological advancements, and problems have become greater because of overpopulation and mankind's extravagant lifestyle.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following solutions would not be considered a symptomatic treatment of environmental issues?
mc_answer1_en: Engaging in activism
mc_answer2_en: Deactivating the root causes of the issues
mc_answer3_en: Voicing opinions about extravagant lifestyle choices
mc_answer4_en: Living in a more environmentally-friendly way

flores_passage_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes. This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4. Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are. Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from. Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.
question_en: According to the passage, what would be considered bad advice for tourists looking to explore Southern Africa by car?
mc_answer1_en: Certain in-car emergency items might be required by law
mc_answer2_en: Though a 4x4 is recommended, most locations are accessible with a normal vehicle

flores_passage_en: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21. Authorities said little officially beyond confirming today's arrest. However, a source with knowledge of the investigation told the Minneapolis Star-Tribune that it was Louis Jourdain, 16-year old son of Red Lake Tribal Chairman Floyd Jourdain. It is not known at this time what charges will be laid or what led authorities to the boy but juvenile proceedings have begun in federal court.
question_en: Based on the information provided, which of the following can be inferred about the arrest of the additional student?
mc_answer1_en: The arrest was confirmed by the Minneapolis Star-Tribune as a federal proceeding.
mc_answer2_en: The arrest was made in connection with funerals held for victims.
mc_answer3_en: The arrest was made public only through a source with knowledge of the investigation.
mc_answer4_en: The arrest was officially confirmed by authorities without any specific details.

flores_passage_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses. This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production. This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length. Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower. This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.
question_en: Based on the information in the passage, when might a zoom lens be preferable to a prime lens?
mc_answer1_en: If a high maximum aperture is a priority
mc_answer2_en: If you want less lens elements
mc_answer3_en: If you don’t want to use a flash in darker settings
mc_answer4_en: If you’re looking for more focal complexity

flores_passage_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism. This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun. Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists. If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism. Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.
question_en: A tourist visits a location known for its historic landmarks and ancient traditions, seeking to understand the local culture rather than to relax at a beach or theme park. Which type of tourism does this scenario best describe, and what is the primary motivation for this tourist's visit?
mc_answer1_en: Cultural tourism, motivated by the desire to learn about history and culture
mc_answer2_en: Adventure tourism, motivated by the thrill of new experiences

flores_passage_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states. The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance. The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power. This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.
question_en: Which war marked the last one to be labeled a religious war, considering the shift in European power dynamics described in the passage?
mc_answer1_en: The Thirty Years' War
mc_answer2_en: The Napoleonic Wars
mc_answer3_en: The War of Spanish Succession
mc_answer4_en: The Hundred Years' War

flores_passage_en: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation. Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts. It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states. The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
question_en: Based on the passage, what can be inferred about the effectiveness of the Articles of Confederation in maintaining a unified national policy?
mc_answer1_en: It was ineffective because states often did not cooperate with the central government's enforcement of acts.
mc_answer2_en: It was ineffective because the Articles could be amended with a simple majority vote.
mc_answer3_en: It was effective because the Congress had the power to impose taxes to fund national initiatives.
mc_answer4_en: It was effective due to the strong national executive branch that ensured compliance.

flores_passage_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment. Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words. Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses. Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes. Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.
question_en: Based on the passage, which combination of factors most likely contributes to a successful wildlife photograph taken for commercial purposes?
mc_answer1_en: Experience and the ability to photograph aggressive animals
mc_answer2_en: Patience and a telephoto lens for shy animals
mc_answer3_en: Good luck and a high-quality camera
mc_answer4_en: A long telephoto lens and compliance with park rules
flores_passage: ବନ୍ୟପ୍ରାଣୀ ଜଣେ ଫଟୋଗ୍ରାଫରଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଚ୍ୟାଲେଞ୍ଜିଂ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ, ଏବଂ ଏଥିପାଇଁ ଉତ୍ତମ ଭାଗ୍ୟ, ଧୈର୍ଯ୍ୟ, ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତା ଏବଂ ଭଲ ଉପକରଣର ଏକ ସଂଯୋଜନ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ହୁଏ। ବନ୍ୟପ୍ରାଣୀ ଫଟୋଗ୍ରାଫିକୁ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ସହଜ ବୋଲି ଭାବି ନିଆଯାଏ, କିନ୍ତୁ ସାଧାରଣ ଫଟୋଗ୍ରାଫି ଭଳି ଏଠାରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଏକ ଛବି ହଜାରେ ଶବ୍ଦ ସହ ସମାନ। ବନ୍ୟପ୍ରାଣୀ ଫଟୋଗ୍ରାଫି ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଏକ ଲମ୍ବା ଟେଲିଫୋଟୋ ଲେନ୍ସ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ହୋଇଥାଏ, ଯଦିଓ ପକ୍ଷୀଙ୍କ ଝାଙ୍କ କିମ୍ବା ଏକ କ୍ଷୁଦ୍ର ପ୍ରାଣୀ ପରି ଜିନିଷ ପାଇଁ ଅନ୍ୟ ଲେନ୍ସ ଦରକାର ହୋଇଥାଏ। ଅନେକ ବିରଳ ପ୍ରାଣୀଙ୍କୁ ଖୋଜି ପାଇବା କଷ୍ଟକର, ଏବଂ ପାର୍କଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ବେଳେବେଳେ ବାଣିଜ୍ୟିକ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟରେ ଫଟୋ ଉଠାଇବା ବିଷୟରେ ନିୟମାବଳୀ ଥାଏ। ବନ୍ୟପ୍ରାଣୀମାନେ ଲାଜକୁଳା କିମ୍ବା ଆକ୍ରମଣାତ୍ମକ ହୋଇପାରନ୍ତି। ପରିବେଶ ଥଣ୍ଡା, ଗରମ କିମ୍ବା ଅନ୍ୟଥା ପ୍ରତିକୂଳ ହୋଇପାରେ।

flores_passage_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries. These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife. The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character. While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries. A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

flores_passage_en: "Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families. The ""typical"" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home. There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of ""going to Disney World"". Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets. While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable."
question_en: According to the passage, what is the relationship between the typical Disney World visit and the resale of tickets on auction websites?
mc_answer1_en: The typical visit and ticket resale are unrelated concepts in the passage.
mc_answer2_en: The typical visit requires a full week on-site, making ticket resale more common.
mc_answer3_en: Ticket resale is encouraged to accommodate variations in the typical visit.
mc_answer4_en: The typical visit involves flying into Orlando, but ticket resale is a separate prohibited activity.

question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଅନୁସାରେ, ସାଧାରଣ ଡିଜ୍ନି ୱାର୍ଲ୍ଡ ଭ୍ରମଣ ଏବଂ ନିଲାମ ୱେବସାଇଟରେ ଟିକେଟ୍ ପୁନଃବିକ୍ରୟ ମଧ୍ୟରେ କ'ଣ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ରହିଛି?

flores_passage_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time. Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range. In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen. German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines. Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.
question_en: Based on the passage, why were submarines forced to travel underwater during the later stages of World War II?
mc_answer1_en: Because they needed to avoid detection by increasingly accurate radar technology
mc_answer2_en: Because they were designed to travel underwater
mc_answer3_en: Because German submarines were not trusted after the war
mc_answer4_en: Because they were very slow and had a limited shooting range
flores_passage: ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ ହେଉଛି ପାଣି ତଳେ ଯାତ୍ରା କରିବା ଏବଂ ଦୀର୍ଘ ସମୟ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସେଠାରେ ରହିବା ପାଇଁ ଡିଜାଇନ୍ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଜାହାଜ। ପ୍ରଥମ ବିଶ୍ୱଯୁଦ୍ଧ ଏବଂ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ବିଶ୍ୱଯୁଦ୍ଧରେ ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ସେତେବେଳେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବହୁତ ମନ୍ଥର ଥିଲା ଏବଂ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକର ସୁଟିଂ ରେଞ୍ଜ ବହୁତ ସୀମିତ ଥିଲା। ଯୁଦ୍ଧର ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ସମୁଦ୍ର ଉପରେ ଯାତ୍ରା କରୁଥିଲେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ରାଡାରର ବିକାଶ ହେବା ଏବଂ ଏହା ଅଧିକ ସଠିକ ହେବା ସହିତ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିଗୋଚର ହେବାରୁ ବଞ୍ଚିବା ପାଇଁ ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପାଣି ତଳକୁ ଯିବାକୁ ବାଧ୍ୟ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା। ଜର୍ମାନ ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ୟୁ-ବୋଟ୍ କୁହାଯାଉଥିଲା। ଜର୍ମାନୀୟମାନେ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ ଚଳାଇବା ଏବଂ ପରିଚାଳନା କରିବାରେ ବହୁତ ନିପୁଣ ଥିଲେ। ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ସଫଳତା ଯୋଗୁଁ, ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ପରେ ଜର୍ମାନୀୟମାନଙ୍କ ପାଖରେ ଅଧିକ ସଂଖ୍ୟକ ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ ରହିବା ଉପରେ ଭରସା କରାଯାଏ ନାହିଁ।

flores_passage_en: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond. Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project. Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office. Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.

mc_answer2_en: An SAT tutor
mc_answer3_en: An independent study program

flores_passage_en: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond. Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project. Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office. Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best describes how scaffolds function differently from project-based learning?
mc_answer1_en: Project-based learning is more complex than scaffolding because it includes both virtual and real aids
mc_answer2_en: Scaffolds are exclusively virtual tools designed to question and prompt students
mc_answer3_en: Scaffolds provide support during new experiences rather than being a learning method themselves
mc_answer4_en: Scaffolds are methods of learning that replace the need for teachers

flores_passage_en: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences. Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group. They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management. The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team. The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best describes the relationship between virtual team members and their local management?
mc_answer1_en: Virtual team members function as the point of contact for the invisible team.
mc_answer2_en: Virtual team members may have more autonomy than conventional team members due to varying time zones that local management may not understand.
mc_answer3_en: Local management always understands the varying time zones of virtual teams.
mc_answer4_en: The invisible team sets the standards for conventional teams only.

flores_passage_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently. These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting. There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features. This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling. It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.
question_en: Based on the passage, what is one advantage of creating a class page on MySpace for students who struggle with typing or spelling?
mc_answer1_en: It includes built-in spellcheck and grammar tools.
mc_answer2_en: It allows for unlimited customization of colors and fonts.
mc_answer3_en: It provides a single web address that is easy to remember and type.
mc_answer4_en: It automatically updates profiles with student grades.
flores_passage: ମାଇସ୍ପେସ୍ ହେଉଛି ଯୁକ୍ତରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର ଆମେରିକାରେ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ତୃତୀୟ ସର୍ବାଧିକ ଲୋକପ୍ରିୟ ୱେବସାଇଟ୍ ଏବଂ ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ଏଥିରେ ୫୪ ମିଲିୟନ୍ ପ୍ରୋଫାଇଲ୍ ରହିଛି। ଏହି ୱେବସାଇଟ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବିଶେଷ କରି ଶିକ୍ଷା କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ବେଶ୍ ଧ୍ୟାନ ଆକର୍ଷଣ କରିଛି। ଏହି ୱେବସାଇଟ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକର କେତେକ ସକାରାତ୍ମକ ଦିଗ ରହିଛି, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ସହଜରେ ଏକ କ୍ଲାସ୍ ପେଜ୍ ତିଆରି କରିବା ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ, ଯାହା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ବ୍ଲଗ୍, ଭିଡିଓ, ଫଟୋ ଏବଂ ଅନ୍ୟାନ୍ୟ ବୈଶିଷ୍ଟ୍ୟ ସାମିଲ କରାଯାଇପାରିବ। କେବଳ ଗୋଟିଏ ୱେବ୍ ଠିକଣା ପ୍ରଦାନ କରି ଏହି ପୃଷ୍ଠାକୁ ସହଜରେ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଯାଇପାରିବ, ଯାହା କୀବୋର୍ଡ୍ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବାରେ କିମ୍ବା ବନାନରେ ଅସୁବିଧା ଥିବା ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ମନେ ରଖିବା ଏବଂ ଟାଇପ୍ କରିବା ସହଜ କରିଥାଏ। ଏହାକୁ ପଢ଼ିବା ସହଜ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଏବଂ ଇଚ୍ଛା ଅନୁସାରେ ଅଧିକ କିମ୍ବା କମ୍ ରଙ୍ଗ ଦେଇ କଷ୍ଟମାଇଜ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ କରାଯାଇପାରିବ।
