flores_passage_en: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain. If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate. Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise. Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements accurately reflects the driving conditions and connectivity in the stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont compared to other sections of the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway?
mc_answer1_en: Mobile phone service is weaker here than in previous and subsequent sections, but drivers can still navigate safely by adhering to the posted speed limits of 35-40 mph.
mc_answer2_en: Drivers must exercise extra caution due to steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves, yet they can expect stronger mobile phone service than in areas like the Pennsylvania Wilds.
mc_answer3_en: Despite the presence of steep grades and narrow lanes, the posted speed limits are higher than in previous sections, and mobile phone service is notably absent in isolated backwoods terrain.
mc_answer4_en: The road conditions are similar to other stretches of the route, with comparable speed limits and mobile phone coverage, making it less challenging for inexperienced drivers.
flores_passage: ପଏଣ୍ଟ ମାରିଅନ ଏବଂ ଫେୟାରମଣ୍ଟ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ରାସ୍ତା ବଫାଲୋ-ପିଟ୍ସବର୍ଗ ହାଇୱେରେ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଆହ୍ୱାନପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଗାଡ଼ି ଚାଳନା ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ, ଯାହା ବାରମ୍ବାର ନିର୍ଜନ ଜଙ୍ଗଲିଆ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ଦେଇ ଗତି କରେ। ଯଦି ଆପଣ ଗ୍ରାମାଞ୍ଚଳ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳାଇବାରେ ଅଭ୍ୟସ୍ତ ନୁହଁନ୍ତି, ତେବେ ସତର୍କ ରୁହନ୍ତୁ: ଖାଲ-ଢାଲୁ ରାସ୍ତା, ସଂକୀର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଲେନ୍ ଏବଂ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ବାଙ୍କ ଏଠାରେ ପ୍ରମୁଖ। ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ଗତିସୀମା ପୂର୍ବ ଏବଂ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଅଂଶ ତୁଳନାରେ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ କମ୍ — ସାଧାରଣତଃ ୩୫-୪୦ ମାଇଲ୍/ଘଣ୍ଟା (୫୬-୬୪ କିମି/ଘଣ୍ଟା) — ଏବଂ ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କଠୋର ଭାବରେ ପାଳନ କରିବା ଅନ୍ୟ ସ୍ଥାନ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଅଧିକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ। କୌତୂହଳର ବିଷୟ ହେଉଛି, ପେନସିଲଭାନିଆ ୱାଇଲ୍ଡ୍ସ ଭଳି ଏହି ମାର୍ଗର ଅନ୍ୟ ଅନେକ ଅଂଶ ତୁଳନାରେ ଏଠାରେ ମୋବାଇଲ୍ ଫୋନ୍ ସେବା ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ଅଧିକ ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ବଫାଲୋ-ପିଟ୍ସବର୍ଗ ହାଇୱେର ଅନ୍ୟ ଅଂଶ ତୁଳନାରେ ପଏଣ୍ଟ ମାରିଅନ ଏବଂ ଫେୟାରମଣ୍ଟ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ଅଂଶରେ ଗାଡ଼ି ଚାଳନା ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ଏବଂ ସଂଯୋଗକୁ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ବିବୃତି ସଠିକ୍ ଭାବରେ ପ୍ରତିଫଳିତ କରେ?
mc_answer1: ପୂର୍ବ ଏବଂ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଅଂଶ ତୁଳନାରେ ଏଠାରେ ମୋବାଇଲ୍ ଫୋନ୍ ସେବା ଦୁର୍ବଳ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଚାଳକମାନେ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ୩୫-୪୦ ମାଇଲ୍/ଘଣ୍ଟା ଗତିସୀମା ମାନି ଏବେ ବି ନିରାପଦରେ ଯାତ୍ରା କରିପାରିବେ।
mc_answer2: ଖାଲ-ଢାଲୁ ରାସ୍ତା, ସଂକୀର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଲେନ୍ ଏବଂ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ବାଙ୍କ ଯୋଗୁଁ ଚାଳକମାନଙ୍କୁ ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ସତର୍କତା ଅବଲମ୍ବନ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ, ତଥାପି ସେମାନେ ପେନସିଲଭାନିଆ ୱାଇଲ୍ଡ୍ସ ଭଳି ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ତୁଳନାରେ ଅଧିକ ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ ମୋବାଇଲ୍ ଫୋନ୍ ସେବା ଆଶା କରିପାରିବେ।
mc_answer3: ଖାଲ-ଢାଲୁ ରାସ୍ତା ଏବଂ ସଂକୀର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଲେନ୍ ଥିବା ସତ୍ତ୍ୱେ, ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ଗତିସୀମା ପୂର୍ବ ଅଂଶଗୁଡ଼ିକ ତୁଳନାରେ ଅଧିକ, ଏବଂ ନିର୍ଜନ ଜଙ୍ଗଲିଆ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ମୋବାଇଲ୍ ଫୋନ୍ ସେବା ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ନାହିଁ।
mc_answer4: ରାସ୍ତାର ଅବସ୍ଥା ଏହି ମାର୍ଗର ଅନ୍ୟ ଅଂଶ ସହିତ ସମାନ, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ସମାନ ଗତିସୀମା ଏବଂ ମୋବାଇଲ୍ ଫୋନ୍ କଭରେଜ୍ ରହିଛି, ଯାହା ଅନଭିଜ୍ଞ ଚାଳକମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏହାକୁ କମ୍ ଆହ୍ୱାନପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କରିଥାଏ।

flores_passage_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover. In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors. Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland. In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices. Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now. Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement best explains the relationship between the protests in Poland and the government's decision regarding ACTA?
mc_answer1_en: The protests in Poland were unrelated to the signing of ACTA.
mc_answer2_en: The government decided to ratify ACTA despite the protests.
mc_answer3_en: ACTA was signed in Poland but no protests occurred there.
mc_answer4_en: The protests led the government to delay ratifying ACTA temporarily.
flores_passage: ବିକ୍ଷୋଭର ଆୟୋଜକମାନେ କହିଛନ୍ତି ଯେ ବର୍ଲିନ, କୋଲୋନ, ହାମବର୍ଗ ଏବଂ ହାନୋଭର ଭଳି ଜର୍ମାନ ସହରଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ପ୍ରାୟ ୧,୦୦,୦୦୦ ଲୋକ ଏକତ୍ରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲେ। ବର୍ଲିନରେ, ପୋଲିସ ୬,୫୦୦ ବିକ୍ଷୋଭକାରୀ ଥିବା ଆକଳନ କରିଥିଲା। ପ୍ୟାରିସ, ବୁଲଗେରିଆର ସୋଫିଆ, ଲିଥୁଆନିଆର ଭିଲ୍ନିୟସ, ମାଲ୍ଟାର ଭାଲେଟା, ଏଷ୍ଟୋନିଆର ଟାଲିନ ଏବଂ ସ୍କଟଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡର ଏଡିନବର୍ଗ ଓ ଗ୍ଲାସଗୋରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ବିକ୍ଷୋଭ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ଲଣ୍ଡନରେ, କେତେକ ପ୍ରମୁଖ କପିରାଇଟ୍ ଧାରକଙ୍କ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାଳୟ ବାହାରେ ପ୍ରାୟ ୨୦୦ ଲୋକ ବିକ୍ଷୋଭ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ କରିଥିଲେ। ଗତ ମାସରେ, ପୋଲାଣ୍ଡ ACTA ସ୍ୱାକ୍ଷର କରିବା ପରେ ସେଠାରେ ବଡ଼ ଧରଣର ବିକ୍ଷୋଭ ହୋଇଥିଲା, ଯାହା ଫଳରେ ପୋଲାଣ୍ଡ ସରକାର ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ପାଇଁ ଏହି ଚୁକ୍ତିନାମାକୁ ଅନୁମୋଦନ ନ କରିବାକୁ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନେଇଛନ୍ତି। ଲାଟଭିଆ ଏବଂ ସ୍ଲୋଭାକିଆ ଉଭୟ ଦେଶ ACTA ରେ ଯୋଗଦେବା ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକୁ ବିଳମ୍ବିତ କରିଛନ୍ତି।

flores_passage_en: "Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the ""little brother"" of Germany and Japan. It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war. Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa. For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else. Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain."
question_en: According to the passage, why did Italy need to remove British bases and ships in Egypt?
mc_answer1_en: To prevent Germany from using Egyptian ports for its navy
mc_answer2_en: To establish a naval alliance with Japan against Britain
mc_answer3_en: To use Egypt as a launching pad for troops to invade African countries
mc_answer4_en: To gain control of the Suez Canal for trade purposes
flores_passage: ଆସନ୍ତୁ ଇଟାଲୀର ଯୋଜନା ବିଷୟରେ ଏକ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ସହିତ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା। ଇଟାଲୀ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ଜର୍ମାନୀ ଏବଂ ଜାପାନର "ଛୋଟ ଭାଇ" ଥିଲା। ଏହାର ଏକ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ସେନା ଏବଂ ଏକ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ନୌସେନା ଥିଲା, ଯଦିଓ ସେମାନେ ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଠିକ୍ ଚାରିଟି ନୂତନ ଜାହାଜ ନିର୍ମାଣ କରିଥିଲେ। ଇଟାଲୀର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଥିଲା ଆଫ୍ରିକୀୟ ଦେଶଗୁଡ଼ିକ। ସେହି ଦେଶଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କବଜା କରିବା ପାଇଁ, ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ଏକ ସୈନ୍ୟ ପ୍ରକ୍ଷେପଣ ସ୍ଥଳର ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ଥିଲା, ଯାହାଫଳରେ ସୈନ୍ୟମାନେ ଭୂମଧ୍ୟସାଗର ପାର ହୋଇ ଆଫ୍ରିକା ଉପରେ ଆକ୍ରମଣ କରିପାରିବେ। ଏଥିପାଇଁ, ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ମିଶରରେ ଥିବା ବ୍ରିଟିଶ ଘାଟି ଏବଂ ଜାହାଜଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ହଟାଇବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିଥିଲା। ସେହି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବ୍ୟତୀତ, ଇଟାଲୀର ଯୁଦ୍ଧପୋତଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଅନ୍ୟ କିଛି କରିବା କଥା ନଥିଲା। ଏବେ ଜାପାନ କଥା। ଜାପାନ ମଧ୍ୟ ବ୍ରିଟେନ୍ ଭଳି ଏକ ଦ୍ୱୀପ ଦେଶ ଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps. At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient. The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures. Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole. Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best explains why summer shoes are particularly dangerous on icy surfaces compared to other footwear mentioned?
mc_answer1_en: Summer shoes lack the deep tread patterns and soft material required for cold temperatures, making them more slippery than winter boots or studded alternatives.
mc_answer2_en: Summer shoes are made of materials that harden in cold temperatures, but they still absorb sand and gravel effectively.
mc_answer3_en: Summer shoes have heels that are too low and wide, which prevents proper traction on salt-scattered roads.
mc_answer4_en: Summer shoes are too heavy for icy conditions, causing instability that leads to falls on pavements and steps.
flores_passage: ଶୀତଦିନେ ଦୁର୍ଘଟଣାର ସବୁଠାରୁ ସାଧାରଣ କାରଣ ହେଉଛି ଖସଡ଼ା ରାସ୍ତା, ଫୁଟପାଥ୍ (ପାଦଚଲା ରାସ୍ତା) ଏବଂ ବିଶେଷ କରି ପାହାଚଗୁଡ଼ିକ। ସର୍ବନିମ୍ନ ଭାବରେ, ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ସୋଲ୍ ଥିବା ଜୋତା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ। ଖରାଦିନିଆ ଜୋତା ସାଧାରଣତଃ ବରଫ ଏବଂ ତୁଷାର ଉପରେ ବହୁତ ଖସଡ଼ା ହୋଇଥାଏ, ଏପରିକି କେତେକ ଶୀତଦିନିଆ ବୁଟ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ ଏଥିପାଇଁ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ନୁହେଁ। ଏହାର ପ୍ୟାଟର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ଗଭୀର ହେବା ଉଚିତ, 5 ମିଲିମିଟର (1/5 ଇଞ୍ଚ) କିମ୍ବା ଅଧିକ, ଏବଂ ଥଣ୍ଡା ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ଏହାର ଉପାଦାନ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ନରମ ହେବା ଉଚିତ। କେତେକ ବୁଟ୍‌ରେ ଷ୍ଟଡ୍ ଥାଏ ଏବଂ ଖସଡ଼ା ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ପାଇଁ ଷ୍ଟଡ୍ ଯୁକ୍ତ ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ଉପକରଣ ମିଳିଥାଏ, ଯାହା ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଜୋତା ଏବଂ ବୁଟ୍‌ର ଗୋଇଠି କିମ୍ବା ଗୋଇଠି ଓ ସୋଲ୍ ଉଭୟ ପାଇଁ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ। ଗୋଇଠି (ହିଲ୍) କମ୍ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଏବଂ ଚଉଡ଼ା ହେବା ଉଚିତ। ରାସ୍ତା ଉପରେ ଧରିରଖିବାର କ୍ଷମତା (ଟ୍ରାକ୍ସନ୍) ବଢ଼ାଇବା ପାଇଁ ରାସ୍ତା କିମ୍ବା ଚାଲିବା ବାଟରେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ବାଲି, ଗୋଡ଼ି କିମ୍ବା ଲୁଣ (କ୍ୟାଲସିୟମ୍ କ୍ଲୋରାଇଡ୍) ବିଛାଯାଇଥାଏ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଉଲ୍ଲେଖ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଅନ୍ୟାନ୍ୟ ଜୋତା ତୁଳନାରେ ଖରାଦିନିଆ ଜୋତା ବରଫାବୃତ ସ୍ଥାନରେ କାହିଁକି ବିଶେଷ ଭାବରେ ବିପଜ୍ଜନକ, ତାହା ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଭଲ ଭାବରେ ବୁଝାଇଥାଏ?
mc_answer1: ଖରାଦିନିଆ ଜୋତାରେ ଥଣ୍ଡା ତାପମାତ୍ରା ପାଇଁ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ହେଉଥିବା ଗଭୀର ଟ୍ରେଡ୍ ପ୍ୟାଟର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଏବଂ ନରମ ଉପାଦାନର ଅଭାବ ଥାଏ, ଯାହା ଏହାକୁ ଶୀତଦିନିଆ ବୁଟ୍ କିମ୍ବା ଷ୍ଟଡ୍ ଥିବା ବିକଳ୍ପଗୁଡ଼ିକ ତୁଳନାରେ ଅଧିକ ଖସଡ଼ା କରିଥାଏ।

mc_answer3: ଖରାଦିନିଆ ଜୋତାରେ ଅତ୍ୟଧିକ ତଳିଆ ଏବଂ ଚଉଡ଼ା ହିଲ୍ ଥାଏ, ଯାହା ଲୁଣ ବିଛାଯାଇଥିବା ରାସ୍ତାରେ ସଠିକ୍ ଟ୍ରାକ୍ସନ୍ ପାଇବାରେ ବାଧା ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ।

flores_passage_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences. Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history. International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants. Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not. These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
question_en: According to the passage, which statement accurately combines information about the duration and location requirements for World Expos and International Horticultural Expositions?
mc_answer1_en: They primarily focus on national pavilions displaying arts and sciences.
mc_answer2_en: They typically last between three and six months and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
mc_answer3_en: They are limited to sites smaller than 50 hectares to ensure exclusivity.
mc_answer4_en: They can occur annually without restrictions on country location.
flores_passage: ଏକ ବିଶ୍ୱ ମେଳା (ସାଧାରଣତଃ ବିଶ୍ୱ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନୀ, କିମ୍ବା କେବଳ ଏକ୍ସପୋ କୁହାଯାଏ) ହେଉଛି କଳା ଏବଂ ବିଜ୍ଞାନର ଏକ ବୃହତ୍ ଆନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ମହୋତ୍ସବ। ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣକାରୀ ଦେଶଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବିଶ୍ୱସ୍ତରୀୟ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗ କିମ୍ବା ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଦେଶର ସଂସ୍କୃତି ଏବଂ ଇତିହାସ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଜାତୀୟ ମଣ୍ଡପଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ କଳାତ୍ମକ ଏବଂ ଶିକ୍ଷଣୀୟ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନୀ ଉପସ୍ଥାପନ କରନ୍ତି। ଆନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ଉଦ୍ୟାନ କୃଷି ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନୀଗୁଡ଼ିକ ହେଉଛି ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ, ଯାହା ଫୁଲ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନୀ, ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ ଉଦ୍ୟାନ ଏବଂ ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ ସହିତ ଜଡ଼ିତ ଅନ୍ୟାନ୍ୟ ଜିନିଷ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ କରିଥାଏ। ଯଦିଓ ତାତ୍ତ୍ୱିକ ଭାବରେ ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପ୍ରତିବର୍ଷ ଅନୁଷ୍ଠିତ ହୋଇପାରିବ (ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବିଭିନ୍ନ ଦେଶରେ ହେଉଛି), ବାସ୍ତବରେ ତାହା ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ। ଏହି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ତିନିରୁ ଛଅ ମାସ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଚାଲିଥାଏ ଏବଂ ୫୦ ହେକ୍ଟରରୁ କମ୍ ନ ଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ଆୟୋଜିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, କେଉଁ ବିବୃତିଟି ବିଶ୍ୱ ଏକ୍ସପୋ ଏବଂ ଆନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ଉଦ୍ୟାନ କୃଷି ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନୀ ପାଇଁ ଅବଧି ଏବଂ ସ୍ଥାନର ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ସୂଚନାକୁ ସଠିକ୍ ଭାବରେ ସଂଯୋଗ କରେ?

flores_passage_en: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July. The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos. The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides. Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year. Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why the vaccine delivery plans for historically most affected areas were delayed this year?
mc_answer1_en: The outbreak was not severe enough to warrant immediate vaccine distribution in affected regions.
mc_answer2_en: Mosquito curtains and pig catchers were more effective than vaccines in controlling the disease.
mc_answer3_en: The vaccine vials were reserved exclusively for health agencies preparing for the following year.
mc_answer4_en: The government lacked sufficient funds and prioritized other diseases over this outbreak.
flores_passage: ଏହି ଋତୁରେ ଏହି ରୋଗର ପ୍ରଥମ ମାମଲା ଜୁଲାଇ ଶେଷ ଭାଗରେ ସାମ୍ନାକୁ ଆସିଥିଲା। ଏହି ରୋଗ ଘୁଷୁରିମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ବହନ କରାଯାଏ, ଯାହା ପରେ ମଶା ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ମଣିଷଙ୍କୁ ସଂକ୍ରମିତ ହୁଏ। ଏହି ପ୍ରାଦୁର୍ଭାବ ଭାରତ ସରକାରଙ୍କୁ ଗୁରୁତର ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଘୁଷୁରି ଧରାଳି ନିୟୋଜନ କରିବା, ହଜାର ହଜାର ମଶାରୀ ବଣ୍ଟନ କରିବା ଏବଂ କୀଟନାଶକ ସ୍ପ୍ରେ କରିବା ଭଳି ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରିବାକୁ ବାଧ୍ୟ କରିଛି। ସରକାରଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଏନସେଫାଲାଇଟିସ୍ ଟିକାର ଅନେକ ନିୟୁତ ଭାଏଲ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ଦିଆଯାଇଛି, ଯାହା ଆସନ୍ତା ବର୍ଷ ପାଇଁ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ଏଜେନ୍ସିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିବ। ଅନ୍ୟ ରୋଗ ତୁଳନାରେ ପାଣ୍ଠିର ଅଭାବ ଏବଂ କମ୍ ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା କାରଣରୁ ଐତିହାସିକ ଭାବରେ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳକୁ ଚଳିତ ବର୍ଷ ଟିକା ଯୋଗାଣ ଯୋଜନା ବିଳମ୍ବିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା କରେ ଯେ ଐତିହାସିକ ଭାବରେ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ପାଇଁ ଟିକା ଯୋଗାଣ ଯୋଜନା ଚଳିତ ବର୍ଷ କାହିଁକି ବିଳମ୍ବିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା?

flores_passage_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn. In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented. Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point. So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge. We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.
question_en: Which of the following statements does not accurately reflect a post modern learning approach?
mc_answer1_en: There are numerous ways to learn information
mc_answer2_en: Certain learning experiences should be prioritized over others
mc_answer3_en: A learning experience relies on the learner and the presented knowledge
mc_answer4_en: Knowledge that we may never apply is still worth learning
flores_passage: ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ପ୍ରତି ଉତ୍ତର-ଆଧୁନିକ (ପୋଷ୍ଟମଡର୍ଣ୍ଣ) ଦୃଷ୍ଟିକୋଣ ଚରମ ସତ୍ୟ ବା ନିରପେକ୍ଷତାରୁ ମୁକ୍ତି ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ। ଶିଖିବା ପାଇଁ କୌଣସି ଗୋଟିଏ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଉତ୍ତମ ଉପାୟ ନାହିଁ। ବାସ୍ତବରେ, ଶିଖିବା ପାଇଁ କୌଣସି ଗୋଟିଏ ମାତ୍ର ଭଲ ଜିନିଷ ନାହିଁ। ଶିକ୍ଷାର୍ଥୀ ଏବଂ ଉପସ୍ଥାପିତ ଜ୍ଞାନ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ଅନୁଭୂତିରୁ ହିଁ ଶିକ୍ଷା ଲାଭ ହୋଇଥାଏ। ସମସ୍ତ ଡୁ-ଇଟ୍-ୟୋରସେଲ୍ଫ (ନିଜେ କରନ୍ତୁ) ତଥା ତଥ୍ୟ ପ୍ରଦାନକାରୀ, ଶିକ୍ଷଣ-ଆଧାରିତ ଟେଲିଭିଜନ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସହିତ ଆମର ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନର ଅନୁଭୂତି ଏହି କଥାକୁ ଦର୍ଶାଏ। ଆମ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଅନେକ ଏପରି ଟେଲିଭିଜନ ଶୋ ଦେଖନ୍ତି ଯାହା ଆମକୁ ଏପରି ଏକ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା କିମ୍ବା ଅନୁଭୂତି ବିଷୟରେ ଜଣାଇଥାଏ ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ଆମେ କେବେ ବି ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣ କରିବୁ ନାହିଁ କିମ୍ବା ସେହି ଜ୍ଞାନକୁ ପ୍ରୟୋଗ କରିବୁ ନାହିଁ। ଆମେ କେବେ ବି କୌଣସି କାର୍ ମରାମତି କରିବୁ ନାହିଁ, ନିଜ ବାଡ଼ିପଟେ କୌଣସି ଫୁଆରା ତିଆରି କରିବୁ ନାହିଁ, ପ୍ରାଚୀନ ଧ୍ୱଂସାବଶେଷ ଅନୁସନ୍ଧାନ କରିବାକୁ ପେରୁ ଯାତ୍ରା କରିବୁ ନାହିଁ, କିମ୍ବା ଆମ ପଡ଼ୋଶୀଙ୍କ ଘରକୁ ପୁନଃନିର୍ମାଣ କରିବୁ ନାହିଁ।

flores_passage_en: Muhammad was deeply interested in matters beyond this mundane life. He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation. he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations. Resting on the top of one of the mountains north of Mecca, the cave is completely isolated from the rest of the world. In fact, it is not easy to find at all even if one knew it existed. Once inside the cave, it is a total isolation. Nothing can be seen other than the clear, beautiful sky above and the many surrounding mountains. Very little of this world can be seen or heard from inside the cave.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why Muhammad's spiritual inclinations are vividly illustrated by the cave's isolation?
mc_answer1_en: Because the clear, beautiful sky visible from inside the cave was considered a direct portal to the afterlife by early Islamic scholars.
mc_answer2_en: Because the cave's complete isolation from the world, where very little of it can be seen or heard, mirrors his interest in matters beyond the mundane life.
mc_answer3_en: Because the cave's physical location on the Mountain of Noor allowed him to easily access worldly supplies during contemplation.
mc_answer4_en: Because the cave's survival over time indicates that it was built specifically to accommodate large groups of followers seeking spiritual guidance.
flores_passage: ମହମ୍ମଦ ଏହି ପାର୍ଥିବ ଜୀବନ ବାହାରର ବିଷୟଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପ୍ରତି ଗଭୀର ଭାବରେ ଆଗ୍ରହୀ ଥିଲେ। ସେ ଚିନ୍ତନ ପାଇଁ "ନୂର" (ଆଲୋକ) ପର୍ବତ ଉପରେ ଥିବା ଏକ ଗୁମ୍ଫାକୁ ବାରମ୍ବାର ଯାଉଥିଲେ, ଯାହା "ହିରା" ଭାବରେ ଜଣାଶୁଣା ହୋଇଥିଲା। ଏହି ଗୁମ୍ଫା ନିଜେ, ଯାହା କାଳକ୍ରମେ ଆଜି ବି ତିଷ୍ଠି ରହିଛି, ମହମ୍ମଦଙ୍କ ଆଧ୍ୟାତ୍ମିକ ପ୍ରବୃତ୍ତିର ଏକ ଅତି ଜୀବନ୍ତ ଚିତ୍ର ପ୍ରଦାନ କରେ। ମକ୍କାର ଉତ୍ତରରେ ଥିବା ଏକ ପର୍ବତ ଶିଖରରେ ଅବସ୍ଥିତ ଏହି ଗୁମ୍ଫା ବାକି ଦୁନିଆଠାରୁ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବେ ବିଚ୍ଛିନ୍ନ। ପ୍ରକୃତରେ, ଏହା ବିଷୟରେ ଜଣାଥିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଏହାକୁ ଖୋଜି ପାଇବା ଆଦୌ ସହଜ ନୁହେଁ। ଥରେ ଗୁମ୍ଫା ଭିତରକୁ ଗଲେ, ସେଠାରେ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଏକାନ୍ତତା ମିଳେ। ଉପରେ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ, ସୁନ୍ଦର ଆକାଶ ଏବଂ ଆଖପାଖର ଅନେକ ପର୍ବତ ବ୍ୟତୀତ ଆଉ କିଛି ଦେଖାଯାଏ ନାହିଁ। ଗୁମ୍ଫା ଭିତରୁ ଏହି ଦୁନିଆର ଖୁବ୍ କମ୍ ଦୃଶ୍ୟ ବା ଶବ୍ଦ ଦେଖିବାକୁ କିମ୍ବା ଶୁଣିବାକୁ ମିଳେ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଗୁମ୍ଫାର ବିଚ୍ଛିନ୍ନତା କିପରି ମହମ୍ମଦଙ୍କ ଆଧ୍ୟାତ୍ମିକ ପ୍ରବୃତ୍ତିକୁ ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ ଦର୍ଶାଉଛି ତାହା ସବୁଠାରୁ ଉତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ବୁଝାଇଥାଏ?

flores_passage_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital. The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years. The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center. Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel. Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement best explains why Jerusalem is considered a major tourist destination?
mc_answer1_en: It is the capital and largest city of Israel
mc_answer2_en: It has vibrant shopping centers and restaurants
mc_answer3_en: It is located in the Judean Hills and has a history spanning thousands of years
mc_answer4_en: It is holy to three monotheistic religions and contains many historic sites

flores_passage_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana. The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay. In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic. You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls. On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
question_en: According to the passage, when should travelers visit the Falls if they are seeking unobstructed views?
mc_answer1_en: November through March
mc_answer2_en: During tourist season
mc_answer3_en: When the water volume is high

flores_passage_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana. The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay. In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic. You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls. On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

mc_answer3_en: They will get wet but see less of the actual Falls due to high water volume.
mc_answer4_en: They will stay dry and have a clearer view of the Falls than in the dry season.

flores_passage_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king. Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration. Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible. The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo. Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement best explains why visitors with limited time might choose to visit the Tomb of Tutankhamun despite its limitations?
mc_answer1_en: The tomb is the only location where one can see evidence of damage to the mummy done during removal from the coffin.
mc_answer2_en: The tomb contains the original fabulous riches, offering a unique experience unmatched elsewhere.
mc_answer3_en: The tomb's small size and limited decoration make it a quick but rewarding visit.
mc_answer4_en: Visitors with limited time are advised to spend their time elsewhere, implying the tomb is not recommended for such visitors.

flores_passage_en: Booking in advance gives the traveller peace of mind that they will have somewhere to sleep once they arrive at their destination. Travel agents often have deals with specific hotels, although you may find it possible to book other forms of accommodation, like camping grounds, through a travel agent. Travel agents usually offer packages that include breakfast, transportation arrangements to/from the airport or even combined flight and hotel packages. They can also hold the reservation for you if you need time to think about the offer or procure other documents for your destination (e.g. visa). Any amendments or requests though should be coursed through the travel agent first and not directly with the hotel.
question_en: According to the passage, which type of traveler is not likely to benefit from using a travel agent’s services?
mc_answer1_en: An indecisive traveler
mc_answer2_en: A traveler prone to spontaneity

flores_passage_en: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast. The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park. The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain. The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas. Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement accurately describes the ecological composition of the Sundarbans National Park?
mc_answer1_en: It was established as a wildlife sanctuary in 1966 to protect the Royal Bengal tigers exclusively.
mc_answer2_en: It consists entirely of mangrove swamps with no other forest types.
mc_answer3_en: It includes both mangrove swamps and remnants of the ancient Gangetic plain jungles.
mc_answer4_en: It is primarily composed of water/marsh areas with minimal forest cover.

flores_passage_en: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today. It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos. The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East. The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction. First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
question_en: According to the Iraq Study Group report, what specific action is urged to be taken before the end of this year to address Iraq's security concerns?
mc_answer1_en: To change the Executive's policy without any specific timeline or recommendations
mc_answer2_en: To guarantee that any course of action will stop sectarian warfare and violence
mc_answer3_en: To issue a plea for open debate and consensus formation within the United States

flores_passage_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo. The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE. Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.
question_en: According to the passage, what was the primary cause of the significant reduction in the Taíno population shortly after European explorers arrived?
mc_answer1_en: They were displaced by the Caribes who arrived earlier
mc_answer2_en: They migrated to other parts of the Americas
mc_answer3_en: They were killed by Spanish conquerors
mc_answer4_en: They were replaced by white settlers
flores_passage: ଡୋମିନିକାନ ରିପବ୍ଲିକ (ସ୍ପାନିସ୍: República Dominicana) ଏକ କାରିବୀୟ ଦେଶ ଯାହା ହିସ୍ପାନିଓଲା ଦ୍ୱୀପର ପୂର୍ବ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧେକ ଅଂଶରେ ଅବସ୍ଥିତ, ଯାହା ଏହା ହାଇତି ସହିତ ବାଣ୍ଟିଥାଏ। ଧଳା ବାଲିର ବେଳାଭୂମି ଏବଂ ପାର୍ବତ୍ୟ ଦୃଶ୍ୟରାଜି ବ୍ୟତୀତ, ଏହି ଦେଶ ଆମେରିକା ମହାଦେଶର ସର୍ବପୁରାତନ ୟୁରୋପୀୟ ସହରର ବାସସ୍ଥଳୀ, ଯାହା ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ସାଣ୍ଟୋ ଡୋମିଙ୍ଗୋର ଏକ ଅଂଶ। ଏହି ଦ୍ୱୀପରେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ତାଇନୋ ଏବଂ କାରିବ୍ ବାସ କରୁଥିଲେ। କାରିବ୍ ଏକ ଆରାୱାକାନ୍-ଭାଷାଭାଷୀ ଲୋକ ଥିଲେ ଯେଉଁମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟ ଖ୍ରୀଷ୍ଟପୂର୍ବ ୧୦,୦୦୦ ସମୟରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଥିଲେ। ୟୁରୋପୀୟ ଅନୁସନ୍ଧାନକାରୀଙ୍କ ଆଗମନର କିଛି ବର୍ଷ ମଧ୍ୟରେ, ସ୍ପାନିସ୍ ବିଜେତାମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ତାଇନୋମାନଙ୍କ ଜନସଂଖ୍ୟା ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ହ୍ରାସ ପାଇଥିଲା। ଫ୍ରେ ବାର୍ଥୋଲୋମେ ଡେ ଲାସ୍ କାସାସ୍ (Tratado de las Indias) ଙ୍କ ଅନୁସାରେ ୧୪୯୨ ରୁ ୧୪୯୮ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସ୍ପାନିସ୍ ବିଜେତାମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟ ୧୦୦,୦୦୦ ତାଇନୋଙ୍କୁ ହତ୍ୟା କରିଥିଲେ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ୟୁରୋପୀୟ ଅନୁସନ୍ଧାନକାରୀମାନେ ପହଞ୍ଚିବାର କିଛି ସମୟ ପରେ ତାଇନୋ ଜନସଂଖ୍ୟାରେ ଉଲ୍ଲେଖନୀୟ ହ୍ରାସର ମୁଖ୍ୟ କାରଣ କ'ଣ ଥିଲା?

flores_passage_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas. The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society. However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture. There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand. They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement best explains the historical misunderstanding regarding the origin of the Moriori people?
mc_answer1_en: The Moriori were actually a subgroup of Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, but early theories incorrectly portrayed them as the original inhabitants displaced by the Maori.
mc_answer2_en: The Moriori were originally a separate group that migrated from Polynesia to the Chatham Islands before the Maori arrived in New Zealand.
mc_answer3_en: The Moriori were the first inhabitants of New Zealand who were displaced by the Maori Great Fleet migration from Polynesia.
mc_answer4_en: The Moriori were a Maori tribe that migrated from the Chatham Islands to New Zealand and were later wiped out in conflicts with the mainland Maori.
flores_passage: ଊନବିଂଶ ଏବଂ ବିଂଶ ଶତାବ୍ଦୀରେ ଏକ ଦୀର୍ଘ ସମୟ ଧରି ଏହା ବିଶ୍ୱାସ କରାଯାଉଥିଲା ଯେ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡର ପ୍ରଥମ ଅଧିବାସୀ ମାଓରି ଲୋକ ଥିଲେ, ଯେଉଁମାନେ ମୋଆ ନାମକ ବିଶାଳ ପକ୍ଷୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ଶିକାର କରୁଥିଲେ। ତା'ପରେ ଏହି ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଏହି ଧାରଣା ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରିଥିଲା ଯେ ମାଓରି ଲୋକମାନେ ଏକ ବିଶାଳ ନୌବାହିନୀରେ (ଗ୍ରେଟ୍ ଫ୍ଲିଟ୍) ପଲିନେସିଆରୁ ପ୍ରବାସ କରିଥିଲେ ଏବଂ ମୋରିଓରିମାନଙ୍କଠାରୁ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ଛଡ଼ାଇ ନେଇ ଏକ କୃଷିଭିତ୍ତିକ ସମାଜ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରିଥିଲେ। ତଥାପି, ନୂତନ ପ୍ରମାଣରୁ ଜଣାପଡ଼େ ଯେ ମୋରିଓରିମାନେ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଭୂଖଣ୍ଡର ମାଓରିମାନଙ୍କର ଏକ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀ ଥିଲେ ଯେଉଁମାନେ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡରୁ ଚାଥାମ ଦ୍ୱୀପପୁଞ୍ଜକୁ ପ୍ରବାସ କରିଥିଲେ ଏବଂ ନିଜର ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର, ଶାନ୍ତିପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସଂସ୍କୃତି ବିକଶିତ କରିଥିଲେ। ଚାଥାମ ଦ୍ୱୀପପୁଞ୍ଜରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ଏକ ଜନଜାତି ମଧ୍ୟ ଥିଲେ, ଏମାନେ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡରୁ ଚାଲିଆସିଥିବା ମାଓରି ଥିଲେ। ସେମାନେ ନିଜକୁ ମୋରିଓରି ବୋଲି କହୁଥିଲେ, ସେଠାରେ କିଛି ସଂଘର୍ଷ ହୋଇଥିଲା ଏବଂ ଶେଷରେ ମୋରିଓରିମାନେ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବିଲୁପ୍ତ ହୋଇଯାଇଥିଲେ।
question: ପାଠ୍ୟାଂଶ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, କେଉଁ ବିବୃତିଟି ମୋରିଓରି ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଉତ୍ପତ୍ତି ସମ୍ପର୍କିତ ଐତିହାସିକ ଭୁଲ ଧାରଣାକୁ ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା କରେ?
mc_answer1: ମୋରିଓରିମାନେ ପ୍ରକୃତରେ ମାଓରିମାନଙ୍କର ଏକ ଉପଗୋଷ୍ଠୀ ଥିଲେ ଯେଉଁମାନେ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡରୁ ଚାଥାମ ଦ୍ୱୀପପୁଞ୍ଜକୁ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ପୂର୍ବର ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ମାଓରିମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ବିସ୍ଥାପିତ ହୋଇଥିବା ମୂଳ ଅଧିବାସୀ ଭାବରେ ଭୁଲ ଭାବରେ ଚିତ୍ରଣ କରିଥିଲା।
mc_answer2: ମୋରିଓରିମାନେ ମୂଳତଃ ଏକ ପୃଥକ୍ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀ ଥିଲେ ଯେଉଁମାନେ ମାଓରିମାନେ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପଲିନେସିଆରୁ ଚାଥାମ ଦ୍ୱୀପପୁଞ୍ଜକୁ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲେ।

flores_passage_en: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope. After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll. French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings. Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters. Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
question_en: According to the passage, what must happen before a voter can sign the voting roll after dropping their envelope into the ballot box?
mc_answer1_en: The voter's identity must be verified by officials.
mc_answer2_en: Candidates must send representatives to witness the process.

flores_passage_en: "Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO. Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a ""thorough and complete rewriting"" of the Conservative party's environmental bill. Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November. But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million."
question_en: Based on the passage, which statement accurately reflects the relationship between the Prime Minister's actions and the environmental bill review process?
mc_answer1_en: The Prime Minister claimed the bill was a stunt to influence the upcoming federal election.
mc_answer2_en: The Prime Minister decided to send the bill to committee without any prior meetings with opposition leaders.
mc_answer3_en: The Prime Minister rejected Layton's request to rewrite the environmental bill entirely.
mc_answer4_en: The Prime Minister agreed to review the Clean Air Act before its second reading following a meeting with Jack Layton.

flores_passage_en: "Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that. Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism. Also blogging ""forces students to become more savvy about the world around them."" The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004). Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day. Appropriate use of blogs ""can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002)."
question_en: According to the passage, how does the presence of an audience affect student writing on blogs, and what additional benefit does blogging provide regarding student perspective?
mc_answer1_en: It encourages students to improve their writing to avoid criticism and helps them define their positions in the context of others' writings.
mc_answer2_en: It eliminates the need for critical thinking and allows students to focus solely on grammar without audience feedback.

flores_passage_en: "Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology. Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has ""effects"" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned. For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads. However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership. Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies."
question_en: According to the passage, how does the development of mass car ownership relate to advancements in healthcare?
mc_answer1_en: Mass car ownership directly causes healthcare techniques to be invented.
mc_answer2_en: Higher accident rates from car ownership lead to new healthcare techniques.
mc_answer3_en: Road networks are developed before healthcare techniques are needed.
mc_answer4_en: Technological determinism prevents healthcare from being influenced by car accidents.

question_en: Based on the passage, if the station lost a gyroscope earlier in the mission and normal attitude was regained after Russian ground control activated the jets during the spacewalk, which of the following best describes the sequence of events that led to the restoration of the station's attitude?
mc_answer1_en: The station maintained attitude throughout the spacewalk, with no need for thruster activation.
mc_answer2_en: The station lost attitude immediately after the gyroscope failure and could not regain it during the spacewalk.
mc_answer3_en: The station regained attitude after the spacewalk ended, following the activation of thrusters by Russian ground control.
mc_answer4_en: The station's attitude was adjusted by the astronauts without any input from ground control.

flores_passage_en: Fluke wrote that the efforts by some to drown out women from speaking out about women’s health were unsuccessful. She came to this conclusion due to the multitude of positive comments and encouragement sent to her by both female and male individuals urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best explains why Fluke concluded that efforts to silence women were unsuccessful?
mc_answer1_en: Because Fluke received many positive comments from both men and women urging that contraception medication be considered a medical necessity.
mc_answer2_en: Because Fluke herself is a female individual who spoke out against contraception medication.
mc_answer3_en: Because the passage states that only women sent encouragement to Fluke regarding her health.
mc_answer4_en: Because Fluke ignored all comments from male individuals and focused only on female responses.

mc_answer4: କାରଣ ଫ୍ଲୁକ୍ ପୁରୁଷମାନଙ୍କ ସମସ୍ତ ମନ୍ତବ୍ୟକୁ ଅଣଦେଖା କରିଥିଲେ ଏବଂ କେବଳ ମହିଳାମାନଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଉପରେ ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦେଇଥିଲେ।

flores_passage_en: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century. The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice. In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following statements accurately reflects the origin and early practice of hanami in Japan?
mc_answer1_en: The concept of hanami came from Japan, but the emperor initially restricted it to himself and other members of the aristocracy.
mc_answer2_en: Hanami was introduced to Japan by Chinese aristocrats who hosted parties for the emperor.
mc_answer3_en: Hanami originated in Japan with the emperor hosting parties exclusively for aristocrats.
mc_answer4_en: Hanami originated in China with plum blossoms, but in Japan, cherry blossom parties were first hosted by the emperor for aristocrats.

question: ପାଠ୍ୟ ଅନୁସାରେ, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ବିବୃତିଟି ଜାପାନରେ ହାନାମିର ଉତ୍ପତ୍ତି ଏବଂ ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ପ୍ରଥାକୁ ସଠିକ୍ ଭାବରେ ଦର୍ଶାଏ?

flores_passage_en: The fission bomb works on the principle that it takes energy to put together a nucleus with many protons and neutrons. Sort of like rolling a heavy cart up a hill. Splitting the nucleus up again then releases some of that energy. Some atoms have unstable nuclei which means that they tend to break apart with little or no nudging.

mc_answer2_en: It releases energy to assemble a nucleus, similar to letting a cart roll downhill.
mc_answer3_en: It requires no energy to assemble a nucleus, as nuclei naturally form.
mc_answer4_en: It requires energy to assemble a nucleus, similar to pushing a cart uphill.

Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium. They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.

flores_passage_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness. Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements best describes the relationship between proper nutritional practices and elite performance in young athletes?
mc_answer1_en: Proper nutritional practices are the sole determinant of elite performance in young athletes.
mc_answer2_en: Proper nutritional practices guarantee elite performances if combined with effective hydration habits.
mc_answer3_en: Proper nutritional practices are irrelevant to young athletes' overall wellness.
mc_answer4_en: Proper nutritional practices cannot generate elite performances but can significantly affect overall wellness.

mc_answer2_en: Passports should be kept by the passenger at all times to avoid confusion.

mc_answer2_en: It would require less funding to maintain than pre-modern observatories.

mc_answer3_en: The Earth rotates on its axis, but the polar regions are shielded by atmospheric clouds that block sunlight.

flores_passage_en: "There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere. When you travel, expect things not to be like they are ""back home"". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live. This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things."
question_en: According to the passage, what must a traveler keep in mind to avoid disappointment or distaste over local ways of doing things?
mc_answer1_en: Avoid learning about local customs before traveling to maintain spontaneity.
mc_answer2_en: Prepare to enforce your home country's laws and customs wherever you travel.
mc_answer3_en: Expect differences in manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, and language.
mc_answer4_en: Assume that local manners, laws, and standards will be identical to those back home.

flores_passage_en: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so. If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it. If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required. Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.
question_en: If a person is planning to record a video of a historical monument using a drone, what is the most critical action they must take according to the passage?
mc_answer1_en: Avoid flying near airports or crowds regardless of local laws
mc_answer2_en: Confirm that video recording rules are less strict than photography rules
mc_answer3_en: Ensure that taking a photo of the monument is permitted before recording
mc_answer4_en: Obtain additional licensing and permits for drone filming well in advance

flores_passage_en: The Twin Otter had been trying to land at Kokoda yesterday as Airlines PNG Flight CG4684, but had aborted once already. About ten minutes before it was due to land from its second approach it disapeared. The crash site was located today and is so inaccessable that two policemen were dropped into the jungle in order to hike to the scene and seek survivors. The search had been hampered by the same bad weather that had caused the aborted landing.
question_en: Based on the passage, if the second approach was aborted and the plane disappeared about ten minutes before it was due to land from this second approach, and the search for survivors was hampered by bad weather, which of the following statements correctly identifies the sequence of events and the reason for the delay in locating the crash site?
mc_answer1_en: The plane disappeared after the second approach was aborted, but the crash site was found without any delays.
mc_answer2_en: The plane disappeared before the second approach was aborted, and the crash site was found immediately after the incident.
mc_answer3_en: The plane disappeared before the second approach was aborted, and the crash site was found after a search delayed by bad weather.
mc_answer4_en: The plane disappeared after the second approach was aborted, and the crash site was found after a search delayed by bad weather.

flores_passage_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity. Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards. Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.
question_en: According to the passage, what is the primary reason that endurance is more important than speed in the half-mile run compared to the quarter-mile run?
mc_answer1_en: Because speed training is unnecessary for half-mile runners
mc_answer2_en: Because runners can compensate for lack of speed with better technique
mc_answer3_en: Because the half-mile distance requires sustained effort over a longer period
mc_answer4_en: Because the quarter-mile run focuses entirely on upper body strength

flores_passage_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees. The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking. The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges. Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.
question_en: Based on the passage, if a fossil hand bone is dated to 2.5 million years ago, which of the following best describes the specialization of the hand at that time compared to a chimpanzee's hand?
mc_answer1_en: The hand was longer than the foot with curved phalanges.
mc_answer2_en: The hand was specialized for manipulation rather than locomotion.
mc_answer3_en: The hand was primarily used for bearing weight in knuckle walking.
mc_answer4_en: The hand was similar in size and length to the foot.

flores_passage_en: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family. Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield. Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
question_en: According to the passage, if a farmer in a developing nation uses saved seed native to their ecoregion and practices crop rotation, what is the primary purpose of these techniques?
mc_answer1_en: To maximize yield
mc_answer2_en: To sell surplus food in international markets

flores_passage_en: "Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs. ""The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."""
question_en: According to the passage, what is the primary purpose of installing CCTV cameras in Australian abattoirs as advocated by the RSPCA and Animal Liberation?
mc_answer1_en: To provide legal evidence for prosecuting animal abuse cases after they occur.
mc_answer2_en: To ensure that animal welfare is prioritized and to signal this to workers.
mc_answer3_en: To replace the need for human inspectors and surveillance altogether.
mc_answer4_en: To reduce the operational costs for abattoir owners by automating inspections.

flores_passage_en: Travelling by plane can be a scary experience for people of all ages and backgrounds, particularly if they've not flown before or have experienced a traumatic event. It is not something to be ashamed of: it is no different from the personal fears and dislikes of other things that very many people have. For some, understanding something about how aircraft work and what happens during a flight may help to overcome a fear which is based on the unknown or on not being in control.
question_en: According to the passage, what is suggested as a potential method to overcome fear of flying that stems from the unknown or lack of control?

mc_answer2_en: Understanding how aircraft work and what happens during a flight
mc_answer3_en: Avoiding all future flights until fear subsides
mc_answer4_en: Relying solely on medication prescribed by a doctor

flores_passage_en: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves. They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses. Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following accurately describes the financial relationship between the U.S. colonial regime and the Filipino people regarding war expenditures?
mc_answer1_en: The U.S. government fully funded war expenditures without any tax burden on Filipinos.
mc_answer2_en: Wall Street banking houses directly paid all war expenditures from their own funds.

flores_passage_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism. Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically. The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish. Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters. Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.

mc_answer4_en: 600 organisms per liter

flores_passage_en: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel. There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona. Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.
question_en: If a user in Chicken, Alaska selects a number from Arizona for their satellite Internet connection, how does this affect the billing or routing for incoming calls from a traditional PSTN phone?
mc_answer1_en: The call will be routed as an international call regardless of the caller's location.
mc_answer2_en: The call may incur long-distance charges depending on the caller's location and the number's origin.
mc_answer3_en: The call will be routed locally to the caller's area code regardless of the number's origin.
mc_answer4_en: The call will always be free because it uses an Internet connection.

flores_passage_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria. They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List. Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea. Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

mc_answer3_en: Cars and helicopters
mc_answer4_en: Buses and taxis

flores_passage_en: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa. Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife. Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts. The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte. European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.

flores_passage_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole. Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea. A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter. Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice. Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

flores_passage_en: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings. An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites. A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person. Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases. These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.
question_en: According to the passage, if a traveler intends to visit Country A, which previously had an outbreak of a contagious disease, and then plans to visit Country B, which requires vaccination for diseases transmitted in close proximity to infected persons, what is the most likely reason Country B might require vaccination?
mc_answer1_en: Because the disease is caused by a pathogen like a virus or bacterium.
mc_answer2_en: Because the disease can be transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.
mc_answer3_en: Because the traveler plans to visit a country that requires vaccination for contagious diseases.

flores_passage_en: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures. On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt. During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time. Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows. On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
question_en: Based on the passage, if a driver encounters a situation where snow is falling rapidly and visibility is restricted by blowing snow, what specific risk is highlighted regarding the vehicle's ability to remain mobile?
mc_answer1_en: The vehicle's engine will freeze due to condensation on the windows.

mc_answer3_en: Traffic will become completely uninterrupted despite the blizzard conditions.
mc_answer4_en: The vehicle may get stuck because enough snow can accumulate in very little time.

Please treat the site with all of the dignity, solemnity and respect it deserves. Do not make jokes about the Holocaust or Nazis. Do not deface the site by marking or scratching graffiti into structures.

flores_passage_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting. The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states. With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem. This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV. The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.
question_en: According to the passage, if a person experiences many artificially induced lucid dreams per night, what is the most likely consequence regarding their sleep recovery?
mc_answer1_en: They will wake up every twenty or thirty minutes to watch TV.
mc_answer2_en: They will have longer REM states without exhausting effects.
mc_answer3_en: They will experience more frequent REM states, enhancing recovery.

It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information. In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. question_en: According to the passage, what is one key advantage of asynchronous communication for students regarding time management?
mc_answer1_en: It ensures immediate responses from instructors without any delay.
mc_answer2_en: It limits their access to information to business hours only.

flores_passage_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others. That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire. Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions. For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car. He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following scenarios would lead to a different judgment of the person breaking the car window?
mc_answer1_en: The person is breaking the window to escape a fire.
mc_answer2_en: The person is trying to steal a stranger's car.
mc_answer3_en: The person is trying to break into their own car after losing their keys.
mc_answer4_en: The person is breaking the window to test the glass's durability.

flores_passage_en: "The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean. It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean. With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as ""Hawaii down under"". Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development. The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements accurately reflects the geographical and administrative characteristics of the Cook Islands?
mc_answer1_en: The Cook Islands have 15 islands spread over 2.2 million km² and no cities.
mc_answer2_en: The Cook Islands have 12 islands spread over 2.2 million km² and no cities.
mc_answer3_en: The Cook Islands have 15 islands spread over 2.2 million km² and 2 cities.
mc_answer4_en: The Cook Islands have 15 islands spread over 2.2 million km² and 3 cities.

flores_passage_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them. Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe. The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy. Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following statements about Sanskrit is supported by the text?
mc_answer1_en: Sanskrit was the earliest known book, and it faded due to a lack of complexity.
mc_answer2_en: The Upanishads were compiled after Sanskrit had already faded from use.

flores_passage_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism. This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun. Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists. If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism. Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.
question_en: A tour guide is planning a series of trips for different groups of tourists. Based on the passage, if a group of tourists visits a beach to relax and have fun, which type of tourism does this represent?

flores_passage: ବୋଧହୁଏ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟଟନର ସବୁଠାରୁ ସାଧାରଣ ପ୍ରକାର ହେଉଛି ସେହି ପ୍ରକାର ଯାହାକୁ ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଲୋକ ଭ୍ରମଣ ସହିତ ଯୋଡ଼ିଥାନ୍ତି: ମନୋରଞ୍ଜନ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟଟନ। ଏହା ସେତେବେଳେ ହୁଏ ଯେତେବେଳେ ଲୋକମାନେ ଆରାମ କରିବା ଏବଂ ମଜା କରିବା ପାଇଁ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ନିୟମିତ ଦୈନନ୍ଦିନ ଜୀବନଠାରୁ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭିନ୍ନ ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତି। ବେଳାଭୂମି, ଥିମ୍ ପାର୍କ ଏବଂ କ୍ୟାମ୍ପ୍ ସ୍ଥଳଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ମନୋରଞ୍ଜନକାରୀ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟଟକଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପରିଦର୍ଶିତ ସବୁଠାରୁ ସାଧାରଣ ସ୍ଥାନ ଅଟେ। ଯଦି କୌଣସି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ସ୍ଥାନ ପରିଦର୍ଶନ କରିବାର ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ଏହାର ଇତିହାସ ଏବଂ ସଂସ୍କୃତି ଜାଣିବା ହୋଇଥାଏ, ତେବେ ଏହି ପ୍ରକାରର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟଟନକୁ ସାଂସ୍କୃତିକ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟଟନ ଭାବରେ ଜଣାଯାଏ। ପର୍ଯ୍ୟଟକମାନେ ଏକ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଦେଶର ବିଭିନ୍ନ ପ୍ରମୁଖ ସ୍ଥାନ ପରିଦର୍ଶନ କରିପାରନ୍ତି କିମ୍ବା ସେମାନେ କେବଳ ଗୋଟିଏ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ଉପରେ ଧ୍ୟାନ କେନ୍ଦ୍ରିତ କରିବାକୁ ପସନ୍ଦ କରିପାରନ୍ତି।

flores_passage_en: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected. You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens. As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs. Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country. The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
question_en: If a traveler's home government issues a travel advisory that contradicts the advice of the destination country's government, which of the following best describes the likely impact on the traveler's trip cancellation insurance coverage based on the passage?
mc_answer1_en: The insurance coverage may be affected, as advisories are brief summaries that might not reflect detailed situations.
mc_answer2_en: The insurance coverage will automatically be voided regardless of the advisory's content.
mc_answer3_en: The traveler must follow only their home government's advice to maintain full insurance coverage.
mc_answer4_en: Government advice from other countries is designed for their citizens and does not apply to the traveler's insurance.
flores_passage: ଯଦି ଆପଣ ଭ୍ରମଣ କରିବାକୁ ଥିବା ଦେଶ ଭ୍ରମଣ ସତର୍କତା ବା ପରାମର୍ଶର ଅଧୀନରେ ଆସେ, ତେବେ ଆପଣଙ୍କର ଯାତ୍ରା ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ବୀମା କିମ୍ବା ଆପଣଙ୍କର ଯାତ୍ରା ବାତିଲ ବୀମା ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ହୋଇପାରେ। ଆପଣ ନିଜ ଦେଶ ବ୍ୟତୀତ ଅନ୍ୟ ସରକାରଙ୍କ ପରାମର୍ଶ ମଧ୍ୟ ନେବାକୁ ଚାହିଁପାରନ୍ତି, କିନ୍ତୁ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ପରାମର୍ଶ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ନାଗରିକମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଉଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ। ଉଦାହରଣ ସ୍ୱରୂପ, ମଧ୍ୟପ୍ରାଚ୍ୟରେ ଆମେରିକୀୟ ନାଗରିକମାନେ ୟୁରୋପୀୟ କିମ୍ବା ଆରବମାନଙ୍କ ଠାରୁ ଭିନ୍ନ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିର ସମ୍ମୁଖୀନ ହୋଇପାରନ୍ତି। ପରାମର୍ଶଗୁଡ଼ିକ କେବଳ ଗୋଟିଏ ଦେଶର ରାଜନୈତିକ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିର ଏକ ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ ସାରାଂଶ। ଅନ୍ୟତ୍ର ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ଅଧିକ ବିସ୍ତୃତ ସୂଚନା ତୁଳନାରେ ଉପସ୍ଥାପିତ ମତାମତଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଉପରଠାଉରିଆ, ସାଧାରଣ ଏବଂ ଅତ୍ୟଧିକ ସରଳୀକୃତ ହୋଇଥାଏ।

flores_passage_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families. Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around. In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially. Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances. There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.
question_en: Based on the passage, if a family with 3 passengers takes a taxi in Charlotte, which of the following best explains why this might be more expensive than necessary?
mc_answer1_en: Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially in child-friendly options.
mc_answer2_en: The surcharge for having more than 2 passengers increases the cost.
mc_answer3_en: Visitors find the city easy to enjoy with children around.
mc_answer4_en: Taxis are generally not used by families in Charlotte.
flores_passage: ଉତ୍ତର କାରୋଲିନାର ଶାର୍ଲଟ ସହରର ଏକ ପ୍ରମୁଖ ବିଶେଷତ୍ୱ ହେଉଛି ଯେ ଏଠାରେ ପରିବାରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରଚୁର ପରିମାଣରେ ଉଚ୍ଚମାନର ବିକଳ୍ପ ରହିଛି। ଅନ୍ୟ ଅଞ୍ଚଳର ବାସିନ୍ଦାମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ପାରିବାରିକ-ଅନୁକୂଳତାକୁ ସେଠାକୁ ସ୍ଥାନାନ୍ତରିତ ହେବାର ଏକ ପ୍ରମୁଖ କାରଣ ଭାବରେ ଉଲ୍ଲେଖ କରନ୍ତି ଏବଂ ପରିଦର୍ଶକମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କ ସହିତ ସହରକୁ ଉପଭୋଗ କରିବା ସହଜ ମନେ କରନ୍ତି। ବିଗତ ୨୦ ବର୍ଷ ମଧ୍ୟରେ, ଅପଟାଉନ୍ ଶାର୍ଲଟରେ ଶିଶୁ-ଅନୁକୂଳ ବିକଳ୍ପଗୁଡ଼ିକର ସଂଖ୍ୟା ଦ୍ରୁତ ଗତିରେ ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇଛି। ଶାର୍ଲଟରେ ପରିବାରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ଟ୍ୟାକ୍ସି ବ୍ୟବହାର କରନ୍ତି ନାହିଁ, ଯଦିଓ କେତେକ ପରିସ୍ଥିତିରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ କିଛି ମାତ୍ରାରେ ଉପଯୋଗୀ ହୋଇପାରେ। ୨ ରୁ ଅଧିକ ଯାତ୍ରୀ ଥିଲେ ଏକ ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ଶୁଳ୍କ (ସରଚାର୍ଜ) ଲାଗିଥାଏ, ତେଣୁ ଏହି ବିକଳ୍ପଟି ଆବଶ୍ୟକତାଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ମହଙ୍ଗା ହୋଇପାରେ।

flores_passage_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states. The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance. The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power. This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.
question_en: According to the passage, which war is identified as the first whose central issue was the balance of power?
mc_answer1_en: The Napoleonic Wars
mc_answer2_en: The Hundred Years' War

flores_passage_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances. Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles. Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds. They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow. Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best describes the primary reason for the development of the Roman Medical Corps?

flores_passage_en: During the Revolutionary War, the thirteen states first formed a weak central government—with the Congress being its only component—under the Articles of Confederation. Congress lacked any power to impose taxes, and, because there was no national executive or judiciary, it relied on state authorities, who were often uncooperative, to enforce all its acts. It also had no authority to override tax laws and tariffs between states. The Articles required unanimous consent from all the states before they could be amended and states took the central government so lightly that their representatives were often absent.
question_en: According to the passage, if the Articles of Confederation required unanimous consent for amendment and states frequently sent absent representatives, what logical consequence follows regarding the likelihood of amending the Articles?
mc_answer1_en: Amendments were nearly impossible to achieve due to the requirement for unanimous state approval.
mc_answer2_en: Amendments were facilitated by the presence of a national executive branch.
mc_answer3_en: Amendments were highly likely to occur quickly due to the strong central government.
mc_answer4_en: Amendments could be passed with a simple majority vote from attending representatives.

flores_passage_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots. Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous. These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves. A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk. Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements best explains why some scientists argue that Triceratops did not eat cycads?

mc_answer2_en: Triceratops only ate leaves and not branches or roots.
mc_answer3_en: Cycads are considered very poisonous by some scientists.
mc_answer4_en: The Triceratops beak was too weak to strip off the leaves.

flores_passage_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time. Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range. In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen. German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines. Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements about German submarines during World War II is NOT supported by the text?
mc_answer1_en: German submarines were known as U-Boats.
mc_answer2_en: Germans were skilled at navigating and operating their submarines.

flores_passage_en: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond. Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project. Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office. Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best describes the role of scaffolding in a new learning experience?
mc_answer1_en: Scaffolding is an aid that provides support to individuals undergoing a new learning experience.
mc_answer2_en: Scaffolding is a method used exclusively for computer-based training programs.
mc_answer3_en: Scaffolding is a standalone learning method that replaces the need for teachers.
mc_answer4_en: Scaffolding is solely a virtual tool embedded in software like Microsoft Office.

flores_passage_en: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences. Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group. They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management. The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team. The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best describes the relationship between virtual team members and their 'invisible team'?
mc_answer1_en: Virtual team members are managed by local management, while the invisible team operates independently.
mc_answer2_en: The invisible team is a temporary committee formed to oversee specific virtual projects.
mc_answer3_en: Virtual team members report directly to the invisible team, which sets standards for them.
mc_answer4_en: The invisible team is a subgroup within the virtual team that handles local management issues.
flores_passage: ଭର୍ଚୁଆଲ୍ ଟିମ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ଟିମ୍ ପରି ଉତ୍କର୍ଷତାର ସମାନ ମାନଦଣ୍ଡ ପାଳନ କରନ୍ତି, କିନ୍ତୁ ଏଥିରେ କିଛି ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମ ପାର୍ଥକ୍ୟ ଥାଏ। ଭର୍ଚୁଆଲ୍ ଟିମ୍‌ର ସଦସ୍ୟମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ଭୌତିକ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀ ପାଇଁ ଯୋଗାଯୋଗର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ମାଧ୍ୟମ ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରନ୍ତି। ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ଟିମ୍‌ର ସଦସ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କ ତୁଳନାରେ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ପାଖରେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଅଧିକ ସ୍ୱାଧୀନତା ଥାଏ, କାରଣ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଟିମ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବିଭିନ୍ନ ସମୟ କ୍ଷେତ୍ର (ଟାଇମ୍ ଜୋନ୍) ଅନୁସାରେ ବୈଠକ କରିପାରନ୍ତି ଯାହା ସେମାନଙ୍କ ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ପରିଚାଳନା କର୍ତ୍ତୃପକ୍ଷଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ବୁଝାପଡ଼ି ନ ଥାଇପାରେ। ଏକ ପ୍ରକୃତ "ଅଦୃଶ୍ୟ ଟିମ୍" (ଲାର୍ସନ ଏବଂ ଲାଫାଷ୍ଟୋ, 1989, ପୃଷ୍ଠା 109) ର ଉପସ୍ଥିତି ମଧ୍ୟ ଏକ ଭର୍ଚୁଆଲ୍ ଟିମ୍‌ର ଏକ ଅନନ୍ୟ ଉପାଦାନ। "ଅଦୃଶ୍ୟ ଟିମ୍" ହେଉଛି ସେହି ପରିଚାଳନା ଟିମ୍ ଯାହାଙ୍କ ନିକଟରେ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସଦସ୍ୟ ରିପୋର୍ଟ କରନ୍ତି। ଅଦୃଶ୍ୟ ଟିମ୍ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସଦସ୍ୟଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ମାନଦଣ୍ଡ ସ୍ଥିର କରେ।

flores_passage_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover. In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors. Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland. In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices. Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now. Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following statements about the number of protestors in German cities is supported by the text?
mc_answer1_en: About 200 people protested in Berlin, while 100,000 protested in all German cities combined.
mc_answer2_en: The passage states that 6,500 people protested in Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover together.
mc_answer3_en: Police estimated that 6,500 people protested in Berlin alone.
mc_answer4_en: Approximately 100,000 people protested in German cities collectively.
flores_passage: ବିକ୍ଷୋଭର ଆୟୋଜକମାନେ କହିଛନ୍ତି ଯେ ବର୍ଲିନ, କୋଲୋନ, ହାମବର୍ଗ ଏବଂ ହାନୋଭର ଭଳି ଜର୍ମାନ ସହରଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ପ୍ରାୟ ୧୦୦,୦୦୦ ଲୋକ ଉପସ୍ଥିତ ହୋଇଥିଲେ। ବର୍ଲିନରେ ପୋଲିସ ୬,୫୦୦ ବିକ୍ଷୋଭକାରୀ ଥିବା ଆକଳନ କରିଥିଲା। ପ୍ୟାରିସ, ବୁଲଗେରିଆର ସୋଫିଆ, ଲିଥୁଆନିଆର ଭିଲନିୟସ, ମାଲ୍ଟାର ଭାଲେଟା, ଏଷ୍ଟୋନିଆର ଟାଲିନ ଏବଂ ସ୍କଟଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡର ଏଡିନବର୍ଗ ଓ ଗ୍ଲାସଗୋରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ବିକ୍ଷୋଭ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ଲଣ୍ଡନରେ, ପ୍ରାୟ ୨୦୦ ଜଣ ଲୋକ କେତେକ ପ୍ରମୁଖ କପିରାଇଟ୍ ଧାରକମାନଙ୍କ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାଳୟ ବାହାରେ ବିକ୍ଷୋଭ କରିଥିଲେ। ଗତ ମାସରେ, ପୋଲାଣ୍ଡରେ ବଡ଼ ଧରଣର ବିକ୍ଷୋଭ ହୋଇଥିଲା ଯେତେବେଳେ ସେହି ଦେଶ ACTA ସ୍ୱାକ୍ଷର କରିଥିଲା, ଯାହା ଫଳରେ ପୋଲାଣ୍ଡ ସରକାର ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ପାଇଁ ଏହି ଚୁକ୍ତିନାମାକୁ ଅନୁମୋଦନ ନ କରିବାକୁ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନେଇଛନ୍ତି। ଲାଟଭିଆ ଏବଂ ସ୍ଲୋଭାକିଆ ଉଭୟ ACTA ରେ ଯୋଗଦେବା ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକୁ ବିଳମ୍ବିତ କରିଛନ୍ତି।

flores_passage_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps. At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. flores_passage_en: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus. The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour. To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite. The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore. This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.
question_en: Based on the passage, if a tourist wants to find evidence of Hong Kong's colonial past while enjoying a view of the city skyline, which area should they prioritize first?

mc_answer2_en: The Kowloon waterfront

He used to frequent a cave that became known as “Hira‘” on the Mountain of “Noor” (light) for contemplation. he cave itself, which survived the times, gives a very vivid image of Muhammad’s spiritual inclinations. flores_passage_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital. The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years. The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center. Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel. Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements accurately reflects the relationship between Jerusalem's religious significance and its status as a tourist destination?
mc_answer1_en: Jerusalem's status as a tourist destination is unrelated to its religious significance, focusing instead on shopping and dining.
mc_answer2_en: Jerusalem is the largest city in Israel, which makes it the top tourist destination despite limited religious sites.
mc_answer3_en: Most countries recognize Jerusalem as Israel's capital, which drives its popularity as a tourist destination.
mc_answer4_en: Jerusalem is a major tourist destination primarily because of its religious sites, especially in the Old City.

flores_passage_en: "After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap. Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as ""Dunlap broadsides"". The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8. One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10. flores_passage_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana. The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay. In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic. You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls. On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
question_en: Based on the passage, during which months is the water volume at Victoria Falls highest, and what is the primary effect of this condition on viewing the Falls?

mc_answer2_en: April to October; the Falls are more dramatic but often obscured by water
