flores_passage_en: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast. The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park. The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain. The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas. Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.

flores_passage_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas. The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society. However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture. There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand. They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following statements best describes the relationship between the Moriori and the Maori people regarding the Chatham Islands?
mc_answer1_en: The Moriori were the original inhabitants of New Zealand before the Maori arrived.
mc_answer2_en: The Moriori migrated from Polynesia to New Zealand and established an agricultural society.
mc_answer3_en: The Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands and were eventually wiped out by other Maori.

flores_passage_en: "Prime Minister Stephen Harper has agreed to send the government's 'Clean Air Act' to an all-party committee for review, before its second reading, after Tuesday's 25 minute meeting with NDP leader Jack Layton at the PMO. Layton had asked for changes to the conservatives' environmental bill during the meeting with the PM, asking for a ""thorough and complete rewriting"" of the Conservative party's environmental bill. Ever since the Federal Government stepped in to take over funding of the Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, the state government and some federal MPs have criticised this act as a stunt in the prelude to the federal election to be called by November. But Prime Minister John Howard has said the act was only to safeguard the facilities of the hospital from being downgraded by the Tasmanian government, in giving an extra AUD$45 million."
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following statements is TRUE regarding the timeline and events described?
mc_answer1_en: John Howard is currently the Prime Minister of Canada.
mc_answer2_en: The Mersey hospital in Devonport, Tasmania, received no additional funding.
mc_answer3_en: The meeting between Stephen Harper and Jack Layton lasted longer than 25 minutes.
mc_answer4_en: The federal election is scheduled to be called by November.
flores_passage: ପ୍ରଧାନମନ୍ତ୍ରୀ ଷ୍ଟିଫେନ୍ ହାର୍ପର ମଙ୍ଗଳବାର ଦିନ PMO ରେ NDP ନେତା ଜ୍ୟାକ୍ ଲେଟନଙ୍କ ସହିତ ୨୫ ମିନିଟର ବୈଠକ ପରେ, ଏହାର ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ପଠନ ପୂର୍ବରୁ, ସରକାରଙ୍କ 'କ୍ଲିନ୍ ଏୟାର ଆକ୍ଟ'କୁ ସମୀକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ଏକ ସର୍ବଦଳୀୟ କମିଟି ନିକଟକୁ ପଠାଇବାକୁ ରାଜି ହୋଇଛନ୍ତି। ଲେଟନ ପ୍ରଧାନମନ୍ତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ସହ ବୈଠକ ସମୟରେ କଞ୍ଜରଭେଟିଭ୍ ଦଳର ପରିବେଶ ବିଲ୍‌ରେ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ କରିବାକୁ ଅନୁରୋଧ କରିଥିଲେ ଏବଂ କଞ୍ଜରଭେଟିଭ୍ ପାର୍ଟିର ପରିବେଶ ବିଲ୍‌ର ଏକ "ପୁଙ୍ଖାନୁପୁଙ୍ଖ ଏବଂ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ପୁନଃଲିଖନ" କରିବାକୁ କହିଥିଲେ। ଯେବେଠାରୁ ଫେଡେରାଲ୍ ସରକାର ତାସମାନିଆର ଡେଭନପୋର୍ଟସ୍ଥିତ ମର୍ସି ହସ୍ପିଟାଲର ପାଣ୍ଠି ଯୋଗାଣ ଦାୟିତ୍ୱ ନେଇଛନ୍ତି, ସେବେଠାରୁ ରାଜ୍ୟ ସରକାର ଏବଂ କିଛି ଫେଡେରାଲ ସାଂସଦ ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପକୁ ନଭେମ୍ବର ସୁଦ୍ଧା ଘୋଷଣା ହେବାକୁ ଥିବା ଫେଡେରାଲ ନିର୍ବାଚନ ପୂର୍ବର ଏକ ଷ୍ଟଣ୍ଟ ଭାବରେ ସମାଲୋଚନା କରିଛନ୍ତି। କିନ୍ତୁ ପ୍ରଧାନମନ୍ତ୍ରୀ ଜନ୍ ହାୱାର୍ଡ କହିଛନ୍ତି ଯେ ଅତିରିକ୍ତ AUD$45 ମିଲିୟନ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରି ଏହି ପଦକ୍ଷେପ କେବଳ ତାସମାନିଆ ସରକାରଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଡାକ୍ତରଖାନାର ସୁବିଧାଗୁଡ଼ିକର ମାନ ହ୍ରାସ ହେବାରୁ ରକ୍ଷା କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଥିଲା।

flores_passage: "ବ୍ଲଗ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କର ଲେଖା ଶୈଳୀରେ ଉନ୍ନତି ଆଣିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିପାରିବ। ଯଦିଓ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ତ୍ରୁଟିପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବ୍ୟାକରଣ ଏବଂ ବନାନ ସହିତ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ବ୍ଲଗ୍ ଅନୁଭୂତି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତି, କିନ୍ତୁ ପାଠକଙ୍କ ଉପସ୍ଥିତି ସାଧାରଣତଃ ଏହାକୁ ବଦଳାଇ ଦିଏ। ଯେହେତୁ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ସବୁଠାରୁ ବଡ଼ ସମାଲୋଚକ ପାଠକ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତି, ତେଣୁ ବ୍ଲଗ୍ ଲେଖକ ସମାଲୋଚନାକୁ ଏଡ଼ାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଲେଖାରେ ଉନ୍ନତି ଆଣିବାକୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରିବା ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତି। ଏହା ସହିତ ବ୍ଲଗିଂ ""ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଚାରିପାଖର ଦୁନିଆ ବିଷୟରେ ଅଧିକ ଅବଗତ ହେବାକୁ ବାଧ୍ୟ କରେ।"" ପାଠକମାନଙ୍କ ଆଗ୍ରହ ବଜାୟ ରଖିବାର ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ଚତୁର ଏବଂ ଆକର୍ଷଣୀୟ ହେବା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରେରଣା ଦିଏ (ଟୋଟୋ, 2004)। ବ୍ଲଗିଂ ହେଉଛି ଏକ ମାଧ୍ୟମ ଯାହା ସହଯୋଗକୁ ପ୍ରେରଣା ଦିଏ, ଏବଂ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ବିଦ୍ୟାଳୟ ସମୟ ବାହାରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଶିକ୍ଷାକୁ ଆଗେଇ ନେବାକୁ ଉତ୍ସାହିତ କରେ। ବ୍ଲଗ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକର ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ବ୍ୟବହାର ""ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ଅଧିକ ବିଶ୍ଳେଷଣାତ୍ମକ ଏବଂ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ହେବା ପାଇଁ ସଶକ୍ତ କରିପାରିବ; ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ ପ୍ରତି ସକ୍ରିୟ ଭାବରେ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଦେଇ, ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନେ ଅନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କ ଲେଖାର ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗରେ ନିଜ ସ୍ଥିତି ସ୍ଥିର କରିପାରିବେ ଏବଂ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗରେ ନିଜର ଦୃଷ୍ଟିକୋଣ ଉପସ୍ଥାପନ କରିପାରିବେ (ଓରାଭେକ୍, 2002)।"

flores_passage_en: "One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up. Such children are called ""feral"" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment. Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away. Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own. When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans."
question_en: According to the passage, what is the primary reason some feral children were abandoned by their parents?
mc_answer1_en: The parents were unaware of the child's condition until later.
mc_answer2_en: The child had run away from home after experiencing trauma.
mc_answer3_en: The parents were unable to provide care because of extreme poverty.
mc_answer4_en: The parents had rejected the child due to severe intellectual or physical impairment.
flores_passage: ସାମାଜିକୀକରଣର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱକୁ ବୁଝାଇବା ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ଏକ ସବୁଠାରୁ ସାଧାରଣ ଉପାୟ ହେଉଛି ସେହି କିଛି ଦୁର୍ଭାଗ୍ୟଜନକ ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କର ଉଦାହରଣ ନେବା, ଯେଉଁମାନେ ଅବହେଳା, ଦୁର୍ଭାଗ୍ୟ କିମ୍ବା ଇଚ୍ଛାକୃତ ନିର୍ଯାତନା ଯୋଗୁଁ ବଡ଼ ହେବା ସମୟରେ ବୟସ୍କମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସାମାଜିକୀକୃତ ହୋଇପାରିନଥିଲେ। ଏହିପରି ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କୁ "ଫେରାଲ୍" କିମ୍ବା ବନ୍ୟ କୁହାଯାଏ। କିଛି ଫେରାଲ୍ ପିଲାଙ୍କୁ ଲୋକମାନେ (ସାଧାରଣତଃ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ନିଜ ପିତାମାତା) ବନ୍ଦୀ କରି ରଖିଥାନ୍ତି; କେତେକ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ପିଲାଟିର ଗୁରୁତର ବୌଦ୍ଧିକ କିମ୍ବା ଶାରୀରିକ ଅକ୍ଷମତାକୁ ପିତାମାତା ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାନ କରିବା ଯୋଗୁଁ ଏଭଳି ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କୁ ପରିତ୍ୟାଗ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା। ଫେରାଲ୍ ପିଲାମାନେ ପରିତ୍ୟକ୍ତ ହେବା କିମ୍ବା ପଳାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଗୁରୁତର ଶିଶୁ ନିର୍ଯାତନା କିମ୍ବା ମାନସିକ ଆଘାତର ଶିକାର ହୋଇଥାଇପାରନ୍ତି। ଅନ୍ୟ କେତେକ ପଶୁମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଲାଳିତପାଳିତ ହୋଇଥିବା କୁହାଯାଏ; ଆଉ କେତେକ ଜଙ୍ଗଲରେ ନିଜେ ଏକାକୀ ରହିଥିବା କୁହାଯାଏ। ଯେତେବେଳେ ଅଣ-ମାନବ ପଶୁମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ରୂପେ ଲାଳିତପାଳିତ ହୁଅନ୍ତି, ସେତେବେଳେ ଫେରାଲ୍ ପିଲାଟି (ଶାରୀରିକ ସୀମା ମଧ୍ୟରେ) ପ୍ରାୟ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବେ ସେହି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପାଳନକାରୀ ପଶୁ ଭଳି ଆଚରଣ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ କରେ, ଯେପରିକି ମଣିଷ ପ୍ରତି ଭୟ କିମ୍ବା ଉଦାସୀନତା।

flores_passage_en: "Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology. Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has ""effects"" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned. For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads. However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership. Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies."
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following sequences best represents the causal chain described in the example of the motor car?
mc_answer1_en: Mass car ownership → higher accident incidence → new healthcare techniques → reduced car ownership costs
mc_answer2_en: Development of roads → motor car necessity → mass production → economic viability

question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ରାଷ୍ଟ୍ରପତି ବୁଶଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଦ୍ୱାରା ଉତ୍ତର କୋରିଆର ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ବିଷୟରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ କେଉଁ ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷଟି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଦୃଢ଼ ଭାବରେ ସମର୍ଥିତ?
mc_answer1: ଆମେରିକା ପ୍ରଶାସନ ଉତ୍ତର କୋରିଆର ପ୍ରତିବଦ୍ଧତାର ସଚ୍ଚୋଟତା ଉପରେ ସନ୍ଦେହ କରୁଛି।
mc_answer2: ଗର୍ଡନ ଜୋହଣ୍ଡ୍ରୋ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ଭାବେ ଉତ୍ତର କୋରିଆ ତରଫରୁ ଏହି ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରିଥିଲେ।
mc_answer3: ଏହି ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ପ୍ରଶାସନର ଯାଞ୍ଚଯୋଗ୍ୟ ପରମାଣୁ ନିରସ୍ତ୍ରୀକରଣର ଘୋଷିତ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ସହିତ ମେଳ ଖାଉଛି।
mc_answer4: ଉତ୍ତର କୋରିଆ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ହିଁ ଉପଦ୍ୱୀପର ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ପରମାଣୁ ନିରସ୍ତ୍ରୀକରଣ କରିସାରିଛି।

flores_passage_en: On Wednesday, the United States' National Basketball Association (NBA) suspended its professional basketball season due to concerns regarding COVID-19. The NBA's decision followed a Utah Jazz player testing positive for the COVID-19 virus.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be logically inferred about the NBA's decision to suspend the season?
mc_answer1_en: The NBA prioritizes player and public health over continuing the season.
mc_answer2_en: The NBA was forced to suspend the season by government officials.
mc_answer3_en: The Utah Jazz player's illness was the only reason for the suspension.
mc_answer4_en: The suspension was temporary until the player recovered.
flores_passage: ବୁଧବାର ଦିନ, ଯୁକ୍ତରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର ଆମେରିକାର ନ୍ୟାସନାଲ ବାସ୍କେଟବଲ ଆସୋସିଏସନ (NBA) କୋଭିଡ-୧୯ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ଚିନ୍ତା କାରଣରୁ ଏହାର ବୃତ୍ତିଗତ ବାସ୍କେଟବଲ ସିଜନକୁ ସ୍ଥଗିତ ରଖିଥିଲା। ୟୁଟା ଜାଜ୍‌ର ଜଣେ ଖେଳାଳି କୋଭିଡ-୧୯ ଭାଇରସ ପାଇଁ ପଜିଟିଭ ଚିହ୍ନଟ ହେବା ପରେ NBA ଏହି ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନେଇଥିଲା।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ସିଜନ ସ୍ଥଗିତ ରଖିବା ପାଇଁ NBA ର ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ବିଷୟରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ଭାବରେ ଅନୁମାନ କରାଯାଇପାରିବ?
mc_answer1: NBA ସିଜନ ଜାରି ରଖିବା ତୁଳନାରେ ଖେଳାଳି ଏବଂ ଜନସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟକୁ ଅଧିକ ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ଦିଏ।
mc_answer2: ସରକାରୀ ଅଧିକାରୀମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା NBA କୁ ସିଜନ ସ୍ଥଗିତ ରଖିବାକୁ ବାଧ୍ୟ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା।
mc_answer3: ୟୁଟା ଜାଜ୍ ଖେଳାଳିଙ୍କ ଅସୁସ୍ଥତା ହିଁ ଏହି ସ୍ଥଗିତତାର ଏକମାତ୍ର କାରଣ ଥିଲା।
mc_answer4: ଖେଳାଳି ଜଣକ ସୁସ୍ଥ ହେବା ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଏହି ସ୍ଥଗିତତା ଅସ୍ଥାୟୀ ଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety. You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags. If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.
question_en: Based on the passage, which conclusion can be logically inferred about the priority of actions when encountering a potential victim?
mc_answer1_en: Getting hurt while helping is an acceptable risk if the victim is in immediate danger.
mc_answer2_en: Automatic red flags are the only critical information needed before making contact.
mc_answer3_en: The victim's position should be ignored if it seems dangerous to approach.
mc_answer4_en: The rescuer's personal safety is a prerequisite for effective assistance.

question: ଏହି ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ଜଣେ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ପୀଡ଼ିତଙ୍କ ସମ୍ମୁଖୀନ ହେବା ସମୟରେ ପଦକ୍ଷେପଗୁଡ଼ିକର ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ବିଷୟରେ କେଉଁ ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷ ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ଭାବରେ ଅନୁମାନ କରାଯାଇପାରିବ?

mc_answer2: ଯୋଗାଯୋଗ କରିବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ସ୍ୱୟଂଚାଳିତ ବିପଦ ସଙ୍କେତଗୁଡ଼ିକ ହିଁ ଏକମାତ୍ର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଆବଶ୍ୟକୀୟ ସୂଚନା।

mc_answer4: ଉଦ୍ଧାରକାରୀଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ହେଉଛି ପ୍ରଭାବଶାଳୀ ସହାୟତା ପ୍ରଦାନ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ପ୍ରାଥମିକ ସର୍ତ୍ତ।

flores_passage_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed. These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions can be most reasonably inferred about the nervous system's role in threat response?
mc_answer1_en: The nervous system's speed is essential for preventing harm from potential threats.
mc_answer2_en: The nervous system operates independently of blood flow to maintain homeostasis.
mc_answer3_en: The nervous system prioritizes blood flow regulation over threat detection.

mc_answer1_en: All airlines within the same alliance provide identical privileges and frequent flyer point structures to their members.
mc_answer2_en: An individual may benefit more from selecting an airline in the same alliance that offers superior privileges, even if it is not the one they fly most.

mc_answer4_en: It is unnecessary to consider airline alliances when choosing a frequent flyer program.

question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences about visiting Singapore is most logically supported?
mc_answer1_en: Strong sun exposure is more frequent than heat exposure due to Singapore's position.
mc_answer2_en: Visitors should prepare for consistent heat exposure regardless of weather conditions.

question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ଜାତିଗତ ଷ୍ଟେରିଓଟାଇପ୍ ଏବଂ ଶୈକ୍ଷିକ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ସମ୍ପର୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷଟି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଦୃଢ଼ ଭାବରେ ସମର୍ଥିତ?

mc_answer2: ଯେଉଁ ପିଲାମାନେ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଜାତିଗତ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀ ବିଷୟରେ ନକାରାତ୍ମକ ଷ୍ଟେରିଓଟାଇପ୍ ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ସଚେତନ ଥାଆନ୍ତି, ସେହି ଷ୍ଟେରିଓଟାଇପ୍‌ଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଆତ୍ମସ୍ଥ କରିବା ଯୋଗୁଁ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ଶୈକ୍ଷିକ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ ହ୍ରାସ ପାଇପାରେ।
mc_answer3: ଶୈକ୍ଷିକ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ କେବଳ ଜନ୍ମଗତ ବୁଦ୍ଧିମତା ଦ୍ୱାରା ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ ଏବଂ ସାମାଜିକ ସଚେତନତା କିମ୍ବା ଷ୍ଟେରିଓଟାଇପ୍ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ।
mc_answer4: ଏକ ସଂଖ୍ୟାଲଘୁ ଜାତିର ବୋଲି ନିଜକୁ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରୁଥିବା ସମସ୍ତ ପିଲା ବାହ୍ୟ ପ୍ରଭାବ ନିର୍ବିଶେଷରେ ସ୍କୁଲରେ ଅପରିହାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଭାବରେ ଖରାପ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ କରିବେ।

flores_passage_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts. Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most logically supported regarding Naked News' strategic direction?
mc_answer1_en: The organization is prioritizing domestic news reporting over international news coverage.
mc_answer2_en: The organization is reducing its digital presence to concentrate on traditional television broadcasting.
mc_answer3_en: The organization plans to discontinue its English-language broadcasts to focus solely on international markets.
mc_answer4_en: The organization is expanding its reach to include non-English speaking audiences in Europe and Asia.
flores_passage: ଗତ ସପ୍ତାହରେ, ନାକେଡ୍ ନ୍ୟୁଜ୍ ଘୋଷଣା କରିଥିଲା ଯେ ଏହା ତିନୋଟି ନୂତନ ପ୍ରସାରଣ ସହିତ ଖବର ପରିବେଷଣରେ ଏହାର ଆନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ଭାଷାର ପରିସରକୁ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରିବ। ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଇଂରାଜୀ ଏବଂ ଜାପାନୀ ଭାଷାରେ ଖବର ପରିବେଷଣ କରୁଥିବା ଏହି ବିଶ୍ୱସ୍ତରୀୟ ସଂସ୍ଥା ଟେଲିଭିଜନ, ୱେବ୍ ଏବଂ ମୋବାଇଲ୍ ଉପକରଣ ପାଇଁ ସ୍ପାନିଶ୍, ଇଟାଲୀୟ ଏବଂ କୋରିଆନ୍ ଭାଷାର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରୁଛି।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ନାକେଡ୍ ନ୍ୟୁଜ୍‌ର ରଣନୀତିକ ଦିଗ ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷଟି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ଭାବରେ ସମର୍ଥିତ?
mc_answer1: ଏହି ସଂସ୍ଥା ଆନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ସମ୍ବାଦ ପ୍ରସାରଣ ତୁଳନାରେ ଘରୋଇ ସମ୍ବାଦ ପରିବେଷଣକୁ ଅଗ୍ରାଧିକାର ଦେଉଛି।
mc_answer2: ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ଟେଲିଭିଜନ ପ୍ରସାରଣ ଉପରେ ଧ୍ୟାନ କେନ୍ଦ୍ରୀଭୂତ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ସଂସ୍ଥାଟି ନିଜର ଡିଜିଟାଲ୍ ଉପସ୍ଥିତିକୁ ହ୍ରାସ କରୁଛି।
mc_answer3: କେବଳ ଆନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ବଜାର ଉପରେ ଧ୍ୟାନ ଦେବା ପାଇଁ ସଂସ୍ଥାଟି ଏହାର ଇଂରାଜୀ ଭାଷାର ପ୍ରସାରଣ ବନ୍ଦ କରିବାକୁ ଯୋଜନା କରୁଛି।
mc_answer4: ୟୁରୋପ ଏବଂ ଏସିଆର ଅଣ-ଇଂରାଜୀ ଭାଷାଭାଷୀ ଦର୍ଶକଙ୍କୁ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଏହି ସଂସ୍ଥା ଏହାର ପରିସରକୁ ବିସ୍ତାର କରୁଛି।

flores_passage_en: Cherry blossom viewing, known as hanami, has been a part of Japanese culture since the 8th century. The concept came from China where plum blossoms were the flower of choice. In Japan, the first cherry blossom parties were hosted by the emperor only for himself and other members of the aristocracy around the Imperial Court.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be inferred about the early history of cherry blossom viewing in Japan?
mc_answer1_en: It was initially restricted to the upper classes.
mc_answer2_en: It was practiced by commoners from the beginning.
mc_answer3_en: It originated in Japan rather than China.
mc_answer4_en: The emperor held the parties for the general public.
flores_passage: 'ହାନାମି' ନାମରେ ପରିଚିତ ଚେରୀ ଫୁଲ ଦେଖିବାର ପରମ୍ପରା ଅଷ୍ଟମ ଶତାବ୍ଦୀରୁ ଜାପାନୀ ସଂସ୍କୃତିର ଏକ ଅଂଶ ହୋଇ ରହିଆସିଛି। ଏହି ଧାରଣା ଚୀନରୁ ଆସିଥିଲା, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ପ୍ଲମ୍ ଫୁଲ ଲୋକଙ୍କର ପ୍ରଥମ ପସନ୍ଦ ଥିଲା। ଜାପାନରେ, ପ୍ରଥମ ଚେରୀ ଫୁଲ ଉତ୍ସବ ସମ୍ରାଟଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା କେବଳ ନିଜ ପାଇଁ ଏବଂ ରାଜଦରବାରର ଅନ୍ୟ ଅଭିଜାତ ସଦସ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଆୟୋଜିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: "Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau. These plateaus are often referred to as ""vidde"" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse. In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called ""hei"" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best describes the relationship between 'vidde' and the geographical features of Norway's plateaus?
mc_answer1_en: Vidde is synonymous with the steep cliffs that drop suddenly from the high plateaus.
mc_answer2_en: Vidde describes the treeless moorland covered in heather found in Rogaland and Agder.
mc_answer3_en: Vidde is a term used exclusively for the steep fjords and valleys found in coastal Norway.
mc_answer4_en: Vidde refers to a wide, open treeless space that characterizes the high plateaus in Norway.
flores_passage: ନରୱେର ଏକ ବିଶେଷତ୍ୱ ହେଉଛି ଖାଡ଼ା ଫ୍ଜୋର୍ଡ୍ ଏବଂ ଉପତ୍ୟକା, ଯାହା ହଠାତ୍ ଏକ ଉଚ୍ଚ, ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ସମତଳ ମାଳଭୂମିରେ ପରିଣତ ହୋଇଥାଏ। ଏହି ମାଳଭୂମିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ "vidde" ବୋଲି କୁହାଯାଏ, ଯାହାର ଅର୍ଥ ହେଉଛି ଏକ ପ୍ରଶସ୍ତ, ଖୋଲା ବୃକ୍ଷହୀନ ସ୍ଥାନ ବା ଏକ ଅସୀମ ବିସ୍ତାର। ରୋଗାଲାଣ୍ଡ ଏବଂ ଆଗଡରରେ ଏଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ସାଧାରଣତଃ "hei" କୁହାଯାଏ, ଯାହାର ଅର୍ଥ ହେଉଛି ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ହିଦର ଗୁଳ୍ମ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଆଚ୍ଛାଦିତ ଏକ ବୃକ୍ଷହୀନ ତୃଣଭୂମି।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି 'vidde' ଏବଂ ନରୱେର ମାଳଭୂମିର ଭୌଗୋଳିକ ବୈଶିଷ୍ଟ୍ୟ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ?
mc_answer1: Vidde ହେଉଛି ଉଚ୍ଚ ମାଳଭୂମିରୁ ହଠାତ୍ ତଳକୁ ଖସିଥିବା ଖାଡ଼ା ଚଟାଣ ସହିତ ସମାନାର୍ଥକ।
mc_answer2: Vidde ରୋଗାଲାଣ୍ଡ ଏବଂ ଆଗଡରରେ ଦେଖାଯାଉଥିବା ହିଦର ଆଚ୍ଛାଦିତ ବୃକ୍ଷହୀନ ତୃଣଭୂମିକୁ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ।
mc_answer3: Vidde ହେଉଛି ଏକ ଶବ୍ଦ ଯାହା କେବଳ ଉପକୂଳବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ନରୱେରେ ଥିବା ଖାଡ଼ା ଫ୍ଜୋର୍ଡ୍ ଏବଂ ଉପତ୍ୟକା ପାଇଁ ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର ଭାବରେ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୁଏ।
mc_answer4: Vidde ଏକ ପ୍ରଶସ୍ତ, ଖୋଲା ବୃକ୍ଷହୀନ ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ବୁଝାଏ ଯାହା ନରୱେର ଉଚ୍ଚ ମାଳଭୂମିଗୁଡ଼ିକର ବୈଶିଷ୍ଟ୍ୟ ଅଟେ।

flores_passage_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path. Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours. These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be inferred about the relationship between the duration of a tornado and its destructive potential?
mc_answer1_en: Tornadoes that last longer are likely to be more violent and cause greater destruction.
mc_answer2_en: The two percent of tornadoes that last over three hours are less dangerous than shorter storms.
mc_answer3_en: A tornado's wind speed is unrelated to how long it remains on the ground.
mc_answer4_en: Most tornadoes are more destructive than the violent two percent, but they last a shorter time.

flores_passage_en: "Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor . This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor. Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means ""western claw."""
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences about Hesperonychus elizabethae is most strongly supported by the evidence provided?
mc_answer1_en: It was fully feathered and warm-blooded, making it more similar to modern birds than to reptiles.
mc_answer2_en: Its name indicates a geographical origin related to the western region where fossils were found.
mc_answer3_en: It likely hunted smaller prey than Velociraptor due to its smaller size.
mc_answer4_en: The larger second claw suggests a specialized hunting adaptation similar to that of Velociraptor.

flores_passage_en: The Hershey and Chase experiment was one of the leading suggestions that DNA was a genetic material. Hershey and Chase used phages, or viruses, to implant their own DNA into a bacterium. They did two experiments marking either the DNA in the phage with a radioactive phosphorus or the protein of the phage with radioactive sulfur.
question_en: Based on the Hershey and Chase experiment described, which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported by the observation that radioactive phosphorus (DNA marker) was found inside the bacterium while radioactive sulfur (protein marker) was not?
mc_answer1_en: The phage protein is responsible for transmitting genetic information to the bacterium.
mc_answer2_en: DNA, not protein, serves as the genetic material that is transmitted during infection.
mc_answer3_en: Radioactive sulfur is a more reliable marker than radioactive phosphorus for tracking viral components.
mc_answer4_en: Both DNA and protein enter the bacterium to contribute equally to genetic inheritance.

flores_passage_en: A moderate earthquake shook western Montana at 10:08 p.m. on Monday. No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center. The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most logically supported by the information provided?
mc_answer1_en: There was a high probability of significant damage in Dillon.
mc_answer2_en: The USGS has not yet determined the exact location of the epicenter.
mc_answer3_en: Residents in Butte likely felt the earthquake due to its proximity.
mc_answer4_en: The earthquake's magnitude was insufficient to cause immediate damage.

flores_passage_en: Travellers may encounter animal pests that they are not familiar with in their home regions. Pests can spoil food, cause irritation, or in a worse case cause allergic reactions, spread venom, or transmit infections. Infectious diseases themselves, or dangerous animals that can injure or kill people by force, do not usually qualify as pests.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements best reflects a logical inference about how travellers should classify an animal that causes allergic reactions but does not transmit infections?
mc_answer1_en: It should be classified as an infectious disease because allergic reactions are a form of illness.
mc_answer2_en: It should be classified as a pest only if it is also capable of transmitting infections.
mc_answer3_en: It should not be classified as a pest because it does not spoil food.
mc_answer4_en: It should be classified as a pest because it poses a health risk beyond simple irritation.

flores_passage_en: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel. In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
question_en: According to the passage, what can be inferred about the relationship between geography and culture in Romanticism?
mc_answer1_en: Romanticism rejected the idea that geography influenced the formation of cultural norms.
mc_answer2_en: Writers like Goethe and Fichte argued that culture should be completely independent of geographical factors.
mc_answer3_en: Arbitrarily imposed laws are superior to customs because they ensure order and stability.
mc_answer4_en: Geography dictates the development of culture and customs that are naturally aligned with a society's needs.

flores_passage_en: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made. The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals. Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions best explains why a diagnosis of internal poisoning is difficult to make immediately?
mc_answer1_en: First aid instructions on labels are often too complex for immediate use.
mc_answer2_en: Internal poisoning always results in immediate death before symptoms appear.
mc_answer3_en: Symptoms such as vomiting are common to many conditions and do not uniquely identify poisoning.
mc_answer4_en: Open containers of medication are rarely found in households where poisoning occurs.

mc_answer4_en: He was the most famous ruler of the Joseon Dynasty.

flores_passage: ପ୍ରକୃତି-ଭିତ୍ତିକ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟଟନ ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରାଣୀ ବନ୍ୟଜୀବନ ସମେତ ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ଦୃଶ୍ୟକୁ ଉପଭୋଗ କରିବା ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟରେ ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ପରିଦର୍ଶନ କରିବାକୁ ଆଗ୍ରହୀ ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ଆକର୍ଷିତ କରିଥାଏ। ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପର ଉଦାହରଣ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଶିକାର, ମାଛ ଧରିବା, ଫଟୋଗ୍ରାଫି, ପକ୍ଷୀ ନିରୀକ୍ଷଣ, ଏବଂ ପାର୍କ ପରିଦର୍ଶନ ତଥା ପାରିବେଶିକ ତନ୍ତ୍ର ବିଷୟରେ ସୂଚନା ଅଧ୍ୟୟନ କରିବା ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ। ଏକ ଉଦାହରଣ ହେଉଛି ବୋର୍ଣ୍ଣିଓରେ ଓରାଙ୍ଗୁଟାନ୍ ପରିଦର୍ଶନ କରିବା, ଫଟୋ ଉଠାଇବା ଏବଂ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ବିଷୟରେ ଶିଖିବା।

flores_passage_en: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole. It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies. These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

mc_answer1_en: Fuel supplies are transported using nimble vehicles for efficiency.
mc_answer2_en: The route avoids the most direct path due to vehicle limitations.
mc_answer3_en: The trail follows the natural contours of the Transantarctic Mountains.
mc_answer4_en: Flags are placed every kilometer to guide tractors through crevasses.

flores_passage_en: "Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany. Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language. It was based on the German alphabet and one character ""Õ/õ"" was added. As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions about the development of the Estonian language is best supported?
mc_answer1_en: The Estonian language was created without any influence from the German alphabet.
mc_answer2_en: The coalescence of German words into Estonian occurred before the invention of the literal language.
mc_answer3_en: The German monks were primarily motivated by a desire to create a unique national identity for Estonia.
mc_answer4_en: The adoption of the Estonian literal language marked the start of a period of intellectual awakening in the region.

flores_passage: ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନର ସିନେଟର ତଥା ଆର୍ଜେଣ୍ଟିନାର ପ୍ରଥମ ମହିଳା (ଫାର୍ଷ୍ଟ ଲେଡି) କ୍ରିଷ୍ଟିନା ଫର୍ଣ୍ଣାଣ୍ଡେଜ୍ ଡି କିର୍ଚନର ଗତକାଲି ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାରେ ବୁଏନସ୍ ଏୟାର୍ସଠାରୁ ୫୦ କିଲୋମିଟର (୩୧ ମାଇଲ୍) ଦୂରରେ ଥିବା ଲା ପ୍ଲାଟା ସହରରେ ନିଜର ରାଷ୍ଟ୍ରପତି ପ୍ରାର୍ଥୀତ୍ୱ ଘୋଷଣା କରିଥିଲେ। ଶ୍ରୀମତୀ କିର୍ଚନର ଆର୍ଜେଣ୍ଟିନ୍ ଥିଏଟରରେ ରାଷ୍ଟ୍ରପତି ପଦ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରତିଦ୍ୱନ୍ଦ୍ୱିତା କରିବାକୁ ନିଜ ଇଚ୍ଛା ଘୋଷଣା କରିଥିଲେ, ଯେଉଁ ସମାନ ସ୍ଥାନକୁ ସେ ବୁଏନସ୍ ଏୟାର୍ସ ପ୍ରଦେଶ ପ୍ରତିନିଧି ଦଳର ସଦସ୍ୟ ଭାବରେ ସିନେଟ୍ ପାଇଁ ନିଜର ୨୦୦୫ ପ୍ରଚାର ଅଭିଯାନ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିଥିଲେ।

flores_passage_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes. Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth. The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins. The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions can be most reasonably drawn about a player who finishes a round of golf in the fewest strokes?
mc_answer1_en: This player has likely played on a shorter course than the standard eighteen-hole layout.
mc_answer2_en: This player has necessarily completed all holes on the green surface without leaving it.
mc_answer3_en: This player has probably used fewer clubs than the other competitors during the round.
mc_answer4_en: This player has demonstrated superior skill in navigating the course compared to others.

flores_passage_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism. Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room. If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls. Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope. They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences about Robert Hooke's observations is most logically supported by the description of the cells he observed?
mc_answer1_en: Hooke discovered that all living organisms are made of cells that function as small rooms.
mc_answer2_en: Hooke observed living cells because they appeared as small squares and balls.
mc_answer3_en: Hooke's microscope allowed him to see the functional aspects of living cells directly.

flores_passage_en: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches. The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest. Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements can be logically inferred about the role of human activity in avalanche occurrence?
mc_answer1_en: Human activity is the most frequent cause of avalanches compared to natural triggers.
mc_answer2_en: Human activity can act as one of several potential triggering events for avalanches.
mc_answer3_en: Avalanches would not occur without human intervention in any way.
mc_answer4_en: Natural events like sunlight and snowfall are less effective than humans in triggering avalanches.

flores_passage_en: The cities of Harappa and Mohenjo-daro had a flush toilet in almost every house, attached to a sophisticated sewage system. mc_answer1: ପ୍ରାଚୀନ ରୋମରେ ଶୌଚାଳୟ ସୁବିଧା କେବଳ ସର୍ବସାଧାରଣ ସ୍ଥାନ ପାଇଁ ଉଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots. Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry. A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.
question_en: Which of the following conclusions is most logically supported by the passage regarding the Assyrian cavalry's combat effectiveness despite the absence of saddles?
mc_answer1_en: Assyrian cavalrymen could fight on horseback without saddles because they had mastered advanced equestrian skills that compensated for the lack of equipment.
mc_answer2_en: The use of crossbows by the Assyrian cavalry allowed them to penetrate armor more effectively than infantry soldiers using spears.
mc_answer3_en: The bare backs of horses likely limited the riders' stability and range of movement, potentially reducing their effectiveness compared to later mounted forces.
mc_answer4_en: The invention of spoke wheels made chariots obsolete as a primary means of warfare by 1000 B.C.
flores_passage: ସ୍ପୋକ୍ ଥିବା ଚକର ଉଦ୍ଭାବନ ଆସିରୀୟ ରଥଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ହାଲୁକା, ଦ୍ରୁତଗାମୀ ଏବଂ ସୈନ୍ୟ ତଥା ଅନ୍ୟ ରଥଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପଛରେ ପକାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଅଧିକ ସମର୍ଥ କରିଥିଲା। ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଘାତକ ଧନୁତୀରରୁ ନିକ୍ଷେପ କରାଯାଉଥିବା ତୀର ଶତ୍ରୁ ସୈନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କ ବାହୁତ୍ରାଣକୁ ଭେଦ କରିପାରୁଥିଲା। ପ୍ରାୟ ଖ୍ରୀଷ୍ଟପୂର୍ବ ୧୦୦୦ ବେଳକୁ, ଆସିରୀୟମାନେ ପ୍ରଥମ ଅଶ୍ୱାରୋହୀ ବାହିନୀର ପ୍ରଚଳନ କରିଥିଲେ। ଅଶ୍ୱାରୋହୀ ବାହିନୀ ହେଉଛି ଏକ ସେନା ଯାହା ଘୋଡ଼ା ପିଠିରେ ବସି ଯୁଦ୍ଧ କରେ। ଜିନ୍ ସେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଉଦ୍ଭାବନ ହୋଇନଥିଲା, ତେଣୁ ଆସିରୀୟ ଅଶ୍ୱାରୋହୀମାନେ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଘୋଡ଼ାର ଖାଲି ପିଠିରେ ବସି ଯୁଦ୍ଧ କରୁଥିଲେ।
question: ଜିନ୍ ନ ଥାଇ ମଧ୍ୟ ଆସିରୀୟ ଅଶ୍ୱାରୋହୀ ବାହିନୀର ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ଦକ୍ଷତା ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତଟି ପରିଚ୍ଛେଦ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସବୁଠାରୁ ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ଭାବରେ ସମର୍ଥିତ?
mc_answer1: ଆସିରୀୟ ଅଶ୍ୱାରୋହୀମାନେ ଜିନ୍ ବିନା ଘୋଡ଼ା ପିଠିରେ ଯୁଦ୍ଧ କରିପାରୁଥିଲେ କାରଣ ସେମାନେ ଉନ୍ନତ ଅଶ୍ୱାରୋହଣ କୌଶଳରେ ଦକ୍ଷତା ହାସଲ କରିଥିଲେ ଯାହା ଉପକରଣର ଅଭାବକୁ ପୂରଣ କରିଥିଲା।
mc_answer2: ଆସିରୀୟ ଅଶ୍ୱାରୋହୀ ବାହିନୀ ଦ୍ୱାରା କ୍ରସବୋର ବ୍ୟବହାର ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ବର୍ଚ୍ଛା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରୁଥିବା ପଦାତିକ ସୈନ୍ୟଙ୍କ ତୁଳନାରେ ଅଧିକ ପ୍ରଭାବଶାଳୀ ଭାବରେ ବାହୁତ୍ରାଣ ଭେଦ କରିବାକୁ ଅନୁମତି ଦେଇଥିଲା।
mc_answer3: ଘୋଡ଼ାର ଖାଲି ପିଠି ସମ୍ଭବତଃ ଆରୋହୀମାନଙ୍କ ସ୍ଥିରତା ଏବଂ ଗତିବିଧିକୁ ସୀମିତ କରିଥିଲା, ଯାହା ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ କାଳର ଅଶ୍ୱାରୋହୀ ବାହିନୀ ତୁଳନାରେ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଭାବଶାଳୀତାକୁ ହ୍ରାସ କରିଥାଇପାରେ।
mc_answer4: ସ୍ପୋକ୍ ଥିବା ଚକର ଉଦ୍ଭାବନ ଖ୍ରୀଷ୍ଟପୂର୍ବ ୧୦୦୦ ସୁଦ୍ଧା ଯୁଦ୍ଧର ଏକ ପ୍ରାଥମିକ ମାଧ୍ୟମ ଭାବରେ ରଥକୁ ଅପ୍ରଚଳିତ କରିଦେଇଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: The issue started on January 1st when dozens of local residents started complaining to the Obanazawa Post Office that they hadn't received their traditional and regular New Year cards. Yesterday, the post office released their apology to citizens and the media after discovering that the boy had hidden more than 600 postal documents, including 429 New Year postcards, which weren't delivered to their intended recipients.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most logically supported regarding the cause of the undelivered New Year cards?
mc_answer1_en: The post office failed to process the cards due to a systemic error in their sorting system.
mc_answer2_en: A single individual's actions led to the retention and non-delivery of the cards.
mc_answer3_en: The residents' complaints were unfounded because the cards were never sent out in the first place.
mc_answer4_en: The New Year cards were intentionally withheld by the post office staff as a protest.

mc_answer1: ଡାକଘର ସେମାନଙ୍କ ବାଛିବା ପ୍ରଣାଳୀରେ (ସର୍ଟିଂ ସିଷ୍ଟମରେ) ଥିବା ଏକ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥାଗତ ତ୍ରୁଟି ଯୋଗୁଁ କାର୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକରଣ କରିବାରେ ବିଫଳ ହୋଇଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: "Felicia, once a Category 4 storm on the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Scale, weakened to a tropical depression before dissipating Tuesday. Its remnants produced showers across most of the islands, though as of yet, no damage or flooding has been reported. The precipitation, reaching 6.34 inches at a gauge on Oahu, was described as ""beneficial"". Some of the rainfall was accompanied by thunderstorms and frequent lightning."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported by the description of the rainfall as 'beneficial'?
mc_answer1_en: Oahu received less rainfall than the other islands.
mc_answer2_en: The thunderstorms caused minor property damage despite no flooding.
mc_answer3_en: Felicia has regained its status as a Category 4 storm.

question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be logically inferred about the relationship between photography and video recording regulations?

I lost my sister and her friend, and on my way there were two disabled people in wheelchairs, people just jumping over and pushing them,"" Armand Versace said."
question_en: Based on Armand Versace's testimony, which of the following statements best captures an underlying ethical implication of the crowd's behavior during the storm?
mc_answer1_en: The disabled people in wheelchairs were responsible for the chaos because they obstructed the path of fleeing pedestrians.
mc_answer2_en: The crowd's panic was primarily caused by the physical pain of the hail rather than fear for others' safety.
mc_answer3_en: The crowd's actions demonstrate a prioritization of individual survival over collective welfare, particularly in how they treated vulnerable individuals.
mc_answer4_en: Armand Versace likely exaggerated the severity of the weather to emphasize the tragedy of losing his sister.

flores_passage_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman. The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile. A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake. The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be logically inferred about a visitor planning to see Phnom Krom?
mc_answer1_en: They can visit the temple without purchasing an Angkor Pass if they bring a boat.
mc_answer2_en: They must ensure they have their passport with them.
mc_answer3_en: They will find the climb to the hilltop unnecessary due to the gloomy atmosphere.
mc_answer4_en: They should prioritize the boat trip over the temple visit for the best experience.

flores_passage_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees. The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking. The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges. Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is best supported by the evidence regarding the evolutionary shift in hominid hands?
mc_answer1_en: Fossil records indicate that hand specialization for manipulation occurred less than one million years ago.
mc_answer2_en: Knuckle walking is the ancestral trait shared by all modern primate species.
mc_answer3_en: Hominid hands evolved primarily to facilitate tool use rather than locomotion.
mc_answer4_en: The human hand is anatomically identical to the chimpanzee's hand in terms of phalange structure.

flores_passage_en: Subsistence agriculture is agriculture carried out for the production of enough food to meet just the needs of the agriculturalist and his/her family. Subsistence agriculture is a simple, often organic, system using saved seed native to the ecoregion combined with crop rotation or other relatively simple techniques to maximize yield. Historically most farmers were engaged in subsistence agriculture and this is still the case in many developing nations.
question_en: Which of the following inferences is most strongly supported by the passage regarding subsistence agriculture?
mc_answer1_en: It relies exclusively on modern industrial farming equipment.
mc_answer2_en: It prioritizes local ecological adaptation over high-volume commercial output.
mc_answer3_en: It requires the use of genetically modified seeds to ensure survival.
mc_answer4_en: It is primarily practiced in developed nations with advanced agricultural infrastructure.

flores_passage_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

mc_answer2_en: The British demonstrated superior tactical preparation and initiative early in the campaign.

mc_answer4_en: The British had planned to avoid direct confrontation with the Italian Tenth Army.

flores_passage_en: A study published on Thursday in the journal Science reported on formation of a new bird species on the Ecuadorean Galápagos Islands. question_en: According to the passage, what can be inferred about the previously held belief regarding the evolution of new bird species?
mc_answer1_en: It was assumed that the process had been completed in only one generation.
mc_answer2_en: It was thought that such evolution required significantly more time than two generations.
mc_answer3_en: It was believed that only Darwin finches could evolve into new species.
mc_answer4_en: It was thought that the evolution occurred without any breeding between species.

flores_passage: ସିନହୁଆ ରିପୋର୍ଟ କରିଛି ଯେ ସରକାରୀ ତଦନ୍ତକାରୀମାନେ ବୁଧବାର ଦିନ ଦୁଇଟି 'ବ୍ଲାକ୍ ବକ୍ସ' ଫ୍ଲାଇଟ୍ ରେକର୍ଡର ଉଦ୍ଧାର କରିଛନ୍ତି। ସାଥୀ ରେସଲରମାନେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଲୁନାଙ୍କୁ ଶ୍ରଦ୍ଧାଞ୍ଜଳି ଅର୍ପଣ କରିଛନ୍ତି। ଟମି ଡ୍ରିମର କହିଛନ୍ତି, "ଲୁନା ଏକ୍ସଟ୍ରିମର ପ୍ରଥମ ରାଣୀ ଥିଲେ। ମୋର ପ୍ରଥମ ମ୍ୟାନେଜର। ଲୁନା ଦୁଇଟି ଚନ୍ଦ୍ର ଥିବା ରାତିରେ ମୃତ୍ୟୁବରଣ କରିଥିଲେ। ତାଙ୍କ ଭଳି ହିଁ ବେଶ୍ ଅନନ୍ୟ। ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ ମହିଳା।" ଡଷ୍ଟିନ୍ "ଗୋଲ୍ଡଷ୍ଟ" ରନେଲ୍ସ ମନ୍ତବ୍ୟ ଦେଇଛନ୍ତି ଯେ, "ଲୁନା ମୋ ଭଳି ହିଁ ଅଜବ ଥିଲେ... ବୋଧହୁଏ ମୋଠାରୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅଧିକ... ତାଙ୍କୁ ଭଲ ପାଏ ଏବଂ ତାଙ୍କୁ ମନେ ପକାଇବି... ଆଶା କରୁଛି ସେ ଏକ ଭଲ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଥିବେ।"
question: ଟମି ଡ୍ରିମର ଏବଂ ଡଷ୍ଟିନ 'ଗୋଲ୍ଡଷ୍ଟ' ରନେଲ୍ସଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପ୍ରଦତ୍ତ ଶ୍ରଦ୍ଧାଞ୍ଜଳି ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ପ୍ରୋଫେସନାଲ୍ ରେସଲିଂ ଉପରେ ଲୁନାଙ୍କ ପ୍ରଭାବ ବିଷୟରେ ଏକ ଅନୁମାନିତ ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷକୁ ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ପ୍ରତିନିଧିତ୍ୱ କରେ?
mc_answer1: ତାଙ୍କ ସାଥୀମାନେ ତାଙ୍କୁ ଏକ ଅଣପାରମ୍ପରିକ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରଭାବଶାଳୀ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିତ୍ୱ ଭାବରେ ଦେଖୁଥିଲେ ଯିଏ ରେସଲିଂ ଇଣ୍ଡଷ୍ଟ୍ରିର ପ୍ରଚଳିତ ନିୟମକୁ ଚ୍ୟାଲେଞ୍ଜ କରିଥିଲେ।
mc_answer2: ଏହି ଶ୍ରଦ୍ଧାଞ୍ଜଳିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସୂଚାଉଛି ଯେ ଅନ୍ୟ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନକାରୀଙ୍କ ସହିତ ଲୁନାଙ୍କ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ତୁଳନାରେ ତାଙ୍କ ରେସଲିଂ ଶୈଳୀ କମ୍ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଥିଲା।
mc_answer3: ଲୁନାଙ୍କ ଉତ୍ତରାଧିକାର ତାଙ୍କ ପରିଚାଳନାଗତ ଅବଦାନ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ତାଙ୍କର ବିବାଦୀୟ ସାର୍ବଜନୀନ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିତ୍ୱ ଦ୍ୱାରା ପରିଭାଷିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା।
mc_answer4: ଲୁନାଙ୍କ କ୍ୟାରିଅର୍ ତାଙ୍କ ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସ୍ୱୀକୃତିର ଅଭାବ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଚିହ୍ନିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା, ଯେତେବେଳେ ତାଙ୍କୁ ଆନୁଷ୍ଠାନିକ ଭାବରେ ହଲ୍ ଅଫ୍ ଫେମରେ ସାମିଲ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: According to the latest bulletin, sea level readings indicated a tsunami was generated. There was some definite tsunami activity recorded near Pago Pago and Niue. No major damage or injuries have been reported in Tonga, but power was temporarily lost, which reportedly prevented Tongan authorities from receiving the tsunami warning issued by the PTWC. Fourteen schools in Hawaii located on or near coastlines were closed all of Wednesday despite the warnings being lifted.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is best supported regarding the impact of the tsunami warning system on the affected regions?
mc_answer1_en: The warning system failed entirely in all affected areas due to power outages.
mc_answer2_en: Tonga experienced major damage despite the warnings being issued.
mc_answer3_en: Tongan authorities were unable to receive the warning due to temporary power loss.
mc_answer4_en: Hawaii schools remained closed because the warnings were not lifted in time.

flores_passage_en: Ocelots like to eat small animals. They will catch monkeys, snakes, rodents and birds if they can. Almost all of the animals that the ocelot hunts are far smaller than it is. Scientists think that ocelots follow and find animals to eat (prey) by smell, sniffing for where they've been on the ground. They can see very well in the dark with night vision, and move very stealthily, too. Ocelots hunt their prey by blending in with their surroundings then pouncing on their prey.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements best explains why ocelots are successful hunters despite their prey being far smaller than them?
mc_answer1_en: Ocelots hunt in large packs to overpower smaller animals through numbers.
mc_answer2_en: Ocelots use a combination of stealth, night vision, and camouflage to overcome the size disadvantage of their prey.
mc_answer3_en: Ocelots prefer to eat animals that are the same size as themselves to ensure an easy catch.
mc_answer4_en: Ocelots rely primarily on their ability to fly to surprise their prey from above.

flores_passage_en: Gothic style peaked in the period between the 10th - 11th centuries and the 14th century. At the beginning dress was heavily influenced by the Byzantine culture in the east. However, due to the slow communication channels, styles in the west could lag behind by 25 to 30 year. towards the end of the Middle Ages western Europe began to develop their own style. one of the biggest developments of the time as a result of the crusades people began to use buttons to fasten clothing.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences about the adoption of buttons in Western European clothing is most logically supported?
mc_answer1_en: Buttons were adopted in the East before they were used in the West due to cultural exchange.
mc_answer2_en: The Crusades introduced buttons to Western Europe, leading to a stylistic shift independent of earlier Byzantine influences.

flores_passage_en: The war expenditures of U.S. imperialism in the conquest of the Philippines were paid for by the Filipino people themselves. They were compelled to pay taxes to the U.S. colonial regime to defray a major part of the expenditures and the interest on bonds floated in the name of the Philippine government through the Wall Street banking houses. Of course, the superprofits derived from the protracted exploitation of the Filipino people would constitute the basic gains of U.S. imperialism.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences about the economic relationship between the U.S. and the Philippines during the colonial period is best supported?
mc_answer1_en: The exploitation of the Philippines was solely aimed at acquiring territory, with no financial gains or profits derived from the colony.
mc_answer2_en: The Filipino population bore a significant portion of the financial burden of U.S. imperial expansion through forced taxation and bond interest payments.
mc_answer3_en: Wall Street banking houses independently financed the war without any involvement from the colonial government or Filipino taxpayers.
mc_answer4_en: The U.S. military expenditures were primarily funded by American taxpayers, with Filipino taxes covering only minor administrative costs.

flores_passage_en: Red tide is caused by a higher than normal concentration of Karenia brevis, a naturally-occurring single-celled marine organism. Natural factors can intersect to produce ideal conditions, allowing this algae to increase in number dramatically. The algae produces a neurotoxin that can disable nerves in both humans and fish. Fish often die because of the high concentrations of the toxin in the waters. Humans can be affected by breathing affected water taken into the air by wind and waves.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions can be most reasonably inferred about the impact of red tide on marine ecosystems?
mc_answer1_en: Red tide events are solely the result of human activity and pollution.
mc_answer2_en: The neurotoxin produced by Karenia brevis poses a direct threat to both aquatic life and human respiratory health.
mc_answer3_en: Fish deaths during red tide are primarily caused by lack of oxygen rather than toxin concentration.
mc_answer4_en: Humans are immune to red tide effects because the toxin only affects marine organisms.

flores_passage_en: The Babylonians built each of their gods a primary temple that was considered the home of the god. People would bring sacrifices to the gods and the priests would try to attend to the needs of the gods through ceremonies and festivals. Each temple had an open temple courtyard and then an inner sanctuary that only the priests could enter. Sometimes special pyramid shaped towers, called ziggurats, were built to be a part of the temples. The top of the tower was special sanctuary for the god.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences about the relationship between the Babylonian gods and their temples is most strongly supported?
mc_answer1_en: Sacrifices were offered exclusively at the top of the ziggurats, never in the temple courtyards.
mc_answer2_en: The open courtyards were designed to allow the general public to enter the sacred inner sanctuary of the temple.
mc_answer3_en: The ziggurats were constructed primarily as residential towers for the priests who served the gods.
mc_answer4_en: The temples served as exclusive domains where only priests had direct access to the innermost sanctuaries of the gods.

flores_passage_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey. Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature. Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences about Greek culture is most strongly supported?
mc_answer1_en: Greek culture was primarily focused on scientific and mathematical achievements rather than artistic expression.
mc_answer2_en: Greek contributions span multiple disciplines, including literature, drama, and mathematics, indicating a broad cultural influence.
mc_answer3_en: Pythagoras was more famous than Homer because his theorem is used more frequently in modern education.
mc_answer4_en: Homer was the only Greek figure whose works have survived to the present day.

flores_passage_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan. Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public. For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides. This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan. Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.
question_en: Based on the passage, what can be inferred about the relationship between DVD manufacturers and television design standards when subtitles are present in a movie?
mc_answer1_en: DVD manufacturers prioritize subtitle visibility over the visual integrity of the film's border.
mc_answer2_en: Television design standards for overscan necessitate that subtitle placement must account for potential border cropping on home viewing devices.
mc_answer3_en: Subtitles are typically placed so far from the bottom of the screen that overscan never affects their visibility.
mc_answer4_en: The problem of overscan is exclusively a result of poor DVD mastering techniques rather than television hardware limitations.

flores_passage_en: This is believed to be the fifth time in history that people have observed what turned out to be chemically confirmed martian material falling to Earth. Out of the approximately 24,000 known meteorites to have fallen to Earth, only about 34 have been verified to be martian in origin. Fifteen of these rocks are attributed to the meteorite shower last July. Some of the rocks, which are very rare on Earth, are being sold from US$11,000 to $22,500 per ounce, which is about ten times more than the cost of gold.

flores_passage_en: "The ""up bow"" mark looks like a V and the ""down bow mark"" like a staple or a square missing its bottom side. Up means you should start at the tip and push the bow, and down means you should start at the frog (which is where your hand is holding the bow) and pull the bow. An up-bow usually generates a softer sound, while a down-bow is stronger and more assertive. Feel free to pencil in your own marks, but remember the printed bowing marks are there for a musical reason, so they should usually be respected."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be inferred about the relationship between bowing direction and musical expression?

mc_answer2_en: The choice of up-bow or down-bow is influenced by the desired dynamic and expressive quality of the note.

flores_passage: "ଉପର ଧନୁ" (ଅପ୍ ବୋ) ଚିହ୍ନଟି ଏକ V ପରି ଦେଖାଯାଏ ଏବଂ "ତଳ ଧନୁ ଚିହ୍ନ" (ଡାଉନ୍ ବୋ) ଏକ ଷ୍ଟାପଲ୍ କିମ୍ବା ତଳ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱ ନଥିବା ଏକ ବର୍ଗକ୍ଷେତ୍ର ପରି ଦେଖାଯାଏ। ଉପର ଅର୍ଥ ହେଉଛି ଆପଣ ଅଗ୍ରଭାଗରୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ଧନୁକୁ ଠେଲିବା ଉଚିତ, ଏବଂ ତଳ ଅର୍ଥ ହେଉଛି ଆପଣ ଫ୍ରଗ୍‌ରୁ (ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ହାତ ଧନୁକୁ ଧରିଥାଏ) ଆରମ୍ଭ କରି ଧନୁକୁ ଟାଣିବା ଉଚିତ। ଏକ ଉପର-ଧନୁ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ଏକ କୋମଳ ଧ୍ୱନି ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ, ଯେତେବେଳେ କି ଏକ ତଳ-ଧନୁ ଅଧିକ ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ ଏବଂ ଦୃଢ଼ ହୋଇଥାଏ। ଆପଣ ନିଜେ ପେନ୍ସିଲ୍‌ରେ ନିଜର ଚିହ୍ନ ଦେଇପାରିବେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ମନେରଖନ୍ତୁ ଯେ ମୁଦ୍ରିତ ଧନୁ ଚିହ୍ନଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଏକ ସାଙ୍ଗୀତିକ କାରଣରୁ ରହିଛି, ତେଣୁ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ଅନୁସରଣ କରାଯିବା ଉଚିତ।

flores_passage_en: NHK also reported that the Kashiwazaki Kariwa nuclear power plant in Niigata prefecture was operating normally. Hokuriku Electric Power Co. reported no effects from the earthquake and that the Number 1 and 2 reactors at its Shika nuclear power plant were shut down. It is reported that some 9400 homes in the region are without water and approximately 100 without electricity. Some roads have been damaged, railway service interrupted in the affected areas, and the Noto Airport in Ishikawa prefecture remains closed.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most logically supported by the reported conditions?
mc_answer1_en: The earthquake caused widespread destruction of residential areas across multiple prefectures.
mc_answer2_en: All transportation networks in Ishikawa and Niigata prefectures have been completely severed.
mc_answer3_en: Nuclear power plants in the region are experiencing critical failures requiring immediate evacuation.
mc_answer4_en: The earthquake's impact has been localized to infrastructure and utilities rather than nuclear safety.
flores_passage: ଏନଏଚକେ (NHK) ମଧ୍ୟ ରିପୋର୍ଟ କରିଛି ଯେ ନିଗାତା ପ୍ରିଫେକ୍ଚରରେ ଥିବା କାଶିୱାଜାକି କାରିୱା ପରମାଣୁ ଶକ୍ତି କେନ୍ଦ୍ର ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରୁଥିଲା। ହୋକୁରିକୁ ଇଲେକ୍ଟ୍ରିକ୍ ପାୱାର କୋ. ଭୂକମ୍ପର କୌଣସି ପ୍ରଭାବ ପଡ଼ିନଥିବା ଏବଂ ଏହାର ଶିକା ପରମାଣୁ ଶକ୍ତି କେନ୍ଦ୍ରର ୧ ଏବଂ ୨ ନମ୍ବର ରିଆକ୍ଟର ବନ୍ଦ ଥିବା ସୂଚନା ଦେଇଛି। ସୂଚନା ଅନୁସାରେ ଏହି ଅଞ୍ଚଳର ପ୍ରାୟ ୯୪୦୦ ଘରେ ପାଣି ନାହିଁ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରାୟ ୧୦୦ ଘରେ ବିଦ୍ୟୁତ୍ ନାହିଁ। କେତେକ ରାସ୍ତା କ୍ଷତିଗ୍ରସ୍ତ ହୋଇଛି, ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ରେଳ ସେବା ବାଧାପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ହୋଇଛି ଏବଂ ଇଶିକାୱା ପ୍ରିଫେକ୍ଚରର ନୋଟୋ ବିମାନବନ୍ଦର ବନ୍ଦ ରହିଛି।

flores_passage_en: For some festivals, the vast majority of the attendants to music festivals decide to camp on site, and most attendants consider it a vital part of the experience. If you want to be close to the action you're going to have to get in early to get a camping site close to the music. Remember that even though music on the main stages may have finished, there may be sections of the festival that will keep playing music until late into the night. Some festivals have special camping areas for families with young children.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be reasonably inferred about a festival-goer who prioritizes being close to the main stages?
mc_answer1_en: They will likely miss late-night music if they camp far away.
mc_answer2_en: They are guaranteed access to special family camping areas.
mc_answer3_en: They can rely on the main stages playing music throughout the night.
mc_answer4_en: They should arrive early to secure a camping spot near the action.
flores_passage: କେତେକ ଉତ୍ସବ ପାଇଁ, ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ମହୋତ୍ସବରେ ଯୋଗ ଦେଉଥିବା ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଲୋକ ଉତ୍ସବ ସ୍ଥଳରେ ହିଁ କ୍ୟାମ୍ପ କରିବାକୁ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନିଅନ୍ତି, ଏବଂ ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଉପସ୍ଥିତ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଏହାକୁ ଏହି ଅନୁଭୂତିର ଏକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଅଂଶ ବୋଲି ମନେ କରନ୍ତି। ଯଦି ଆପଣ ମୁଖ୍ୟ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମର ନିକଟତର ହେବାକୁ ଚାହାଁନ୍ତି, ତେବେ ସଙ୍ଗୀତର ପାଖାପାଖି ଏକ କ୍ୟାମ୍ପିଂ ସ୍ଥାନ ପାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ଶୀଘ୍ର ପହଞ୍ଚିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ। ମନେରଖନ୍ତୁ ଯେ ଯଦିଓ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ମଞ୍ଚଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ଶେଷ ହୋଇଯାଇପାରେ, ତଥାପି ଉତ୍ସବର କିଛି ଭାଗ ଏପରି ଥାଇପାରେ ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ବିଳମ୍ବିତ ରାତି ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ବାଜୁଥିବ। କେତେକ ଉତ୍ସବରେ ଛୋଟ ପିଲା ଥିବା ପରିବାରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର କ୍ୟାମ୍ପିଂ ସ୍ଥାନ ରହିଥାଏ।

flores_passage_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand. Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years. We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past. Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events. You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best describes how the author implies we gain a deeper understanding of time?
mc_answer1_en: By measuring the exact duration of every event that occurs
mc_answer2_en: By observing the repetition of cyclical events in our daily lives
mc_answer3_en: By ignoring the differences between the future, present, and past
mc_answer4_en: By memorizing the definitions provided by religious and scientific scholars

flores_passage_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria. They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List. Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea. Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be inferred about the accessibility of the Cinque Terre villages?
mc_answer1_en: The villages are isolated from external vehicle traffic due to specific transportation constraints.
mc_answer2_en: The villages are primarily accessible by car, with limited train and boat options.
mc_answer3_en: The terraces built on the landscape were designed to allow cars to drive directly to the cliffs.
mc_answer4_en: The villages have been developed with modern infrastructure to accommodate large-scale tourism.
flores_passage: ସିଙ୍କେ ଟେରେ (Cinque Terre), ଯାହାର ଅର୍ଥ ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ଭୂମି, ଇଟାଲୀର ଲିଗୁରିଆ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଅବସ୍ଥିତ ରିଓମାଗିଓରେ, ମାନାରୋଲା, କୋର୍ନିଗ୍ଲିଆ, ଭର୍ଣ୍ଣାଜା ଏବଂ ମୋଣ୍ଟେରୋସୋର ପାଞ୍ଚଟି ଛୋଟ ଉପକୂଳବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ଗ୍ରାମକୁ ନେଇ ଗଠିତ। ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ୟୁନେସ୍କୋ ବିଶ୍ୱ ଐତିହ୍ୟ ତାଲିକାରେ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ। ଶତାବ୍ଦୀ ଧରି, ଲୋକମାନେ ସମୁଦ୍ର ମୁହାଁ ଖାଲଖମା, ଢାଲୁଆ ଭୂମି ଉପରେ ପାହାଡ଼ର ଢାଲୁ ଧାର ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଯତ୍ନର ସହ ପାହାଚିଆ ଚଟାଣ (ଟେରେସ୍) ନିର୍ମାଣ କରିଛନ୍ତି। କୌଣସି ଦୃଶ୍ୟମାନ କର୍ପୋରେଟ୍ ବିକାଶ ନ ରହିବା ଏହାର ଆକର୍ଷଣର ଏକ ଅଂଶ। ଚଲାପଥ, ଟ୍ରେନ୍ ଏବଂ ଡଙ୍ଗା ଏହି ଗ୍ରାମଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ସଂଯୋଗ କରେ ଏବଂ ବାହାରୁ କାରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଏଠାକୁ ପହଞ୍ଚିପାରିବ ନାହିଁ।

flores_passage_en: The East African Islands are in the Indian Ocean off the eastern coast of Africa. Madagascar is by far the biggest, and a continent on its own when it comes to wildlife. Most of the smaller islands are independent nations, or associated with France, and known as luxury beach resorts. The Arabs also brought Islam to the lands, and it took in a big way in the Comoros and Mayotte. European influence and colonialism began in the 15th century, as Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama found the Cape Route from Europe to India.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be reasonably inferred about the cultural and political landscape of the East African Islands?
mc_answer1_en: Vasco da Gama's discovery of the Cape Route was primarily aimed at expanding European colonialism.
mc_answer2_en: The smaller islands have retained a mix of European, Arab, and local influences in their development.
mc_answer3_en: Islam is the dominant religion on all islands in the region due to early Arab influence.
mc_answer4_en: Madagascar is politically dependent on France despite its large size and unique wildlife.

flores_passage_en: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole. Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea. A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter. Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice. Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.
question_en: Based on the passage, which conclusion can be reasonably inferred about the feasibility of inland tourism in Antarctica?
mc_answer1_en: It is widely available due to the presence of a large base at the Pole.
mc_answer2_en: It is primarily conducted via sea vessels traveling through the Ross Sea.
mc_answer3_en: It is restricted to occasional specialist air tours rather than regular tourist visits.

flores_passage_en: German pastries are quite good, and in Bavaria, are quite rich and varied, similar to those of their southern neighbor, Austria. Fruit pastries are common, with apples cooked into pastries year round, and cherries and plums making their appearances during the summer. Many German baked goods also feature almonds, hazelnuts, and other tree nuts. Popular cakes often pair particularly well with a cup of strong coffee. If you want some small though rich pastries, try what depending on region are called Berliner, Pfannkuchen or Krapfen.

mc_answer1_en: They are primarily made using seasonal fruits.

mc_answer4_en: They are more varied in Bavaria than in other regions.

flores_passage_en: Both golf and rugby are set to return to the Olympic Games. The International Olympic Committee voted to include the sports at its executive board meeting in Berlin today. Rugby, specifically rugby union, and golf were selected over five other sports to be considered to participate in the Olympics. Squash, karate and roller sports tried to get onto the Olympic program as well as baseball and softball, which were voted out of the Olympic Games in 2005. The vote must still be ratified by the full IOC at it's October meeting in Copenhagen.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements can be logically inferred about the inclusion of golf and rugby in the Olympic Games?
mc_answer1_en: The IOC's executive board has the final authority to decide which sports are included in the Olympics.
mc_answer2_en: The full IOC's ratification is a necessary procedural step before the sports' inclusion becomes official.
mc_answer3_en: Squash, karate, and roller sports were rejected because they were less popular than golf and rugby.
mc_answer4_en: Baseball and softball were permanently removed from the Olympic Games following the 2005 vote.

flores_passage_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries. Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations. It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours. Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most logically supported regarding the decision-making process of a traveler considering a travel agent?
mc_answer1_en: A traveler should avoid travel agents altogether and book directly to ensure the lowest possible cost.
mc_answer2_en: A traveler should always choose the agency that has been in operation the longest.
mc_answer3_en: A traveler should prioritize agents with experience in similar itineraries over generalists for unfamiliar destinations.
mc_answer4_en: A traveler should select an agent based solely on the visual appeal of their shop window or website.
flores_passage: ୧୯ଶ ଶତାବ୍ଦୀରୁ ଟ୍ରାଭେଲ୍ ଏଜେନ୍ସିଗୁଡ଼ିକ ରହିଆସିଛି। ପ୍ରକୃତି, ସଂସ୍କୃତି, ଭାଷା କିମ୍ବା ସ୍ୱଳ୍ପ ଆୟକାରୀ ଦେଶ ବିଷୟରେ ଜଣେ ଯାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ପୂର୍ବ ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତାର ପରିସର ବାହାରେ ଥିବା ଯାତ୍ରା ପାଇଁ ଜଣେ ଟ୍ରାଭେଲ୍ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ଏକ ଭଲ ବିକଳ୍ପ ଅଟନ୍ତି। ଯଦିଓ ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଏଜେନ୍ସି ନିୟମିତ ବୁକିଂ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରିବାକୁ ଇଚ୍ଛୁକ ଥାଆନ୍ତି, ତଥାପି ଅନେକ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ଧରଣର ଭ୍ରମଣ, ବଜେଟ୍ ସୀମା କିମ୍ବା ଗନ୍ତବ୍ୟସ୍ଥଳରେ ବିଶେଷଜ୍ଞତା ହାସଲ କରିଥାଆନ୍ତି। ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଯାତ୍ରା ପରି ସମାନ ଯାତ୍ରା ବାରମ୍ବାର ବୁକ୍ କରୁଥିବା ଜଣେ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟଙ୍କ ସହାୟତା ନେବା ଅଧିକ ଭଲ ହୋଇପାରେ। ଏଜେଣ୍ଟ କେଉଁ ସବୁ ଯାତ୍ରାକୁ ପ୍ରୋତ୍ସାହିତ କରୁଛନ୍ତି, ତାହା ୱେବସାଇଟ୍‌ରେ ହେଉ ବା ଦୋକାନ ଝରକାରେ ହେଉ, ତାହା ଉପରେ ଟିକେ ନଜର ପକାନ୍ତୁ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଆଧାରରେ, ଜଣେ ଟ୍ରାଭେଲ୍ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟଙ୍କ ବିଷୟରେ ବିଚାର କରୁଥିବା ଯାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ଗ୍ରହଣ ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟା ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷଟି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ଭାବରେ ସମର୍ଥିତ?
mc_answer1: ଜଣେ ଯାତ୍ରୀ ଟ୍ରାଭେଲ୍ ଏଜେଣ୍ଟମାନଙ୍କୁ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବେ ଏଡ଼ାଇବା ଉଚିତ ଏବଂ ଯଥାସମ୍ଭବ କମ୍ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ସୁନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ସିଧାସଳଖ ବୁକ୍ କରିବା ଉଚିତ।
mc_answer2: ଜଣେ ଯାତ୍ରୀ ସର୍ବଦା ସେହି ଏଜେନ୍ସିକୁ ବାଛିବା ଉଚିତ ଯାହା ସବୁଠାରୁ ଦୀର୍ଘ ସମୟ ଧରି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିଆସୁଛି।

flores_passage_en: The capital of Moldova is Chişinău. The local language is Romanian, but Russian is widely used. Moldova is a multi-ethnic republic that has suffered from ethnic conflict. In 1994, this conflict led to the creation of the self-proclaimed Transnistria Republic in eastern Moldova, which has its own government and currency but is not recognised by any UN member country. Economic links have been re-established between these two parts of Moldova despite the failure in political negotiations. The major religion in Moldova is Orthodox Christian.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be reasonably inferred about the relationship between the political status of Transnistria and its economic interactions with the rest of Moldova?
mc_answer1_en: Transnistria's economic links with Moldova are sustained despite its lack of international recognition.
mc_answer2_en: Russian is the official language of Transnistria due to its separation from Moldova.
mc_answer3_en: The failure of political negotiations has prevented any economic cooperation between Transnistria and Moldova.
mc_answer4_en: Moldova's Orthodox Christian majority has influenced the currency used in Transnistria.
flores_passage: ମୋଲଡୋଭାର ରାଜଧାନୀ ହେଉଛି ଚିସିନାଉ । ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ଭାଷା ହେଉଛି ରୋମାନିଆନ୍, କିନ୍ତୁ ରୁଷିଆନ୍ ବହୁଳ ଭାବରେ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୁଏ । ମୋଲଡୋଭା ଏକ ବହୁ-ଜାତିଗତ ଗଣରାଜ୍ୟ ଯାହା ଜାତିଗତ ସଂଘର୍ଷରେ ପୀଡ଼ିତ ହୋଇଛି । ୧୯୯୪ ରେ, ଏହି ସଂଘର୍ଷ ପୂର୍ବ ମୋଲଡୋଭାରେ ସ୍ୱୟଂ-ଘୋଷିତ ଟ୍ରାନ୍ସନିଷ୍ଟ୍ରିଆ ଗଣରାଜ୍ୟର ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରାଇଥିଲା, ଯାହାର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ସରକାର ଏବଂ ମୁଦ୍ରା ଅଛି କିନ୍ତୁ ଜାତିସଂଘର କୌଣସି ସଦସ୍ୟ ଦେଶ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସ୍ୱୀକୃତିପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ନୁହେଁ । ରାଜନୈତିକ ଆଲୋଚନାରେ ବିଫଳତା ସତ୍ତ୍ୱେ ମୋଲଡୋଭାର ଏହି ଦୁଇ ଅଂଶ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଅର୍ଥନୈତିକ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ପୁନଃସ୍ଥାପିତ ହୋଇଛି । ମୋଲଡୋଭାର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଧର୍ମ ହେଉଛି ଅର୍ଥୋଡକ୍ସ ଖ୍ରୀଷ୍ଟିଆନ ।

flores_passage_en: The games kicked off at 10:00am with great weather and apart from mid morning drizzle which quickly cleared up, it was a perfect day for 7's rugby. Tournament top seeds South Africa started on the right note when they had a comfortable 26 - 00 win against 5th seeded Zambia. Looking decidedly rusty in the game against their southern sisters, South Africa however steadily improved as the tournament progressed. Their disciplined defence, ball handling skills and excellent team work made them stand out and it was clear that this was the team to beat.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why South Africa was considered 'the team to beat'?
mc_answer1_en: The weather conditions were perfect for all of their matches.
mc_answer2_en: Their performance improved over time and their skills were outstanding.
mc_answer3_en: They played against the strongest teams in the tournament.
mc_answer4_en: They won every match without conceding a single point.
flores_passage: ଉତ୍ତମ ପାଗ ସହିତ ସକାଳ ୧୦:୦୦ ଟାରେ ଖେଳ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥିଲା ଏବଂ ମଧ୍ୟାହ୍ନ ପୂର୍ବର ହାଲୁକା ବର୍ଷାକୁ ଛାଡ଼ିଦେଲେ ଯାହା ତୁରନ୍ତ ଛାଡ଼ି ଯାଇଥିଲା, ଏହା ୭'ସ୍ ରଗବି ପାଇଁ ଏକ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ଦିନ ଥିଲା। ଟୁର୍ଣ୍ଣାମେଣ୍ଟର ଶୀର୍ଷ ମାନ୍ୟତାପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ଦକ୍ଷିଣ ଆଫ୍ରିକା ୫ମ ମାନ୍ୟତାପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ଜାମ୍ବିଆ ବିପକ୍ଷରେ ୨୬ - ୦୦ ରେ ଏକ ସହଜ ବିଜୟ ସହିତ ଭଲ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିଥିଲା। ସେମାନଙ୍କର ଦକ୍ଷିଣ ଭଉଣୀମାନଙ୍କ ବିପକ୍ଷ ଖେଳରେ କିଛିଟା ଅପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ ଦେଖାଯାଉଥିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ, ଟୁର୍ଣ୍ଣାମେଣ୍ଟ ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ିବା ସହିତ ଦକ୍ଷିଣ ଆଫ୍ରିକା କ୍ରମାଗତ ଭାବରେ ଉନ୍ନତି କରିଥିଲା। ସେମାନଙ୍କର ଶୃଙ୍ଖଳିତ ପ୍ରତିରକ୍ଷା, ବଲ୍ ପରିଚାଳନା କୌଶଳ ଏବଂ ଉତ୍କୃଷ୍ଟ ଦଳଗତ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର କରିଥିଲା ଏବଂ ଏହା ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ହୋଇଯାଇଥିଲା ଯେ ଏହା ହିଁ ପରାସ୍ତ କରିବାକୁ ଥିବା ପ୍ରମୁଖ ଦଳ ଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: Anyone who's going to drive at high latitudes or over mountain passes should consider the possibility of snow, ice, or freezing temperatures. On icy and snowy roadways, friction is low and you cannot drive as if you were on bare asphalt. During blizzards, enough snow to get you stuck can fall in very little time. Visibility may also be restricted by falling or blowing snow or by condensation or ice on vehicle windows. On the other hand, icy and snowy conditions are normal in many countries, and traffic goes on mostly uninterrupted all year round.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be logically inferred about driving in countries where icy and snowy conditions are common?
mc_answer1_en: Blizzards are rare occurrences that only affect high latitudes and mountain passes.
mc_answer2_en: Road maintenance crews are primarily responsible for ensuring uninterrupted traffic flow.

flores_passage: ଉଚ୍ଚ ଅକ୍ଷାଂଶରେ କିମ୍ବା ପାର୍ବତ୍ୟ ଘାଟିରେ ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳାଇବାକୁ ଯାଉଥିବା ଯେକୌଣସି ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ତୁଷାର, ବରଫ କିମ୍ବା ଜମାଟ ବାନ୍ଧିବା ଭଳି ଥଣ୍ଡା ତାପମାତ୍ରାର ସମ୍ଭାବନାକୁ ବିଚାର କରିବା ଉଚିତ। ବରଫାଚ୍ଛାଦିତ ଏବଂ ତୁଷାରପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଘର୍ଷଣ କମ୍ ଥାଏ ଏବଂ ଆପଣ ସାଧାରଣ ପିଚୁ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଚଲାଇବା ଭଳି ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳାଇ ପାରିବେ ନାହିଁ। ତୁଷାର ଝଡ଼ ସମୟରେ, ଆପଣ ଫସିଯିବା ପାଇଁ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ତୁଷାର ଖୁବ୍ କମ୍ ସମୟ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ପଡ଼ିପାରେ। ତୁଷାରପାତ କିମ୍ବା ପବନରେ ଉଡୁଥିବା ତୁଷାର, ଅଥବା ଗାଡ଼ିର କାଚ ଉପରେ ଜମୁଥିବା ବାଷ୍ପ ବା ବରଫ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଦୃଶ୍ୟମାନତା ମଧ୍ୟ ବାଧାପ୍ରାପ୍ତ ହୋଇପାରେ। ଅନ୍ୟପକ୍ଷରେ, ଅନେକ ଦେଶରେ ତୁଷାର ଓ ବରଫାଚ୍ଛାଦିତ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ସାଧାରଣ ଅଟେ, ଏବଂ ବର୍ଷସାରା ଯାତାୟାତ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଅବ୍ୟାହତ ଭାବରେ ଚାଲିଥାଏ।
question: ପରିଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ଯେଉଁ ଦେଶଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ତୁଷାର ଏବଂ ବରଫାଚ୍ଛାଦିତ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ସାଧାରଣ ଅଟେ, ସେଠାରେ ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳାଇବା ବିଷୟରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ଭାବରେ ଅନୁମାନ କରାଯାଇପାରେ?
mc_answer1: ତୁଷାର ଝଡ଼ ହେଉଛି ବିରଳ ଘଟଣା ଯାହା କେବଳ ଉଚ୍ଚ ଅକ୍ଷାଂଶ ଏବଂ ପାର୍ବତ୍ୟ ଘାଟିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ କରିଥାଏ।
mc_answer2: ନିରବଚ୍ଛିନ୍ନ ଯାତାୟାତ ସୁନିଶ୍ଚିତ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ରାସ୍ତା ରକ୍ଷଣାବେକ୍ଷଣ କର୍ମଚାରୀମାନେ ଉତ୍ତରଦାୟୀ।
mc_answer3: ଯେଉଁ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ତୁଷାର ଏବଂ ବରଫ ସ୍ୱାଭାବିକ, ସେଠାରେ ଦୃଶ୍ୟମାନତା କ୍ୱଚିତ ଏକ ସମସ୍ୟା ହୋଇଥାଏ।
mc_answer4: ବାରମ୍ବାର ଦେଖାଦେଉଥିବା ଶୀତକାଳୀନ ବିପଦର ମୁକାବିଲା କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଚାଳକମାନଙ୍କୁ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ଆଶା ଏବଂ କୌଶଳକୁ ଅନୁକୂଳ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ।

flores_passage_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus. According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded. The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born. Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences about the Ephesians' reaction to Herostratus' crime is most logically supported?
mc_answer1_en: The Ephesians believed that recording Herostratus' name would honor his memory.
mc_answer2_en: The Ephesians were unaware that the temple was destroyed by arson.
mc_answer3_en: The Ephesians sought to erase Herostratus' legacy as a direct response to his desire for infamy.
mc_answer4_en: The Ephesians immediately rebuilt the temple without waiting for Alexander's offer.
flores_passage: ୩୫୬ ଖ୍ରୀଷ୍ଟପୂର୍ବ ଜୁଲାଇ ୨୧ ତାରିଖରେ ହେରୋଷ୍ଟ୍ରାଟସ୍ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଘଟାଯାଇଥିବା ଏକ ଅଗ୍ନିକାଣ୍ଡରେ ଏଫିସସ୍‌ର ଆର୍ଟେମିସ୍ ମନ୍ଦିର ଧ୍ୱଂସ ପାଇଥିଲା। କାହାଣୀ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଯେକୌଣସି ମୂଲ୍ୟରେ ଖ୍ୟାତି ଅର୍ଜନ କରିବା ତାଙ୍କର ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ଥିଲା। ଏଥିରେ କ୍ରୋଧିତ ହୋଇ ଏଫିସସ୍‌ବାସୀ ଘୋଷଣା କରିଥିଲେ ଯେ ହେରୋଷ୍ଟ୍ରାଟସ୍‌ଙ୍କ ନାମ କେବେହେଲେ ଲିପିବଦ୍ଧ କରାଯିବ ନାହିଁ। ଗ୍ରୀକ୍ ଐତିହାସିକ ଷ୍ଟ୍ରାବୋ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସମୟରେ ଏହି ନାମ ଉଲ୍ଲେଖ କରିଥିଲେ, ଯାହା ଫଳରେ ଆଜି ଆମେ ଏହା ଜାଣିପାରିଛୁ। ଆଲେକ୍‌ଜାଣ୍ଡାର୍ ଦ ଗ୍ରେଟ୍ ଯେଉଁ ରାତିରେ ଜନ୍ମଗ୍ରହଣ କରିଥିଲେ, ସେହି ରାତିରେ ହିଁ ମନ୍ଦିରଟି ଧ୍ୱଂସ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ରାଜା ଭାବରେ ଆଲେକ୍‌ଜାଣ୍ଡାର୍ ମନ୍ଦିରର ପୁନଃନିର୍ମାଣ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ବହନ କରିବାକୁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବ ଦେଇଥିଲେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ତାଙ୍କ ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବକୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାନ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା। ପରେ, ଆଲେକ୍‌ଜାଣ୍ଡାର୍‌ଙ୍କ ମୃତ୍ୟୁ ପରେ, ୩୨୩ ଖ୍ରୀଷ୍ଟପୂର୍ବରେ ମନ୍ଦିରଟି ପୁନଃନିର୍ମିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ହେରୋଷ୍ଟ୍ରାଟସ୍‌ଙ୍କ ଅପରାଧ ପ୍ରତି ଏଫିସସ୍‌ବାସୀଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ବିଷୟରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ଅନୁମାନଟି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ?
mc_answer1: ଏଫିସସ୍‌ବାସୀ ବିଶ୍ୱାସ କରୁଥିଲେ ଯେ ହେରୋଷ୍ଟ୍ରାଟସ୍‌ଙ୍କ ନାମ ଲିପିବଦ୍ଧ କଲେ ତାଙ୍କ ସ୍ମୃତିକୁ ସମ୍ମାନ ମିଳିବ।
mc_answer2: ଏଫିସସ୍‌ବାସୀ ଅଜ୍ଞ ଥିଲେ ଯେ ମନ୍ଦିରଟି ଅଗ୍ନିକାଣ୍ଡ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଧ୍ୱଂସ ହୋଇଥିଲା।
mc_answer3: ହେରୋଷ୍ଟ୍ରାଟସ୍‌ଙ୍କ କୁଖ୍ୟାତି ପାଇବାର ଇଚ୍ଛାର ସିଧାସଳଖ ଜବାବରେ ଏଫିସସ୍‌ବାସୀ ତାଙ୍କ ସ୍ମୃତି ବା ପରିଚୟକୁ ଚିରଦିନ ପାଇଁ ଲିଭାଇ ଦେବାକୁ ଚାହୁଁଥିଲେ।
mc_answer4: ଆଲେକ୍‌ଜାଣ୍ଡାର୍‌ଙ୍କ ପ୍ରସ୍ତାବକୁ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ନକରି ଏଫିସସ୍‌ବାସୀ ତୁରନ୍ତ ମନ୍ଦିରଟିକୁ ପୁନଃନିର୍ମାଣ କରିଥିଲେ।

flores_passage_en: The movie, featuring Ryan Gosling and Emma Stone, received nominations in all major categories. Gosling and Stone received nominations for Best Actor and Actress respectively. The other nominations include Best Picture, Director, Cinematography, Costume Design, Film-editing, Original Score, Production Design, Sound Editing, Sound Mixing and Original Screenplay. Two songs from the movie, Audition (The Fools Who Dream) and City of Stars, received nominations for best original song. Lionsgate studio received 26 nominations — more than any other studio.
question_en: Based on the information provided, which of the following statements can be logically inferred about the movie's success relative to other films in its category?
mc_answer1_en: The movie was the most commercially successful film of its release year.
mc_answer2_en: The movie achieved a level of industry recognition that surpassed that of its studio's competitors.
mc_answer3_en: The movie's soundtrack received more nominations than its screenplay.
mc_answer4_en: The movie's lead actors were the only nominees from their respective gender categories.
flores_passage: ରିଆନ୍ ଗୋସ୍ଲିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଏବଂ ଏମା ଷ୍ଟୋନ୍‌ଙ୍କ ଅଭିନୀତ ଏହି ଚଳଚ୍ଚିତ୍ରଟି ସମସ୍ତ ପ୍ରମୁଖ ବର୍ଗରେ ନାମାଙ୍କନ ପାଇଥିଲା। ଗୋସ୍ଲିଙ୍ଗ୍ ଏବଂ ଷ୍ଟୋନ୍ ଯଥାକ୍ରମେ ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ ଅଭିନେତା ଏବଂ ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ ଅଭିନେତ୍ରୀ ପାଇଁ ନାମାଙ୍କନ ପାଇଥିଲେ। ଅନ୍ୟାନ୍ୟ ନାମାଙ୍କନଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ ଚଳଚ୍ଚିତ୍ର, ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦେଶକ, ସିନେମାଟୋଗ୍ରାଫି, ପୋଷାକ ଡିଜାଇନ୍, ଫିଲ୍ମ ଏଡିଟିଂ, ମୂଳ ସ୍କୋର, ପ୍ରଡକ୍ସନ ଡିଜାଇନ୍, ସାଉଣ୍ଡ ଏଡିଟିଂ, ସାଉଣ୍ଡ ମିକ୍ସିଂ ଏବଂ ମୂଳ ଚିତ୍ରନାଟ୍ୟ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ। ଏହି ଚଳଚ୍ଚିତ୍ରର ଦୁଇଟି ଗୀତ, 'ଅଡିସନ୍ (ଦ ଫୁଲ୍ସ ହୁ ଡ୍ରିମ୍)' ଏବଂ 'ସିଟି ଅଫ୍ ଷ୍ଟାର୍ସ', ଶ୍ରେଷ୍ଠ ମୌଳିକ ଗୀତ ପାଇଁ ନାମାଙ୍କନ ପାଇଥିଲା। ଲାୟନ୍ସଗେଟ୍ ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓ ୨୬ଟି ନାମାଙ୍କନ ପାଇଥିଲା — ଯାହା ଅନ୍ୟ ଯେକୌଣସି ଷ୍ଟୁଡିଓ ତୁଳନାରେ ଅଧିକ।
question: ପ୍ରଦତ୍ତ ସୂଚନା ଆଧାରରେ, ନିଜ ବର୍ଗର ଅନ୍ୟ ଚଳଚ୍ଚିତ୍ରଗୁଡ଼ିକ ତୁଳନାରେ ଏହି ଚଳଚ୍ଚିତ୍ରର ସଫଳତା ବିଷୟରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ବିବୃତିଟି ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ଭାବରେ ଅନୁମାନ କରାଯାଇପାରିବ?
mc_answer1: ଚଳଚ୍ଚିତ୍ରଟି ଏହାର ମୁକ୍ତିଲାଭ ବର୍ଷରେ ବ୍ୟବସାୟିକ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିରୁ ସବୁଠାରୁ ସଫଳ ଚଳଚ୍ଚିତ୍ର ଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: """Panama Papers"" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016. The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations. British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this. There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported by the evidence presented?
mc_answer1_en: The Mossack Fonseca documents directly led to significant political consequences in at least two nations.
mc_answer2_en: All fourteen banks implicated in the scandal faced criminal prosecution as a direct result of the leak.
mc_answer3_en: The Guardian newspaper was the sole source responsible for leaking the Panama Papers to the public.
mc_answer4_en: Deutsche Bank was the primary facilitator of tax evasion across all involved countries.

flores_passage_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting. The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states. With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem. This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV. The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.
question_en: According to the passage, what is the primary reason why frequently experiencing artificially induced lucid dreams can lead to exhaustion?
mc_answer1_en: It increases the frequency of waking up during the night, similar to watching TV.
mc_answer2_en: It causes the brain to spend less time in REM states, which are necessary for physical recovery.
mc_answer3_en: It requires more energy from the brain to maintain lucidity, leading to fatigue.
mc_answer4_en: It prevents the brain from entering REM states entirely during sleep cycles.

flores_passage_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior. The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours. The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera. Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain. The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences is most strongly supported regarding the observation of dark clouds at the base of the mountain?
mc_answer1_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office had already confirmed the clouds as a result of volcanic ash prior to the USGS report.
mc_answer2_en: The presence of dark clouds indicates that a new eruption was imminent despite the lack of recent seismic data.
mc_answer3_en: The clouds were likely mistaken for signs of an eruption by observers unfamiliar with the volcano's recent activity.
mc_answer4_en: The clouds were caused by the same seismic activity that occurred on March 10.
flores_passage: ଯୁକ୍ତରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର ଭୂତାତ୍ତ୍ୱିକ ସର୍ବେକ୍ଷଣର ଆନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ଭୂମିକମ୍ପ ମାନଚିତ୍ରରେ ପୂର୍ବ ସପ୍ତାହରେ ଆଇସଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡରେ କୌଣସି ଭୂମିକମ୍ପ ଦର୍ଶାଯାଇ ନଥିଲା। ଆଇସଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ପାଣିପାଗ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାଳୟ ମଧ୍ୟ ଗତ ୪୮ ଘଣ୍ଟା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ହେକ୍ଲା ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ କୌଣସି ଭୂମିକମ୍ପ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପ ନଥିବା ରିପୋର୍ଟ କରିଥିଲା। ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାୟ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଘଟାଇଥିବା ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭୂମିକମ୍ପ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପ ମାର୍ଚ୍ଚ ୧୦ ରେ ଆଗ୍ନେୟଗିରିର ଶିଖର କାଲଡେରାର ଉତ୍ତର-ପୂର୍ବ ପାର୍ଶ୍ୱରେ ଘଟିଥିଲା। ପର୍ବତର ପାଦଦେଶରେ କୌଣସି ଆଗ୍ନେୟଗିରି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପ ସହିତ ଜଡ଼ିତ ନଥିବା କଳା ମେଘ ଦେଖାଯାଇଥିବା ରିପୋର୍ଟ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା। ଏହି ମେଘଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପ୍ରକୃତରେ ଏକ ଉଦ୍‌ଗୀରଣ ଘଟିଛି କି ନାହିଁ ସେ ବିଷୟରେ ଦ୍ୱନ୍ଦ୍ୱ ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରିବାର ସମ୍ଭାବନା ଉପସ୍ଥାପନ କରିଥିଲା।
