flores_passage_en: Anyone planning a visit to a country that could be considered a war zone should get professional training. A search of the Internet for 'Hostile environment course' will probably provide the address of a local company. A course will normally cover all the issues discussed here in far greater detail, usually with practical experience. A course will normally be from 2-5 days and will involve role play, a lot of first aid and sometimes weapons training. Books and magazines dealing with wilderness survival are common, but publications dealing with war zones are few.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported regarding the preparation for visiting a war zone?
mc_answer1_en: Individuals should seek professional training rather than relying solely on general survival literature.
mc_answer2_en: The internet provides a comprehensive list of all available war zone training courses.
mc_answer3_en: Books and magazines are the most reliable sources for learning about war zone survival.
mc_answer4_en: A one-day course is sufficient for comprehensive preparation in a hostile environment.

flores_passage_en: "Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as ""King Tut"" or ""The Boy King"", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times. Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists. However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed. Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is best supported by the information provided regarding King Tutankhamun's historical status?
mc_answer1_en: His fame in modern times is primarily due to the discovery of his undisturbed tomb.
mc_answer2_en: He was celebrated by the ancient Egyptians for his military conquests.
mc_answer3_en: The preservation of his tomb was the result of a deliberate conspiracy by his priests.
mc_answer4_en: He was recorded on most ancient king lists but forgotten over time.

flores_passage_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others. That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire. Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions. For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car. He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.
question_en: According to the passage, why is understanding the intention of others considered crucial for social interaction?
mc_answer1_en: It ensures that all physical actions are judged fairly regardless of intent.
mc_answer2_en: It allows people to resolve ambiguities in interpreting physical actions based on context.
mc_answer3_en: It enables humans to accurately predict what other humans perceive, believe, or desire.
mc_answer4_en: It helps individuals distinguish between intentional theft and accidental behavior.

flores_passage_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain. Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak. But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel. However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions about British military strategy is most strongly supported by the information provided?
mc_answer1_en: The Royal Navy was expected to engage the German fleet in open waters to prevent an invasion.
mc_answer2_en: Germany planned to launch Operation Sealion without considering the strength of the Royal Navy.
mc_answer3_en: The British Army was fully prepared to repel an invasion despite losses at Dunkirk.
mc_answer4_en: The British command prioritized protecting the Royal Navy from air attacks over immediate naval confrontation.

flores_passage_en: Courier companies are well paid for delivering things quickly. Frequently, time is very important with business documents, merchandise or spare parts for an urgent repair. On some routes, the larger companies have their own planes, but for other routes and smaller firms there was a problem. If they sent things by air freight, on some routes it may have taken days to get through unloading and customs. The only way to get it through faster was to send it as checked luggage. Airline regulations will not allow them to send luggage without a passenger, which is where you come in.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why courier companies might send packages as checked luggage instead of using standard air freight?
mc_answer1_en: It ensures that the packages arrive faster than standard air freight on some routes
mc_answer2_en: It is the only method guaranteed to bypass customs delays on certain routes
mc_answer3_en: It allows courier companies to avoid paying higher fees for air freight services
mc_answer4_en: It is a legal requirement for transporting urgent business documents and merchandise
flores_passage: ଦ୍ରୁତ ଗତିରେ ଜିନିଷ ବିତରଣ କରିବା ପାଇଁ କୁରିୟର କମ୍ପାନୀଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଭଲ ଅର୍ଥ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରାଯାଏ। ବ୍ୟବସାୟିକ ଦଲିଲ, ସାମଗ୍ରୀ କିମ୍ବା ଜରୁରୀ ମରାମତି ପାଇଁ ସ୍ପେୟାର୍ ପାର୍ଟସ୍ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ସମୟ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ବହୁତ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ହୋଇଥାଏ। କେତେକ ମାର୍ଗରେ, ବଡ଼ କମ୍ପାନୀଗୁଡ଼ିକର ନିଜସ୍ୱ ବିମାନ ଥାଏ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଅନ୍ୟ ମାର୍ଗ ଏବଂ ଛୋଟ ଫାର୍ମଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ଏକ ସମସ୍ୟା ଥିଲା। ଯଦି ସେମାନେ ବିମାନ ମାଲ ପରିବହନ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ଜିନିଷ ପଠାନ୍ତି, ତେବେ କେତେକ ମାର୍ଗରେ ଅନଲୋଡିଂ ଏବଂ କଷ୍ଟମ୍ସ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଶେଷ ହେବାକୁ କିଛି ଦିନ ଲାଗିଯାଇପାରେ। ଏହାକୁ ଅଧିକ ଶୀଘ୍ର ପହଞ୍ଚାଇବାର ଏକମାତ୍ର ଉପାୟ ଥିଲା ଏହାକୁ ଚେକ୍‌ଡ୍ ଲଗେଜ୍ ଭାବରେ ପଠାଇବା। ବିମାନ କମ୍ପାନୀର ନିୟମାବଳୀ ଯାତ୍ରୀ ବିନା ଲଗେଜ୍ ପଠାଇବାକୁ ଅନୁମତି ଦିଏ ନାହିଁ, ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ଆପଣଙ୍କର ଭୂମିକା ଆସିଥାଏ।

flores_passage_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them. Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe. The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy. Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

mc_answer1_en: Sanskrit was primarily developed through contact with European languages.
mc_answer2_en: Sanskrit served as a foundational language for other Indian languages in a manner similar to Latin's role in European languages.
mc_answer3_en: Sanskrit's decline was caused by the influence of Latin.
mc_answer4_en: Sanskrit and Latin were developed simultaneously as the earliest known languages.

flores_passage_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism. This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun. Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists. If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism. Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be reasonably inferred about the motivations of tourists engaging in cultural tourism versus recreational tourism?
mc_answer1_en: Recreational tourists typically prioritize familiar environments over novel historical insights.
mc_answer2_en: Both cultural and recreational tourists exclusively visit beaches and theme parks for their primary activities.
mc_answer3_en: Cultural tourists often seek experiences that contrast with their daily routine, similar to recreational tourists, but with a focus on learning rather than leisure.
mc_answer4_en: Cultural tourists are primarily motivated by relaxation and entertainment, whereas recreational tourists seek educational experiences.

flores_passage_en: If the country you will be visiting becomes subject to a travel advisory, your travel health insurance or your trip cancellation insurance may be affected. You may also wish to consult the advice of governments other than your own, but their advice is designed for their citizens. As one example, American citizens in the Middle East might face different situations from Europeans or Arabs. Advisories are merely a brief summary of the political situation in one country. The views presented are often cursory, general and oversimplified compared to the more detailed information available elsewhere.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions about travel advisories is most strongly supported by the text?
mc_answer1_en: Travel advisories offer a simplified overview that may not fully capture the nuanced realities of a political situation.
mc_answer2_en: Travel advisories issued by foreign governments are always more reliable than those issued by the traveler's home government.
mc_answer3_en: Travel advisories guarantee that insurance coverage will be automatically voided if a country is subject to an advisory.
mc_answer4_en: Travel advisories are comprehensive guides that provide detailed, country-specific advice for all citizens.

flores_passage_en: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families. Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around. In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially. Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances. There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

mc_answer3_en: Taxis are universally preferred by visitors over other transportation methods.
mc_answer4_en: Families in Charlotte have no other transportation options besides taxis.

flores_passage_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states. The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance. The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power. This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles. Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds. Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

mc_answer1_en: The need to treat battlefield injuries drove the development of surgical techniques and the formal organization of medical personnel.
mc_answer2_en: The Roman Medical Corps was established to prevent diseases in the army rather than to treat injuries.
mc_answer3_en: Medical advances were primarily a result of Roman trade with other civilizations rather than military necessity.
mc_answer4_en: Emperor Augustus personally invented morphine and scopolamine to improve soldier survival rates.

flores_passage: ଆନସା (Ansa) ଅନୁସାରେ, "ଦୁଇଟି ଉଚ୍ଚସ୍ତରୀୟ ହତ୍ୟାକାଣ୍ଡକୁ ନେଇ ପୋଲିସ ଚିନ୍ତିତ ଥିଲା, ଯାହା ଏକ ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣାଙ୍ଗ ଉତ୍ତରାଧିକାରୀ ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିଦେଇପାରେ ବୋଲି ସେମାନେ ଆଶଙ୍କା କରୁଥିଲେ। ପୋଲିସ କହିଛି ଯେ ଲୋ ପିକୋଲୋଙ୍କ ସ୍ଥିତି ମଜବୁତ ଥିଲା କାରଣ ସେ ପାଲେରମୋରେ ପ୍ରୋଭେନଜାନୋଙ୍କ ଡାହାଣ ହାତ ଥିଲେ ଏବଂ ତାଙ୍କର ଅଧିକ ଅଭିଜ୍ଞତା ତାଙ୍କୁ ପୁରୁଣା ପିଢ଼ିର ବସ୍‌ମାନଙ୍କ ସମ୍ମାନ ଆଣିଦେଇଥିଲା, ଯେହେତୁ ସେମାନେ ନିଜ କ୍ଷମତା ନେଟୱାର୍କକୁ ମଜବୁତ କରିବା ସହିତ ଯଥାସମ୍ଭବ ଚୁପଚାପ ରହିବାର ପ୍ରୋଭେନଜାନୋଙ୍କ ନୀତିକୁ ଅନୁସରଣ କରୁଥିଲେ। ଏହି ବସ୍‌ମାନଙ୍କୁ ପ୍ରୋଭେନଜାନୋ ସେତେବେଳେ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରିଥିଲେ ଯେତେବେଳେ ସେ ରାଜ୍ୟ ବିରୁଦ୍ଧରେ ରିଇନା-ଚାଳିତ ଯୁଦ୍ଧର ଅନ୍ତ ଘଟାଇଥିଲେ, ଯେଉଁ ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ୧୯୯୨ ମସିହାରେ ମାଫିଆ ବିରୋଧୀ ସଂଗ୍ରାମୀ ଜିଓଭାନି ଫାଲକୋନେ ଏବଂ ପାଓଲୋ ବୋରସେଲିନୋଙ୍କ ଜୀବନ ନେଇଥିଲା।"

flores_passage_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots. Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous. These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves. A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk. Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be inferred about the diet of Triceratops regarding cycads?
mc_answer1_en: Triceratops probably consumed cycads despite their toxicity, as some modern animals can eat poisonous plants.
mc_answer2_en: Triceratops exclusively ate cycads because no other plants were available during the Cretaceous period.
mc_answer3_en: Triceratops likely avoided cycads because the plants were poisonous and the evidence of consumption is inconclusive.
mc_answer4_en: Triceratops could have eaten the trunk of cycads without stripping the leaves due to their powerful beaks.
flores_passage: ଟ୍ରାଇସେରାଟପ୍ସର ଦାନ୍ତ କେବଳ ପତ୍ର ନୁହେଁ ବରଂ ବହୁତ ଶକ୍ତ ଶାଖା ଏବଂ ଚେରକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ଚୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ କରିବାରେ ସକ୍ଷମ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା। କେତେକ ବୈଜ୍ଞାନିକଙ୍କ ମତରେ ଟ୍ରାଇସେରାଟପ୍ସ ସାଇକାଡ୍ ଖାଉଥିଲା, ଯାହା ଏକ ପ୍ରକାରର ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ ଏବଂ କ୍ରେଟାସିୟସ୍ ଯୁଗରେ ସାଧାରଣ ଥିଲା। ଏହି ଉଦ୍ଭିଦଗୁଡ଼ିକ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ, କଣ୍ଟାଳିଆ ପତ୍ରର ମୁକୁଟ ଥିବା ଏକ ଛୋଟ ତାଳ ଗଛ ପରି ଦେଖାଯାଏ। ଟ୍ରାଇସେରାଟପ୍ସ କାଣ୍ଡ ଖାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପତ୍ରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଛଡ଼ାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଏହାର ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ ଥଣ୍ଟ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରିଥାନ୍ତା। ଅନ୍ୟ ବୈଜ୍ଞାନିକମାନେ ଯୁକ୍ତି କରନ୍ତି ଯେ ଏହି ଉଦ୍ଭିଦଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଅତ୍ୟନ୍ତ ବିଷାକ୍ତ, ତେଣୁ କୌଣସି ଡାଇନୋସର ଏହାକୁ ଖାଇବାର ସମ୍ଭାବନା ନାହିଁ, ଯଦିଓ ଆଜି ସ୍ଲଥ୍ ଏବଂ ଶୁଆ (ଡାଇନୋସରଙ୍କ ଏକ ବଂଶଧର) ଭଳି ଅନ୍ୟ ପ୍ରାଣୀମାନେ ବିଷାକ୍ତ ପତ୍ର କିମ୍ବା ଫଳ ଖାଇପାରନ୍ତି।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ସାଇକାଡ୍ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧରେ ଟ୍ରାଇସେରାଟପ୍ସର ଖାଦ୍ୟ ବିଷୟରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଅନୁମାନ କରାଯାଇପାରିବ?

mc_answer2: କ୍ରେଟାସିୟସ୍ ଯୁଗରେ ଅନ୍ୟ କୌଣସି ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ ଉପଲବ୍ଧ ନ ଥିବାରୁ ଟ୍ରାଇସେରାଟପ୍ସ କେବଳ ସାଇକାଡ୍ ଖାଉଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment. Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words. Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses. Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes. Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is best supported by the author's discussion of wildlife photography?
mc_answer1_en: Wildlife photographers must prioritize commercial success over artistic expression.
mc_answer2_en: Success in wildlife photography depends on a variety of factors beyond just having the right equipment.
mc_answer3_en: Photographs of wild animals are less valuable than those of domestic animals.
mc_answer4_en: Most exotic animals are easy to locate if a photographer has sufficient patience.

flores_passage_en: "Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families. The ""typical"" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home. There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of ""going to Disney World"". Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets. While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable."
question_en: Which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported by the passage regarding the purchase of Disney World tickets on auction websites?
mc_answer1_en: A buyer may be purchasing a ticket that is invalid for future use due to Disney's non-transferability policy.
mc_answer2_en: Most buyers of these tickets are unaware that they are engaging in an activity prohibited by Disney.
mc_answer3_en: Disney explicitly encourages the resale of partially used tickets to increase revenue.
mc_answer4_en: Tickets sold on eBay or Craigslist are guaranteed to be authentic and fully transferable to new users.

flores_passage_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time. Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range. In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen. German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines. Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences about the post-World War II situation regarding German submarines is most logically supported?
mc_answer1_en: Germany was allowed to operate submarines for defense purposes but under strict international supervision.
mc_answer2_en: Germany's historical proficiency in submarine warfare led to restrictions on their current naval capabilities.
mc_answer3_en: Other nations feared German submarines would be used for trade disruption rather than military aggression.
mc_answer4_en: The development of radar made German submarines obsolete, leading to their complete dismantling.
flores_passage: ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ ହେଉଛି ପାଣି ଭିତରେ ଯାତ୍ରା କରିବା ଏବଂ ଦୀର୍ଘ ସମୟ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସେଠାରେ ରହିବା ପାଇଁ ଡିଜାଇନ୍ କରାଯାଇଥିବା ଜାହାଜ। ପ୍ରଥମ ବିଶ୍ୱଯୁଦ୍ଧ ଏବଂ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ବିଶ୍ୱଯୁଦ୍ଧରେ ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ସେତେବେଳେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବହୁତ ମନ୍ଥର ଥିଲା ଏବଂ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକର ଗୁଳି ଚଳାଇବା ପରିସର ବହୁତ ସୀମିତ ଥିଲା। ଯୁଦ୍ଧର ଆରମ୍ଭରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ସମୁଦ୍ର ଉପରେ ଯାତ୍ରା କରୁଥିଲେ, କିନ୍ତୁ ରାଡାର ବିକଶିତ ହେବା ଏବଂ ଅଧିକ ସଠିକ୍ ହେବା ସହିତ ନଜରରୁ ବର୍ତ୍ତିବା ପାଇଁ ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପାଣି ଭିତରକୁ ଯିବାକୁ ବାଧ୍ୟ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା। ଜର୍ମାନ ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ୟୁ-ବୋଟ୍ କୁହାଯାଉଥିଲା। ଜର୍ମାନମାନେ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ ଚଳାଇବା ଏବଂ ପରିଚାଳନା କରିବାରେ ବହୁତ ଦକ୍ଷ ଥିଲେ। ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ସଫଳତା ଯୋଗୁଁ, ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ପରେ ଜର୍ମାନମାନଙ୍କ ପାଖରେ ଅଧିକ ସଂଖ୍ୟକ ବୁଡ଼ାଜାହାଜ ରହିବା ଉପରେ ଭରସା କରାଯାଏ ନାହିଁ।

flores_passage_en: While project based learning should make learning easier and more interesting, scaffolding goes a step beyond. Scaffolding is not a method of learning but rather an aid that provides support to individuals whom are undergoing a new learning experience such as using a new computer program or beginning a new project. Scaffolds can be both virtual and real, in other words, a teacher is a form of scaffold but so is the little paperclip man in Microsoft Office. Virtual Scaffolds are internalized in the software and are meant to question, prompt, and explain procedures that may have been to challenging for the student to handle alone.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best describes the role of scaffolding in relation to project-based learning?
mc_answer1_en: It is a standalone method of learning that functions independently of student needs.
mc_answer2_en: It is primarily used for teaching software programs like Microsoft Office exclusively.
mc_answer3_en: It replaces the need for project-based learning by offering a more advanced method.
mc_answer4_en: It serves as a supportive aid that complements project-based learning rather than replacing it.
flores_passage: ଯଦିଓ ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ ଭିତ୍ତିକ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ପାଠପଢ଼ାକୁ ସହଜ ଏବଂ ଅଧିକ ଆକର୍ଷଣୀୟ କରିବା ଉଚିତ, ସ୍କାଫୋଲ୍ଡିଂ ଆଉ ଏକ ପାଦ ଆଗକୁ ଯାଇଥାଏ। ସ୍କାଫୋଲ୍ଡିଂ ଶିକ୍ଷଣର କୌଣସି ପଦ୍ଧତି ନୁହେଁ, ବରଂ ଏକ ସହାୟକ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ଯାହା ନୂତନ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ଅନୁଭୂତି ମଧ୍ୟ ଦେଇ ଗତି କରୁଥିବା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିବିଶେଷଙ୍କୁ ସହାୟତା ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିଥାଏ, ଯେପରିକି ଏକ ନୂତନ କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର ପ୍ରୋଗ୍ରାମ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିବା କିମ୍ବା ଏକ ନୂତନ ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା। ସ୍କାଫୋଲ୍ଡ ଉଭୟ ଭର୍ଚୁଆଲ୍ ଏବଂ ବାସ୍ତବ ହୋଇପାରେ; ଅନ୍ୟ ଅର୍ଥରେ, ଜଣେ ଶିକ୍ଷକ ହେଉଛନ୍ତି ସ୍କାଫୋଲ୍ଡର ଏକ ରୂପ, ସେହିପରି ମାଇକ୍ରୋସଫ୍ଟ ଅଫିସ୍‌ରେ ଥିବା ଛୋଟ ପେପରକ୍ଲିପ୍ ମ୍ୟାନ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ। ଭର୍ଚୁଆଲ୍ ସ୍କାଫୋଲ୍ଡଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସଫ୍ଟୱେର୍ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ ହୋଇଥାଏ ଏବଂ ଏହାର ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ହେଉଛି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ପଚାରିବା, ଉତ୍ସାହିତ କରିବା ଏବଂ ଏପରି ପ୍ରଣାଳୀଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବୁଝାଇବା ଯାହା ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ଏକାକୀ ସମ୍ଭାଳିବା କଷ୍ଟକର ହୋଇପାରେ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଅନୁସାରେ, ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପ-ଭିତ୍ତିକ ଶିକ୍ଷଣ ସହିତ ସ୍କାଫୋଲ୍ଡିଂର ସମ୍ପର୍କକୁ ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ?

flores_passage_en: Virtual teams are held to the same standards of excellence as conventional teams, but there are subtle differences. Virtual team members often function as the point of contact for their immediate physical group. They often have more autonomy than conventional team members as their teams may meet according to varying time zones which may not be understood by their local management. The presence of a true “invisible team” (Larson and LaFasto, 1989, p109) is also a unique component of a virtual team. The “invisible team” is the management team to which each of the members report. The invisible team sets the standards for each member.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be logically inferred about the standards of excellence applied to virtual teams?
mc_answer1_en: They may differ in application due to the autonomy and time zone differences affecting management oversight.
mc_answer2_en: They are lower than those of conventional teams because virtual teams have more autonomy.
mc_answer3_en: They are higher than those of conventional teams because virtual teams are more autonomous.
mc_answer4_en: They are identical to those of conventional teams because virtual teams are held to the same standards.
flores_passage: ଭର୍ଚୁଆଲ୍ ଦଳଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ଦଳଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପରି ଉତ୍କର୍ଷତାର ସମାନ ମାନଦଣ୍ଡରେ ରଖାଯାଏ, କିନ୍ତୁ ଏଥିରେ କିଛି ସୂକ୍ଷ୍ମ ପାର୍ଥକ୍ୟ ଥାଏ। ଭର୍ଚୁଆଲ୍ ଦଳର ସଦସ୍ୟମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ପ୍ରତ୍ୟକ୍ଷ ଭୌତିକ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀ ପାଇଁ ଯୋଗାଯୋଗର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ବିନ୍ଦୁ ଭାବରେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରନ୍ତି। ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ଦଳର ସଦସ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କ ତୁଳନାରେ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ପାଖରେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଅଧିକ ସ୍ୱାୟତ୍ତତା ଥାଏ, କାରଣ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଦଳଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଭିନ୍ନ ଭିନ୍ନ ଟାଇମ୍ ଜୋନ୍ ଅନୁସାରେ ଏକତ୍ରିତ ହୋଇପାରନ୍ତି ଯାହା ସେମାନଙ୍କ ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ପରିଚାଳନା ଦ୍ୱାରା ବୁଝିବା ସମ୍ଭବ ନ ହୋଇପାରେ। ଏକ ପ୍ରକୃତ “ଅଦୃଶ୍ୟ ଦଳ” (ଲାର୍ସନ୍ ଏବଂ ଲାଫାଷ୍ଟୋ, 1989, ପୃଷ୍ଠା 109) ର ଉପସ୍ଥିତି ମଧ୍ୟ ଭର୍ଚୁଆଲ୍ ଦଳର ଏକ ଅନନ୍ୟ ଉପାଦାନ। “ଅଦୃଶ୍ୟ ଦଳ” ହେଉଛି ସେହି ପରିଚାଳନା ଦଳ ଯାହା ନିକଟରେ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସଦସ୍ୟ ରିପୋର୍ଟ କରନ୍ତି। ଅଦୃଶ୍ୟ ଦଳ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ସଦସ୍ୟଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ମାନଦଣ୍ଡ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଧାରଣ କରେ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ଭର୍ଚୁଆଲ୍ ଦଳଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରଯୁଜ୍ୟ ଉତ୍କର୍ଷତାର ମାନଦଣ୍ଡ ବିଷୟରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ଭାବରେ ଅନୁମାନ କରାଯାଇପାରିବ?

flores_passage_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently. These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting. There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features. This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling. It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why MySpace pages might be particularly accessible for students with specific learning challenges?
mc_answer1_en: MySpace allows for extensive customization of text size and color to enhance readability for different users.
mc_answer2_en: MySpace provides automatic translation services for non-native English speakers.

flores_passage_en: The stretch between Point Marion and Fairmont presents the most challenging driving conditions on the Buffalo-Pittsburgh Highway, passing frequently through isolated backwoods terrain. If you're not used to driving on country roads, keep your wits about you: steep grades, narrow lanes, and sharp curves predominate. Posted speed limits are noticeably lower than in previous and subsequent sections — commonly 35-40 mph (56-64 km/h) — and strict obedience to them is even more important than otherwise. Curiously, though, mobile phone service is much stronger here than along many other stretches of the route, e.g. the Pennsylvania Wilds.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is best supported by the information provided?
mc_answer1_en: The contrast between poor phone service elsewhere and strong service here suggests a deliberate infrastructure investment to aid navigation.
mc_answer2_en: The strong mobile phone service in this region is likely due to the need for drivers to call for assistance given the challenging road conditions.
mc_answer3_en: The lower speed limits in this section are primarily intended to protect wildlife in the isolated backwoods area.
mc_answer4_en: Drivers unfamiliar with rural roads may require more frequent communication with emergency services on this stretch compared to others.
flores_passage: ପଏଣ୍ଟ ମାରିଅନ୍ ଏବଂ ଫେୟାରମଣ୍ଟ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ରାସ୍ତା ଅଂଶଟି ବଫେଲୋ-ପିଟ୍ସବର୍ଗ ହାଇୱେରେ ସବୁଠାରୁ ଚ୍ୟାଲେଞ୍ଜପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଡ୍ରାଇଭିଂ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ସୃଷ୍ଟି କରେ, ଯାହା ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ବିଚ୍ଛିନ୍ନ ଜଙ୍ଗଲିଆ ଇଲାକା ଦେଇ ଯାଇଥାଏ। ଯଦି ଆପଣ ଗ୍ରାମାଞ୍ଚଳ ରାସ୍ତାରେ ଗାଡ଼ି ଚଳାଇବାରେ ଅଭ୍ୟସ୍ତ ନୁହଁନ୍ତି, ତେବେ ସତର୍କ ରୁହନ୍ତୁ: ତୀବ୍ର ଢାଲୁ, ସଂକୀର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଲେନ୍ ଏବଂ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ବାଙ୍କ ପ୍ରମୁଖ ଭାବେ ରହିଛି। ଫଳକରେ ଦର୍ଶାଯାଇଥିବା ଗତି ସୀମା ପୂର୍ବ ଏବଂ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ବିଭାଗ ତୁଳନାରେ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ କମ୍ — ସାଧାରଣତଃ ୩୫-୪୦ ମାଇଲ୍/ଘଣ୍ଟା (୫୬-୬୪ କିମି/ଘଣ୍ଟା) — ଏବଂ ଅନ୍ୟ ସ୍ଥାନ ତୁଳନାରେ ଏଠାରେ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକର କଡ଼ାକଡ଼ି ପାଳନ ଅଧିକ ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ। ତଥାପି, ଆଶ୍ଚର୍ଯ୍ୟଜନକ ଭାବରେ, ଏହି ମାର୍ଗର ଅନ୍ୟ ଅନେକ ଅଂଶ (ଯଥା: ପେନସିଲଭାନିଆ ୱାଇଲ୍ଡ୍ସ) ତୁଳନାରେ ଏଠାରେ ମୋବାଇଲ୍ ଫୋନ୍ ସେବା ବହୁତ ଭଲ।

flores_passage: ଏହି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ସମୟ ରାତି ୮:୩୦ (୧୫.୦୦ UTC) ରେ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଥିଲା। ସାରା ଦେଶର ପ୍ରସିଦ୍ଧ ଗାୟକମାନେ ଶ୍ରୀ ଶ୍ୟାମଙ୍କ ଚରଣରେ ଭଜନ ବା ଭକ୍ତି ସଙ୍ଗୀତ ପରିବେଷଣ କରିଥିଲେ। ଗାୟକ ସଞ୍ଜୁ ଶର୍ମା ସନ୍ଧ୍ୟାର ଶୁଭାରମ୍ଭ କରିଥିଲେ, ତାଙ୍କ ପରେ ଜୟ ଶଙ୍କର ଚୌଧୁରୀ ଆସିଥିଲେ। ସେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଛପ୍ପନ ଭୋଗ ଭଜନ ପରିବେଷଣ କରିଥିଲେ। ଗାୟକ ରାଜୁ ଖଣ୍ଡେଲୱାଲ୍ ତାଙ୍କ ସହିତ ସହଯୋଗ କରୁଥିଲେ। ତା'ପରେ, ଲକ୍ଷା ସିଂହ ଭଜନ ଗାଇବାରେ ନେତୃତ୍ୱ ନେଇଥିଲେ। ବାବା ଶ୍ୟାମଙ୍କୁ ଛପ୍ପନ ଭୋଗର ୧୦୮ ଥାଳି (ହିନ୍ଦୁ ଧର୍ମରେ, ୫୬ ଟି ଭିନ୍ନ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ସାମଗ୍ରୀ, ଯେପରିକି ମିଠା, ଫଳ, ବାଦାମ, ବ୍ୟଞ୍ଜନ ଇତ୍ୟାଦି ଯାହା ଦେବତାଙ୍କୁ ଅର୍ପଣ କରାଯାଏ) ପରଷା ଯାଇଥିଲା। ଲକ୍ଷା ସିଂହ ଛପ୍ପନ ଭୋଗ ଭଜନ ମଧ୍ୟ ପରିବେଷଣ କରିଥିଲେ। ଗାୟକ ରାଜୁ ଖଣ୍ଡେଲୱାଲ୍ ତାଙ୍କ ସହିତ ସହଯୋଗ କରୁଥିଲେ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ସମୟର ଘଟଣାକ୍ରମ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ କେଉଁ ଅନୁମାନଟି ସର୍ବାଧିକ ଦୃଢ଼ ଭାବରେ ସମର୍ଥିତ?

flores_passage_en: "Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the ""little brother"" of Germany and Japan. It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war. Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa. For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else. Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following can be reasonably inferred about Italy's naval strategy in relation to its African objectives?
mc_answer1_en: Italy aimed to establish a direct naval blockade of Britain to prevent interference in its African campaigns.
mc_answer2_en: Italy's naval efforts were focused on defending against British attacks in the Mediterranean rather than facilitating invasions.
mc_answer3_en: Italy intended to use captured Egyptian bases to support troop movements toward Africa.
mc_answer4_en: Italy planned to rely primarily on its newly built battleships to conquer African territories without needing additional strategic locations.
flores_passage: ଆସନ୍ତୁ ଇଟାଲୀର ଯୋଜନା ବିଷୟରେ ଏକ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ସହିତ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରିବା। ଇଟାଲୀ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ଜର୍ମାନୀ ଏବଂ ଜାପାନର ""ଛୋଟ ଭାଇ"" ଥିଲା। ଏହାର ଏକ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ସ୍ଥଳସେନା ଏବଂ ଏକ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ନୌସେନା ଥିଲା, ଯଦିଓ ସେମାନେ ଯୁଦ୍ଧ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହେବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଚାରୋଟି ନୂଆ ଜାହାଜ ନିର୍ମାଣ କରିଥିଲେ। ଇଟାଲୀର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ ଥିଲା ଆଫ୍ରିକୀୟ ଦେଶଗୁଡ଼ିକ। ସେହି ଦେଶଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କବଜା କରିବା ପାଇଁ, ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ସୈନ୍ୟ ପଠାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଏକ ସ୍ଥାନ (ଲଞ୍ଚିଂ ପ୍ୟାଡ୍) ଦରକାର ଥିଲା, ଯେପରି ସୈନ୍ୟମାନେ ଭୂମଧ୍ୟସାଗର ପାର ହୋଇ ଆଫ୍ରିକା ଉପରେ ଆକ୍ରମଣ କରିପାରିବେ। ଏଥିପାଇଁ, ସେମାନଙ୍କୁ ମିଶରରେ ଥିବା ବ୍ରିଟିଶ ଘାଟି ଏବଂ ଜାହାଜଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ହଟାଇବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିଥିଲା। ସେହି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବ୍ୟତୀତ, ଇଟାଲୀର ଯୁଦ୍ଧପୋତଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଅନ୍ୟ କିଛି କରିବାର ନ ଥିଲା। ଏବେ ଜାପାନ କଥା। ବ୍ରିଟେନ୍ ଭଳି ଜାପାନ ମଧ୍ୟ ଏକ ଦ୍ୱୀପ ଦେଶ ଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: The work done was mostly theoretical, but the program was written to simulate observations made of the Sagittarius galaxy. The effect the team was looking for would be caused by tidal forces between the galaxy's dark matter and the Milky Way's dark matter. Just like the moon exerts a pull on the earth, causing tides, so does the Milky Way exert a force on the Sagittarius galaxy. The scientists were able to conclude that the dark matter affect other dark matter in the same way regular matter does. This theory says that most dark matter around a galaxy is located around a galaxy in a kind of halo, and is made of lots of small particles.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions about dark matter is most strongly supported by the scientists' findings?
mc_answer1_en: The simulation program used in the study was designed to measure the light emitted by dark matter particles.
mc_answer2_en: The Sagittarius galaxy contains no dark matter within its core, only in its outer halo.
mc_answer3_en: Dark matter interacts with other dark matter through gravitational forces similar to those observed in regular matter.
mc_answer4_en: Tidal forces between galaxies are caused exclusively by visible matter rather than dark matter.

flores_passage_en: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps. At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient. The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures. Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole. Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported regarding footwear selection for winter conditions?
mc_answer1_en: All winter boots provide adequate traction in icy conditions, provided they are made of soft materials.
mc_answer2_en: Footwear with deep tread patterns is essential for safety, as smooth soles significantly increase slip risk on ice and snow.
mc_answer3_en: Sand and salt are the only reliable methods for improving road traction during winter.
mc_answer4_en: Studded add-ons are only effective when applied to footwear with wide heels.
flores_passage: ଶୀତଦିନେ ଦୁର୍ଘଟଣାର ସବୁଠାରୁ ସାଧାରଣ କାରଣ ହେଉଛି ଖସଡ଼ା ରାସ୍ତା, ଫୁଟପାଥ୍ (ପାଦଚଲା ରାସ୍ତା) ଏବଂ ବିଶେଷକରି ପାହାଚଗୁଡ଼ିକ। ଅତି କମରେ, ଆପଣଙ୍କୁ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ସୋଲ୍ ଥିବା ଜୋତା ଆବଶ୍ୟକ। ଗ୍ରୀଷ୍ମଦିନିଆ ଜୋତା ସାଧାରଣତଃ ବରଫ ଓ ତୁଷାର ଉପରେ ବହୁତ ଖସଡ଼ା ହୋଇଥାଏ, ଏପରିକି କିଛି ଶୀତକାଳୀନ ବୁଟ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ ଅନୁପଯୁକ୍ତ ହୋଇଥାଏ। ତଳିର ଖାଞ୍ଚ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ଗଭୀର ହେବା ଉଚିତ, ୫ ମିଲିମିଟର (୧/୫ ଇଞ୍ଚ) କିମ୍ବା ଅଧିକ, ଏବଂ ଥଣ୍ଡା ତାପମାତ୍ରାରେ ଉପାଦାନଟି ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ନରମ ହେବା ଉଚିତ। କେତେକ ବୁଟରେ ଷ୍ଟଡ୍ ଥାଏ ଏବଂ ଖସଡ଼ା ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ପାଇଁ ଷ୍ଟଡ୍ ଲାଗିଥିବା ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ଉପକରଣ ମଧ୍ୟ ଉପଲବ୍ଧ, ଯାହା ଅଧିକାଂଶ ଜୋତା ଏବଂ ବୁଟର ଗୋଇଠି କିମ୍ବା ଗୋଇଠି ଓ ସୋଲ୍ ପାଇଁ ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ। ଗୋଇଠି ତଳୁଆ ଏବଂ ଚଉଡ଼ା ହେବା ଉଚିତ। ଟ୍ରାକ୍ସନ୍ ବୃଦ୍ଧି କରିବା ପାଇଁ ରାସ୍ତା କିମ୍ବା ପଥଗୁଡ଼ିକରେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ବାଲି, ଗୋଡ଼ି କିମ୍ବା ଲୁଣ (କ୍ୟାଲସିୟମ୍ କ୍ଲୋରାଇଡ୍) ବିଛାଯାଇଥାଏ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ଶୀତକାଳୀନ ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ପାଇଁ ଜୋତା ଚୟନ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷଟି ସବୁଠାରୁ ଦୃଢ଼ ଭାବରେ ସମର୍ଥିତ?
mc_answer1: ସମସ୍ତ ଶୀତକାଳୀନ ବୁଟ୍ ବରଫାବୃତ ଅବସ୍ଥାରେ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟାପ୍ତ ଟ୍ରାକ୍ସନ୍ ପ୍ରଦାନ କରିଥାଏ, ଯଦି ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ନରମ ପଦାର୍ଥରେ ନିର୍ମିତ ହୋଇଥାଏ।
mc_answer2: ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ଗଭୀର ଟ୍ରେଡ୍ ପ୍ୟାଟର୍ନ ଥିବା ଜୋତା ଅତ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ, କାରଣ ଚିକ୍କଣ ସୋଲ୍ ବରଫ ଏବଂ ତୁଷାର ଉପରେ ଖସିଯିବାର ଆଶଙ୍କାକୁ ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ବଢ଼ାଇଦିଏ।

mc_answer4: ଷ୍ଟଡ୍ ଥିବା ଅତିରିକ୍ତ ଉପକରଣ କେବଳ ସେତିକିବେଳେ ପ୍ରଭାବଶାଳୀ ହୁଏ ଯେତେବେଳେ ତାହା ଚଉଡ଼ା ଗୋଇଠି ଥିବା ଜୋତାରେ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରାଯାଏ।

flores_passage_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences. Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history. International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants. Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not. These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements best represents a logical inference about the frequency of International Horticultural Expositions?
mc_answer1_en: They are scheduled less frequently than annually despite theoretical feasibility.
mc_answer2_en: They occur every year in different countries to maximize global participation.
mc_answer3_en: They are typically held on sites smaller than 50 hectares to reduce costs.
mc_answer4_en: They focus exclusively on non-botanical scientific displays.
flores_passage: ଏକ ବିଶ୍ୱ ମେଳା (ସାଧାରଣତଃ ବିଶ୍ୱ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନୀ, କିମ୍ବା କେବଳ ଏକ୍ସପୋ କୁହାଯାଏ) ହେଉଛି କଳା ଏବଂ ବିଜ୍ଞାନର ଏକ ବୃହତ ଆନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ମହୋତ୍ସବ। ଅଂଶଗ୍ରହଣକାରୀ ଦେଶମାନେ ବିଶ୍ୱସ୍ତରୀୟ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗ କିମ୍ବା ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଦେଶର ସଂସ୍କୃତି ଏବଂ ଇତିହାସ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଜାତୀୟ ପାଭିଲିୟନରେ କଳାତ୍ମକ ଏବଂ ଶିକ୍ଷଣୀୟ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନୀ ଉପସ୍ଥାପନ କରନ୍ତି। ଆନ୍ତର୍ଜାତୀୟ ଉଦ୍ୟାନ କୃଷି ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନୀ ହେଉଛି ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମ ଯାହା ଫୁଲ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନୀ, ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ ଉଦ୍ୟାନ ଏବଂ ଉଦ୍ଭିଦ ସହିତ ଜଡ଼ିତ ଅନ୍ୟାନ୍ୟ ବିଷୟ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ କରେ। ଯଦିଓ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ପ୍ରତିବର୍ଷ ଅନୁଷ୍ଠିତ ହୋଇପାରିବ (ଯେପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ସେଗୁଡ଼ିକ ବିଭିନ୍ନ ଦେଶରେ ହେଉଛି), ବାସ୍ତବରେ ତାହା ହୁଏ ନାହିଁ। ଏହି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକ୍ରମଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସାଧାରଣତଃ ତିନିରୁ ଛଅ ମାସ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ଚାଲିଥାଏ ଏବଂ ୫୦ ହେକ୍ଟରରୁ କମ୍ ନ ଥିବା ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଆୟୋଜିତ ହୁଏ।

flores_passage_en: The first cases of the disease this season were reported in late July. The disease is carried by pigs, which then migrates to humans through mosquitos. The outbreak has prompted the Indian government to undertake such measures as deployment of pig catchers in seriously affected areas, distributing thousands of mosquito curtains and spraying pesticides. Several million vials of encephalitis vaccine have also been promised by the government, which will help prepare health agencies for next year. Plans for vaccines to be delivered to the historically most affected areas this year were delayed due to lack of funds and low prioritisation relative to other diseases.
question_en: Which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported by the passage regarding the government's response to the disease outbreak?
mc_answer1_en: The government prioritized immediate containment over long-term prevention.
mc_answer2_en: The delay in vaccine delivery was due to insufficient funding and competing health priorities.
mc_answer3_en: The outbreak was primarily caused by a failure in mosquito control measures.
mc_answer4_en: Health agencies are fully prepared for next year's outbreak due to the vaccine distribution.
flores_passage: ଚଳିତ ଋତୁରେ ଏହି ରୋଗର ପ୍ରଥମ ମାମଲା ଜୁଲାଇ ଶେଷ ଭାଗରେ ରିପୋର୍ଟ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା। ଏହି ରୋଗ ଘୁଷୁରିମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ବହନ କରାଯାଏ, ଯାହା ପରେ ମଶାମାନଙ୍କ ମାଧ୍ୟମରେ ମଣିଷଙ୍କ ଶରୀରକୁ ସଂକ୍ରମିତ ହୁଏ। ଏହି ପ୍ରକୋପ ଭାରତ ସରକାରଙ୍କୁ ଗମ୍ଭୀର ଭାବରେ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳରେ ଘୁଷୁରି ଧରାଳି ମୁତୟନ କରିବା, ହଜାର ହଜାର ମଶାରୀ ବଣ୍ଟନ କରିବା ଏବଂ କୀଟନାଶକ ସ୍ପ୍ରେ କରିବା ଭଳି ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ଗ୍ରହଣ କରିବାକୁ ପ୍ରେରିତ କରିଛି। ସରକାରଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଅନେକ ନିୟୁତ ଏନସେଫାଲାଇଟିସ୍ ଟିକା ଭାଏଲ୍ ମଧ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି ଦିଆଯାଇଛି, ଯାହା ଆସନ୍ତା ବର୍ଷ ପାଇଁ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ଏଜେନ୍ସିଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ପ୍ରସ୍ତୁତ କରିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିବ। ଅନ୍ୟ ରୋଗ ତୁଳନାରେ ପାଣ୍ଠିର ଅଭାବ ଏବଂ କମ୍ ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ଯୋଗୁଁ ଚଳିତ ବର୍ଷ ଐତିହାସିକ ଭାବେ ସର୍ବାଧିକ ପ୍ରଭାବିତ ଅଞ୍ଚଳକୁ ଟିକା ଯୋଗାଇବାର ଯୋଜନାରେ ବିଳମ୍ବ ହୋଇଥିଲା।
question: ରୋଗର ପ୍ରକୋପ ପ୍ରତି ସରକାରଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ପରିଚ୍ଛେଦ ଦ୍ୱାରା ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତଟି ସର୍ବାଧିକ ଦୃଢ଼ ଭାବରେ ସମର୍ଥିତ?
mc_answer1: ସରକାର ଦୀର୍ଘକାଳୀନ ପ୍ରତିରୋଧ ଅପେକ୍ଷା ତୁରନ୍ତ ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣକୁ ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ଦେଇଥିଲେ।
mc_answer2: ଟିକା ଯୋଗାଣରେ ବିଳମ୍ବ ଅପର୍ଯ୍ୟାପ୍ତ ପାଣ୍ଠି ଏବଂ ଅନ୍ୟାନ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତିଦ୍ୱନ୍ଦ୍ୱୀ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ପ୍ରାଥମିକତା ଯୋଗୁଁ ହୋଇଥିଲା।
mc_answer3: ମଶା ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ ପଦକ୍ଷେପଗୁଡ଼ିକର ବିଫଳତା ଯୋଗୁଁ ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ଏହି ପ୍ରକୋପ ଘଟିଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: Hong Kong Island gives the territory of Hong Kong its name and is the place that many tourists regard as the main focus. The parade of buildings that make the Hong Kong skyline has been likened to a glittering bar chart that is made apparent by the presence of the waters of Victoria Harbour. To get the best views of Hong Kong, leave the island and head for the Kowloon waterfront opposite. The great majority of Hong Kong Island's urban development is densely packed on reclaimed land along the northern shore. This is the place the British colonisers took as their own and so if you are looking for evidence of the territory's colonial past, this is a good place to start.

mc_answer3_en: It offers the best views of the Victoria Harbour skyline.

flores_passage_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital. The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years. The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center. Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel. Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences about Jerusalem's status as a tourist destination is most strongly supported by the text?
mc_answer1_en: It is the most visited city in Israel, surpassing Tel Aviv and Haifa.
mc_answer2_en: The crowded shopping centers are the main reason for its popularity among international tourists.
mc_answer3_en: Tourism is limited to specific religious holidays when the Old City is most accessible.
mc_answer4_en: It attracts visitors primarily due to its religious significance and historic sites.

flores_passage_en: "After its adoption by Congress on July 4, a handwritten draft signed by the President of Congress John Hancock and the Secretary Charles Thomson was then sent a few blocks away to the printing shop of John Dunlap. Through the night between 150 and 200 copies were made, now known as ""Dunlap broadsides"". The first public reading of the document was by John Nixon in the yard of Independence Hall on July 8. One was sent to George Washington on July 6, who had it read to his troops in New York on July 9. A copy reached London on August 10. The 25 Dunlap broadsides still known to exist are the oldest surviving copies of the document. The original handwritten copy has not survived."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is best supported by the evidence provided regarding the survival of early copies of the Declaration of Independence?
mc_answer1_en: George Washington received the first public reading of the Declaration of Independence, which led to the survival of his personal copy.
mc_answer2_en: Only 25 copies of the Declaration of Independence were ever printed during the initial run, as confirmed by surviving records from London.
mc_answer3_en: The Dunlap broadsides were distributed globally within weeks of the document's adoption, ensuring widespread preservation across multiple continents.
mc_answer4_en: The handwritten draft signed by John Hancock and Charles Thomson is no longer extant, while the earliest surviving copies are the Dunlap broadsides.
flores_passage: ଜୁଲାଇ ୪ ରେ କଂଗ୍ରେସ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଏହା ଗୃହୀତ ହେବା ପରେ, କଂଗ୍ରେସର ସଭାପତି ଜନ୍ ହାନକକ୍ ଏବଂ ସଚିବ ଚାର୍ଲ୍ସ ଥମସନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସ୍ୱାକ୍ଷରିତ ଏକ ହସ୍ତଲିଖିତ ଚିଠା କିଛି ବ୍ଲକ ଦୂରରେ ଥିବା ଜନ୍ ଡନଲପ୍‌ଙ୍କ ଛାପାଖାନାକୁ ପଠାଯାଇଥିଲା। ରାତିସାରା ୧୫୦ ରୁ ୨୦୦ ନକଲ ଛପା ଯାଇଥିଲା, ଯାହା ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ "ଡନଲପ୍ ବ୍ରଡସାଇଡ୍ସ" ଭାବରେ ଜଣାଶୁଣା। ଏହି ଦଲିଲର ପ୍ରଥମ ସର୍ବସାଧାରଣ ପାଠ ଜୁଲାଇ ୮ ରେ ଇଣ୍ଡିପେଣ୍ଡେନ୍ସ ହଲ୍ ପ୍ରାଙ୍ଗଣରେ ଜନ୍ ନିକ୍ସନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା କରାଯାଇଥିଲା। ଗୋଟିଏ ନକଲ ଜୁଲାଇ ୬ ରେ ଜର୍ଜ ୱାଶିଂଟନଙ୍କ ନିକଟକୁ ପଠାଯାଇଥିଲା, ଯିଏ ଏହାକୁ ଜୁଲାଇ ୯ ରେ ନ୍ୟୁୟର୍କରେ ତାଙ୍କ ସୈନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କୁ ପଢ଼ି ଶୁଣାଇଥିଲେ। ଗୋଟିଏ ନକଲ ଅଗଷ୍ଟ ୧୦ ରେ ଲଣ୍ଡନରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଥିଲା। ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ ତିଷ୍ଠି ରହିଥିବା ଜଣାପଡ଼ିଥିବା ୨୫ ଟି ଡନଲପ୍ ବ୍ରଡସାଇଡ୍ ହେଉଛି ଏହି ଦଲିଲର ସର୍ବପୁରାତନ ଜୀବନ୍ତ ନକଲ। ମୂଳ ହସ୍ତଲିଖିତ ନକଲଟି ତିଷ୍ଠି ରହିନାହିଁ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ସ୍ୱାଧୀନତା ଘୋଷଣାନାମାର ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ନକଲଗୁଡ଼ିକର ତିଷ୍ଠି ରହିବା ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧରେ ପ୍ରଦତ୍ତ ପ୍ରମାଣ ଦ୍ୱାରା ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷ ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ସମର୍ଥିତ?

flores_passage_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana. The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay. In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic. You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls. On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions best explains why a tourist might choose to visit Victoria Falls during the dry season rather than the rainy season?
mc_answer1_en: Tourists visiting in the dry season can expect warmer weather and more opportunities for extended sightseeing without getting wet.
mc_answer2_en: Tourists would find the bridge crossings safer and more accessible during the rainy season when water levels are higher.
mc_answer3_en: Tourists seeking to see the actual waterfall structure would prefer lower water volumes that reduce visual obstruction.
mc_answer4_en: Tourists would find the adventure activities more thrilling and less dangerous when the water volume is lower.

flores_passage_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king. Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration. Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible. The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo. Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions is most strongly supported by the author's statements regarding the tomb of Tutankhamun?
mc_answer1_en: Most visitors should prioritize seeing the mummy's head and shoulders over the other artifacts.
mc_answer2_en: The tomb's lack of decoration and visible damage to the mummy makes it less suitable for visitors with limited time.
mc_answer3_en: The Egyptian Museum in Cairo is the only place where the tomb's riches can be viewed, making it a less valuable site overall.
mc_answer4_en: The tomb is still considered the most important royal tomb in the Valley despite its small size.

flores_passage_en: The Sundarbans are the largest littoral mangrove belt in the world, stretching 80 km (50 mi) into the Bangladeshi and Indian hinterland from the coast. The Sundarbans has been declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The part of the forest within Indian territory is called Sundarbans National Park. The forests aren't just mangrove swamps though — they include some of the last remaining stands of the mighty jungles which once covered the Gangetic plain. The Sundarbans cover an area of 3,850 km², of which about one-third is covered in water/marsh areas. Since 1966 the Sundarbans have been a wildlife sanctuary, and it is estimated that there are now 400 Royal Bengal tigers and about 30,000 spotted deer in the area.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following conclusions can be most reasonably inferred about the ecological significance of the Sundarbans?
mc_answer1_en: The Sundarbans was established as a wildlife sanctuary before it was designated a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
mc_answer2_en: The Sundarbans is dominated by open water, with minimal terrestrial vegetation.
mc_answer3_en: The Sundarbans is primarily a tourist destination with limited conservation value.
mc_answer4_en: The Sundarbans serves as a critical habitat for endangered species and preserves unique terrestrial ecosystems.

flores_passage_en: The Iraq Study Group presented its report at 12.00 GMT today. It warns No one can guarantee that any course of action in Iraq at this point will stop sectarian warfare, growing violence, or a slide toward chaos. The Report opens with plea for open debate and the formation of a consensus in the United States about the policy towards the Middle East. The Report is highly critical of almost every aspect of the present policy of the Executive towards Iraq and it urges an immediate change of direction. First among its 78 recommendations is that a new diplomatic initiative should be taken before the end of this year to secure Iraq’s borders against hostile interventions and to re-establish diplomatic relations with its neighbors.
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following conclusions logically follows from the Iraq Study Group's report regarding the current situation in Iraq?
mc_answer1_en: The report asserts that the United States has successfully contained sectarian warfare through its present executive policy.
mc_answer2_en: The report concludes that the United States should cease all military operations in Iraq by the end of the year to prevent further chaos.
mc_answer3_en: The report implies that while no solution is guaranteed, the current trajectory of violence and sectarian conflict necessitates a fundamental shift in U.S. diplomatic strategy.
mc_answer4_en: The report suggests that the current U.S. policy is entirely ineffective and should be abandoned immediately.
flores_passage: ଇରାକ ଷ୍ଟଡି ଗ୍ରୁପ୍ ଆଜି 12.00 GMT ରେ ନିଜର ରିପୋର୍ଟ ଉପସ୍ଥାପନ କରିଛି। ଏହା ଚେତାବନୀ ଦେଇଛି ଯେ ଏହି ସମୟରେ ଇରାକରେ କୌଣସି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାନୁଷ୍ଠାନ ସାମ୍ପ୍ରଦାୟିକ ଯୁଦ୍ଧ, ବଢ଼ୁଥିବା ହିଂସା କିମ୍ବା ଅରାଜକତା ଆଡ଼କୁ ଗତିକୁ ରୋକିପାରିବ ବୋଲି କେହି ଗ୍ୟାରେଣ୍ଟି ଦେଇପାରିବେ ନାହିଁ। ଏହି ରିପୋର୍ଟ ମଧ୍ୟପ୍ରାଚ୍ୟ ପ୍ରତି ନୀତି ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ମୁକ୍ତ ବିତର୍କ ଏବଂ ଯୁକ୍ତରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର ଆମେରିକାରେ ଏକ ସହମତି ଗଠନ ପାଇଁ ନିବେଦନ ସହିତ ଆରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇଛି। ଏହି ରିପୋର୍ଟ ଇରାକ ପ୍ରତି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟନିର୍ବାହୀଙ୍କ ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନର ନୀତିର ପ୍ରାୟ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଦିଗକୁ ତୀବ୍ର ସମାଲୋଚନା କରେ ଏବଂ ଏହା ତୁରନ୍ତ ଦିଗ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ କରିବାକୁ ଆହ୍ୱାନ ଦିଏ। ଏହାର 78 ଟି ସୁପାରିଶ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ପ୍ରଥମଟି ହେଉଛି ଶତ୍ରୁତାପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ହସ୍ତକ୍ଷେପ ବିରୁଦ୍ଧରେ ଇରାକର ସୀମାକୁ ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ କରିବା ଏବଂ ଏହାର ପଡ଼ୋଶୀମାନଙ୍କ ସହିତ କୂଟନୈତିକ ସମ୍ପର୍କ ପୁନଃ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଚଳିତ ବର୍ଷ ଶେଷ ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଏକ ନୂତନ କୂଟନୈତିକ ପଦକ୍ଷେପ ନିଆଯିବା ଉଚିତ।
question: ଏହି ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଇରାକର ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନର ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ଇରାକ ଷ୍ଟଡି ଗ୍ରୁପ୍‌ର ରିପୋର୍ଟରୁ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷଟି ଯୁକ୍ତିଯୁକ୍ତ ଭାବରେ ଉପନୀତ ହୁଏ?

mc_answer2: ରିପୋର୍ଟ ଏହି ନିଷ୍କର୍ଷ ଦିଏ ଯେ ଯୁକ୍ତରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର ଆମେରିକା ଇରାକରେ ଅଧିକ ଅରାଜକତାକୁ ରୋକିବା ପାଇଁ ବର୍ଷ ଶେଷ ସୁଦ୍ଧା ସମସ୍ତ ସାମରିକ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାନୁଷ୍ଠାନ ବନ୍ଦ କରିବା ଉଚିତ।

flores_passage_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo. The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE. Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences about the relationship between European explorers and the Taíno population is best supported by the text?
mc_answer1_en: The arrival of European explorers led to a rapid and severe decline in the Taíno population due to actions by Spanish conquerors.
mc_answer2_en: The Spanish conquerors intentionally exterminated the Taíno population to clear land for colonial agriculture.
mc_answer3_en: The Taíno population was already declining before the arrival of European explorers due to internal conflicts with the Caribes.
mc_answer4_en: The Spanish conquerors and the Taíno population lived in relative peace for several decades after the initial arrival of European explorers.
flores_passage: ଡୋମିନିକାନ ରିପବ୍ଲିକ (ସ୍ପାନିଶ୍: República Dominicana) ଏକ କାରିବୀୟ ଦେଶ ଯାହା ହିସ୍ପାନିଓଲା ଦ୍ୱୀପର ପୂର୍ବ ଭାଗକୁ ଅଧିକାର କରେ, ଯାହା ଏହା ହାଇତି ସହିତ ଅଂଶୀଦାର କରେ। ଧଳା ବାଲିର ବେଳାଭୂମି ଏବଂ ପାର୍ବତ୍ୟ ପରିଦୃଶ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟତୀତ, ଏହି ଦେଶ ଆମେରିକାର ସର୍ବପୁରାତନ ୟୁରୋପୀୟ ସହରର ବାସସ୍ଥଳୀ, ଯାହା ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ ସାଣ୍ଟୋ ଡୋମିଙ୍ଗୋର ଏକ ଅଂଶ। ଏହି ଦ୍ୱୀପରେ ପ୍ରଥମେ ଟାଇନୋ ଏବଂ କାରିବ୍ ଲୋକମାନେ ବାସ କରୁଥିଲେ। କାରିବ୍ ମାନେ ଏକ ଆରାୱାକାନ୍ ଭାଷାଭାଷୀ ଲୋକ ଥିଲେ ଯେଉଁମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟ ୧୦,୦୦୦ ଖ୍ରୀଷ୍ଟପୂର୍ବରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଥିଲେ। ୟୁରୋପୀୟ ଅନୁସନ୍ଧାନକାରୀଙ୍କ ଆଗମନର କିଛି ବର୍ଷ ମଧ୍ୟରେ, ସ୍ପେନୀୟ ବିଜେତାମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଟାଇନୋଙ୍କ ଜନସଂଖ୍ୟା ଯଥେଷ୍ଟ ହ୍ରାସ ପାଇଥିଲା। ଫ୍ରେ ବାର୍ଥୋଲୋମେ ଡେ ଲାସ୍ କାସାସ୍ (ଟ୍ରାଟାଡୋ ଡେ ଲାସ୍ ଇଣ୍ଡିଆସ୍)ଙ୍କ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ୧୪୯୨ ଏବଂ ୧୪୯୮ ମଧ୍ୟରେ ସ୍ପେନୀୟ ବିଜେତାମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟ ୧,୦୦,୦୦୦ ଟାଇନୋଙ୍କୁ ହତ୍ୟା କରିଥିଲେ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ୟୁରୋପୀୟ ଅନୁସନ୍ଧାନକାରୀ ଏବଂ ଟାଇନୋ ଜନସଂଖ୍ୟା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଥିବା ସମ୍ପର୍କ ବିଷୟରେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ଅନୁମାନ ପାଠ୍ୟ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ସମର୍ଥିତ?

flores_passage_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas. The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society. However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture. There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand. They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following best explains why the traditional theory about the Great Fleet migrating from Polynesia is now considered inaccurate?
mc_answer1_en: The Great Fleet theory has been disproven because no archaeological evidence of migration from Polynesia has ever been found.
mc_answer2_en: The Maori people who migrated from Polynesia established an agricultural society that was entirely different from the culture of the Moriori.
mc_answer3_en: The Moriori were wiped out by a different tribe of Maori who migrated to the Chatham Islands, which had no connection to the Great Fleet.
mc_answer4_en: New evidence indicates that the Moriori were not a separate group taken from by the Maori but rather a branch of mainland Maori who migrated to the Chatham Islands.
flores_passage: ଊନବିଂଶ ଏବଂ ବିଂଶ ଶତାବ୍ଦୀରେ ଏକ ଦୀର୍ଘ ସମୟ ଧରି ଏହା ବିଶ୍ୱାସ କରାଯାଉଥିଲା ଯେ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡର ପ୍ରଥମ ବାସିନ୍ଦା ମାଓରୀ ଲୋକ ଥିଲେ, ଯେଉଁମାନେ ମୋଆ ନାମକ ବିଶାଳ ପକ୍ଷୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ଶିକାର କରୁଥିଲେ। ପରେ ଏହି ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଧାରଣା ଦେଇଥିଲା ଯେ ମାଓରୀ ଲୋକମାନେ ପଲିନେସିଆରୁ ଏକ ବିଶାଳ ନୌବହର (ଗ୍ରେଟ୍ ଫ୍ଲିଟ୍) ଯୋଗେ ପ୍ରବାସ କରିଥିଲେ ଏବଂ ଏକ କୃଷି ସମାଜ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରି ମୋରିଓରୀଙ୍କଠାରୁ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡ ଅଧିକାର କରିନେଇଥିଲେ। ତଥାପି, ନୂତନ ପ୍ରମାଣରୁ ଜଣାପଡ଼େ ଯେ ମୋରିଓରୀମାନେ ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଭୂଖଣ୍ଡର ମାଓରୀମାନଙ୍କର ଏକ ଗୋଷ୍ଠୀ ଥିଲେ, ଯେଉଁମାନେ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡରୁ ଚାଥାମ ଦ୍ୱୀପପୁଞ୍ଜକୁ ପ୍ରବାସ କରି ନିଜର ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର, ଶାନ୍ତିପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ସଂସ୍କୃତି ବିକଶିତ କରିଥିଲେ। ଚାଥାମ ଦ୍ୱୀପପୁଞ୍ଜରେ ଅନ୍ୟ ଏକ ଜନଜାତି ମଧ୍ୟ ଥିଲେ, ଏମାନେ ମାଓରୀ ଥିଲେ ଯେଉଁମାନେ ନ୍ୟୁଜିଲ୍ୟାଣ୍ଡରୁ ଚାଲିଆସିଥିଲେ। ସେମାନେ ନିଜକୁ ମୋରିଓରୀ ବୋଲି କହୁଥିଲେ; ସେଠାରେ କିଛି ସଂଘର୍ଷ ହୋଇଥିଲା ଏବଂ ଶେଷରେ ମୋରିଓରୀମାନେ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବେ ନିଶ୍ଚିହ୍ନ ହୋଇଯାଇଥିଲେ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ପଲିନେସିଆରୁ ପ୍ରବାସ କରିଥିବା ଗ୍ରେଟ୍ ଫ୍ଲିଟ୍ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତକୁ ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନ କାହିଁକି ଭୁଲ ବୋଲି ବିବେଚନା କରାଯାଏ, ତାହା ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା କରେ?
mc_answer1: ଗ୍ରେଟ୍ ଫ୍ଲିଟ୍ ସିଦ୍ଧାନ୍ତ ଭୁଲ ପ୍ରମାଣିତ ହୋଇଛି କାରଣ ପଲିନେସିଆରୁ ପ୍ରବାସର କୌଣସି ପ୍ରତ୍ନତାତ୍ତ୍ୱିକ ପ୍ରମାଣ କେବେ ମିଳିନାହିଁ।
mc_answer2: ପଲିନେସିଆରୁ ପ୍ରବାସ କରିଥିବା ମାଓରୀ ଲୋକମାନେ ଏକ କୃଷି ସମାଜ ପ୍ରତିଷ୍ଠା କରିଥିଲେ ଯାହା ମୋରିଓରୀ ସଂସ୍କୃତିଠାରୁ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭିନ୍ନ ଥିଲା।

flores_passage_en: In France, voting has traditionally been a low-tech experience: voters isolate themselves in a booth, put a pre-printed sheet of paper indicating their candidate of choice into an envelope. After officials verify the voter's identity, the voter drops the envelope into the ballot box and signs the voting roll. French electoral law rather strictly codifies the proceedings. Since 1988, ballot boxes must be transparent so that voters and observers can witness that no envelopes are present at the start of the vote and that no envelopes are added except those of the duly counted and authorized voters. Candidates can send representatives to witness every part of the process. In the evening, votes are counted by volunteers under heavy supervision, following specific procedures.
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following inferences is most strongly supported by the strict codification of French electoral proceedings?
mc_answer1_en: It prevents candidates from sending representatives to witness any part of the process.
mc_answer2_en: It primarily serves to reduce the cost of elections by minimizing the need for technology.
mc_answer3_en: It guarantees that all voters will be present at the polling stations to verify their identity.
mc_answer4_en: It ensures that the voting process remains consistent and verifiable across different locations and times.

flores_passage_en: "Blogs can also help improve student writing. While students often begin their blog experience with sloppy grammar and spelling, the presence of an audience generally changes that. Since students are often the most critical audience, the blog writer begins to strive to improve writing to avoid criticism. Also blogging ""forces students to become more savvy about the world around them."" The need to feed the interest of the audience inspires students to be clever and interesting (Toto, 2004). Blogging is a tool that inspires collaboration, and encourages students to extend learning well beyond the traditional school day. Appropriate use of blogs ""can empower students to become more analytical and critical; through actively responding to Internet materials, students can define their positions in the context of others' writings as well as outline their own perspectives on particular issues (Oravec, 2002)."
question_en: According to the passage, what is the most likely outcome for students who actively engage with blogging beyond just writing initial drafts?
mc_answer1_en: They will become less interested in school subjects because blogging extends learning beyond the classroom.
mc_answer2_en: They will rely solely on their peers for feedback rather than seeking out external internet materials.

flores_passage: ବ୍ଲଗ୍ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କ ଲେଖାରେ ଉନ୍ନତି ଆଣିବାରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିପାରେ। ଯଦିଓ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ତ୍ରୁଟିପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ବ୍ୟାକରଣ ଏବଂ ବନାନ ସହିତ ସେମାନଙ୍କର ବ୍ଲଗ୍ ଅନୁଭୂତି ଆରମ୍ଭ କରନ୍ତି, ପାଠକଙ୍କ ଉପସ୍ଥିତି ସାଧାରଣତଃ ଏଥିରେ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଆଣିଥାଏ। ଯେହେତୁ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନେ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ସବୁଠାରୁ କଠୋର ସମାଲୋଚକ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତି, ତେଣୁ ବ୍ଲଗ୍ ଲେଖକ ସମାଲୋଚନାକୁ ଏଡ଼ାଇବା ପାଇଁ ଲେଖାରେ ଉନ୍ନତି ଆଣିବାକୁ ଚେଷ୍ଟା କରନ୍ତି। ଏହା ସହିତ ବ୍ଲଗିଂ "ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ଚାରିପାଖର ଦୁନିଆ ବିଷୟରେ ଅଧିକ ଜ୍ଞାନୀ ଓ ସଚେତନ ହେବାକୁ ପ୍ରେରିତ କରେ।" ପାଠକଙ୍କ ଆଗ୍ରହ ବଜାୟ ରଖିବାର ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ଚତୁର ଏବଂ ଆକର୍ଷଣୀୟ ହେବା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରେରଣା ଯୋଗାଏ (ଟୋଟୋ, 2004)। ବ୍ଲଗିଂ ହେଉଛି ଏକ ମାଧ୍ୟମ ଯାହା ସହଯୋଗକୁ ପ୍ରୋତ୍ସାହିତ କରେ ଏବଂ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ପାରମ୍ପରିକ ବିଦ୍ୟାଳୟ ସମୟ ବାହାରେ ମଧ୍ୟ ଶିକ୍ଷଣକୁ ବିସ୍ତାର କରିବାକୁ ଉତ୍ସାହିତ କରେ। ବ୍ଲଗଗୁଡ଼ିକର ଉପଯୁକ୍ତ ବ୍ୟବହାର "ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନଙ୍କୁ ଅଧିକ ବିଶ୍ଳେଷଣାତ୍ମକ ଏବଂ ସମାଲୋଚନାମୂଳକ ହେବା ପାଇଁ ସଶକ୍ତ କରିପାରେ; ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ ସାମଗ୍ରୀ ଉପରେ ସକ୍ରିୟ ଭାବରେ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଦେଇ ଛାତ୍ରଛାତ୍ରୀମାନେ ଅନ୍ୟମାନଙ୍କ ଲେଖା ପରିପ୍ରେକ୍ଷୀରେ ନିଜର ସ୍ଥିତି ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ କରିପାରିବେ ଏବଂ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପ୍ରସଙ୍ଗରେ ନିଜର ଦୃଷ୍ଟିକୋଣ ଉପସ୍ଥାପନ କରିପାରିବେ (ଓରାଭେକ୍, 2002)।"

flores_passage_en: "One of the most common methods used to illustrate the importance of socialization is to draw upon the few unfortunate cases of children who were, through neglect, misfortune, or wilful abuse, not socialized by adults while they were growing up. Such children are called ""feral"" or wild. Some feral children have been confined by people (usually their own parents); in some cases this child abandonment was due to the parents' rejection of a child's severe intellectual or physical impairment. Feral children may have experienced severe child abuse or trauma before being abandoned or running away. Others are alleged to have been brought up by animals; some are said to have lived in the wild on their own. When completely brought up by non-human animals, the feral child exhibits behaviors (within physical limits) almost entirely like those of the particular care-animal, such as its fear of or indifference to humans."
question_en: Based on the passage, which of the following statements best represents an inference that logically follows from the description of feral children's behaviors when raised by non-human animals?
mc_answer1_en: Feral children raised by animals have no fear of humans because they were never exposed to people.
mc_answer2_en: Feral children raised by animals are more likely to be found in urban environments than in rural areas.
mc_answer3_en: Feral children raised by animals are unable to develop any form of communication.
mc_answer4_en: Feral children raised by animals often struggle to adapt to human society due to learned behaviors that mirror their care-animal.
flores_passage: ସାମାଜିକୀକରଣର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ବୁଝାଇବା ପାଇଁ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ଏକ ସବୁଠାରୁ ସାଧାରଣ ପଦ୍ଧତି ହେଉଛି ସେହି କିଛି ଦୁର୍ଭାଗ୍ୟଜନକ ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କ ଉଦାହରଣ ନେବା, ଯେଉଁମାନେ ଅବହେଳା, ଦୁର୍ଭାଗ୍ୟ କିମ୍ବା ଇଚ୍ଛାକୃତ ନିର୍ଯାତନା ଯୋଗୁଁ ବଡ଼ ହେବା ସମୟରେ ବୟସ୍କମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସାମାଜିକୀକରଣରୁ ବଞ୍ଚିତ ହୋଇଥିଲେ। ଏହିପରି ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କୁ "ଫେରାଲ" (ଅସାମାଜିକ) କିମ୍ବା ବନ୍ୟ କୁହାଯାଏ। କେତେକ ବନ୍ୟ ପିଲାଙ୍କୁ ଲୋକମାନେ (ସାଧାରଣତଃ ସେମାନଙ୍କ ନିଜ ପିତାମାତା) ଆବଦ୍ଧ କରି ରଖିଥାନ୍ତି; କେତେକ କ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ ପିଲାଟିର ଗୁରୁତର ବୌଦ୍ଧିକ କିମ୍ବା ଶାରୀରିକ ଅକ୍ଷମତାକୁ ପିତାମାତା ଗ୍ରହଣ ନ କରିବା ଯୋଗୁଁ ପିଲାଟିକୁ ପରିତ୍ୟାଗ କରିଦିଆଯାଇଥିଲା। ବନ୍ୟ ପିଲାମାନେ ପରିତ୍ୟକ୍ତ ହେବା କିମ୍ବା ପଳାଇବା ପୂର୍ବରୁ ଗୁରୁତର ଶିଶୁ ନିର୍ଯାତନା କିମ୍ବା ମାନସିକ ଆଘାତର ସମ୍ମୁଖୀନ ହୋଇଥାଇପାରନ୍ତି। ଅନ୍ୟ କେତେକ ପଶୁମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ଲାଳିତପାଳିତ ହୋଇଥିବା କୁହାଯାଏ; ଆଉ କେତେକ ନିଜେ ଏକାକୀ ଜଙ୍ଗଲରେ ବାସ କରିଥିବା କୁହାଯାଏ। ଯେତେବେଳେ ଅଣ-ମାନବ ପ୍ରାଣୀମାନଙ୍କ ଦ୍ୱାରା ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବରେ ଲାଳନପାଳନ କରାଯାଏ, ସେତେବେଳେ ସେହି ବନ୍ୟ ପିଲାଟି (ଶାରୀରିକ ସୀମା ମଧ୍ୟରେ) ପ୍ରାୟ ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବରେ ସେହି ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ପାଳନକାରୀ ପଶୁ ପରି ଆଚରଣ ପ୍ରଦର୍ଶନ କରେ, ଯେପରିକି ମଣିଷ ପ୍ରତି ଭୟ କିମ୍ବା ଉଦାସୀନତା।

flores_passage_en: "Technological determinism is a term that encompasses a wide range of ideas in practice, from technology-push or the technological imperative to a strict sense that human destiny is driven by an underlying logic associated with scientific laws and their manifestation in technology. Most interpretations of technological determinism share two general ideas: that the development of technology itself follows a path largely beyond cultural or political influence, and that technology in turn has ""effects"" on societies that are inherent, rather than socially conditioned. For example, one might say that the motor car necessarily leads to the development of roads. However, a nationwide road network is not economically viable for just a handful of cars, so new methods of production are developed to reduce the cost of car ownership. Mass car ownership also leads to a higher incidence of accidents on the roads, which leads to the invention of new techniques in healthcare for repairing damaged bodies."
question_en: According to the passage, which of the following best describes the relationship between technological determinism and the development of a nationwide road network?
mc_answer1_en: The passage argues that technological determinism is fully supported by the example of the motor car and road network.
mc_answer2_en: The motor car's development is independent of production methods and healthcare advancements, aligning with strict technological determinism.
mc_answer3_en: Technological determinism implies that societal needs and economic factors shape the development of technology, contradicting the notion of inherent technological effects.
mc_answer4_en: Technological determinism suggests that the invention of the motor car automatically creates the need for roads, regardless of economic conditions.

flores_passage: ବୁଧବାର ଦିନ, ଯୁକ୍ତରାଷ୍ଟ୍ର ଆମେରିକାର ନ୍ୟାସନାଲ ବାସ୍କେଟବଲ୍ ଆସୋସିଏସନ୍ (ଏନବିଏ) କୋଭିଡ-୧୯ ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ଚିନ୍ତା ହେତୁ ଏହାର ବୃତ୍ତିଗତ ବାସ୍କେଟବଲ୍ ସିଜିନ୍‌କୁ ସ୍ଥଗିତ ରଖିଥିଲା। ୟୁଟା ଜାଜ୍‌ର ଜଣେ ଖେଳାଳି କୋଭିଡ-୧୯ ଭୂତାଣୁ ପାଇଁ ପଜିଟିଭ୍ ଚିହ୍ନଟ ହେବା ପରେ ଏନବିଏ ଏହି ନିଷ୍ପତ୍ତି ନେଇଥିଲା।
question: ଏହି ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି, ଯଦି ୟୁଟା ଜାଜ୍‌ର ଖେଳାଳି କୋଭିଡ-୧୯ ପାଇଁ ପଜିଟିଭ୍ ଚିହ୍ନଟ ହୋଇନଥାନ୍ତେ, ତେବେ ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ଫଳାଫଳକୁ ସର୍ବୋତ୍ତମ ଭାବରେ ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା କରେ?
mc_answer1: ଏନବିଏ ତୁରନ୍ତ ୟୁଟା ଜାଜ୍ ଦଳକୁ ଲିଗ୍‌ରୁ ବାସନ୍ଦ କରିଥାନ୍ତା।

mc_answer1_en: The rescuer would be rewarded for their quick response time.
mc_answer2_en: The rescuer might become injured themselves, potentially worsening the overall situation.
mc_answer3_en: The victim would immediately recover once the rescuer reached them.

question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଯଦି ଜଣେ ଉଦ୍ଧାରକାରୀ ପ୍ରାରମ୍ଭିକ ଘଟଣାସ୍ଥଳ ନିରୀକ୍ଷଣକୁ ଏଡ଼ାଇ ଦେଇ ସୁରକ୍ଷା ଆକଳନ ନ କରି ତୁରନ୍ତ ପୀଡ଼ିତଙ୍କ ନିକଟକୁ ଯାଆନ୍ତି, ତେବେ ସମ୍ଭବତଃ କ'ଣ ଘଟିବ?
mc_answer1: ଉଦ୍ଧାରକାରୀଙ୍କୁ ତାଙ୍କର ତ୍ୱରିତ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ସମୟ ପାଇଁ ପୁରସ୍କୃତ କରାଯିବ।

mc_answer3: ଉଦ୍ଧାରକାରୀ ପହଞ୍ଚିବା ମାତ୍ରେ ପୀଡ଼ିତ ତୁରନ୍ତ ସୁସ୍ଥ ହୋଇଯିବେ।
mc_answer4: ଉଦ୍ଧାରକାରୀ ସ୍ୱତଃସ୍ଫୂର୍ତ୍ତ ଭାବରେ ପୀଡ଼ିତଙ୍କ ଚାରିପାଖରେ ଥିବା ସମସ୍ତ ବିପଦ ସଙ୍କେତ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରିବାରେ ସକ୍ଷମ ହେବେ।

flores_passage_en: At its peak, Tropical Cyclone Gonu, named for a bag of palm leaves in the language of the Maldives, reached sustained winds of 240 kilometers an hour (149 miles per hour) . By early today, winds were around 83 km/h, and it was expect to keep weakening.
question_en: If Tropical Cyclone Gonu had not reached sustained winds of 240 kilometers an hour at its peak, what would most likely have been the consequence based on the passage?
mc_answer1_en: The cyclone would have weakened more slowly than it did by early today.
mc_answer2_en: The cyclone would not have been named Gonu, as the name is tied to its peak intensity.
mc_answer3_en: The cyclone's peak intensity would have been lower, but it would still have weakened by early today.
mc_answer4_en: The cyclone would have strengthened further instead of weakening by early today.
flores_passage: ଏହାର ଚରମ ସୀମାରେ, ମାଳଦ୍ୱୀପର ଭାଷାରେ ତାଳପତ୍ରର ଏକ ବ୍ୟାଗ୍ ନାମରେ ନାମିତ ଗ୍ରୀଷ୍ମମଣ୍ଡଳୀୟ ବାତ୍ୟା ଗୋନୁର ନିରନ୍ତର ପବନର ବେଗ ଘଣ୍ଟା ପ୍ରତି ୨୪୦ କିଲୋମିଟର (ଘଣ୍ଟା ପ୍ରତି ୧୪୯ ମାଇଲ) ରେ ପହଞ୍ଚିଥିଲା। ଆଜି ସକାଳ ସୁଦ୍ଧା, ପବନର ବେଗ ପ୍ରାୟ ୮୩ କିମି/ଘଣ୍ଟା ଥିଲା, ଏବଂ ଏହା ଆହୁରି ଦୁର୍ବଳ ହୋଇଚାଲିବ ବୋଲି ଆଶା କରାଯାଉଥିଲା।
question: ଯଦି ଗ୍ରୀଷ୍ମମଣ୍ଡଳୀୟ ବାତ୍ୟା ଗୋନୁ ଏହାର ଶୀର୍ଷ ସମୟରେ ଘଣ୍ଟା ପ୍ରତି ୨୪୦ କିଲୋମିଟରର ନିରନ୍ତର ପବନର ବେଗରେ ପହଞ୍ଚି ନ ଥାନ୍ତା, ତେବେ ପରିଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ପରିଣାମ କ'ଣ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା?
mc_answer1: ଆଜି ସକାଳ ସୁଦ୍ଧା ଯେତିକି ଦୁର୍ବଳ ହୋଇଥିଲା, ବାତ୍ୟାଟି ତା' ଅପେକ୍ଷା ଅଧିକ ଧୀରେ ଧୀରେ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା।
mc_answer2: ବାତ୍ୟାର ନାମ ଗୋନୁ ରଖାଯାଇ ନ ଥାନ୍ତା, କାରଣ ଏହି ନାମଟି ଏହାର ସର୍ବୋଚ୍ଚ ତୀବ୍ରତା ସହିତ ଜଡ଼ିତ।
mc_answer3: ବାତ୍ୟାର ସର୍ବୋଚ୍ଚ ତୀବ୍ରତା କମ୍ ରହିଥାନ୍ତା, କିନ୍ତୁ ଆଜି ସକାଳ ସୁଦ୍ଧା ତଥାପି ଏହା ଦୁର୍ବଳ ହୋଇଯାଇଥାନ୍ତା।
mc_answer4: ଆଜି ସକାଳ ସୁଦ୍ଧା ଦୁର୍ବଳ ହେବା ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତେ ବାତ୍ୟାଟି ଆହୁରି ଅଧିକ ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତା।

flores_passage_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed. These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.
question_en: According to the passage, if nerve impulses were unable to be sent quickly throughout the body, what would most likely occur as a consequence?
mc_answer1_en: Blood flow would increase automatically to compensate for the slower nerve signals
mc_answer2_en: The body would be more vulnerable to potential threats due to delayed responses
mc_answer3_en: Homeostasis would improve because slower impulses allow for more stable blood flow
mc_answer4_en: The nervous system would stop functioning entirely and blood would stop flowing
flores_passage: ସ୍ନାୟୁ ତନ୍ତ୍ର ସମଗ୍ର ଶରୀରକୁ ସ୍ନାୟୁ ଆବେଗ (ନର୍ଭ ଇମ୍ପଲସ୍) ପଠାଇ ରକ୍ତ ପ୍ରବାହକୁ ନିରନ୍ତର ତଥା ଅବିଚ୍ଛିନ୍ନ ରଖି ହୋମିଓଷ୍ଟାସିସ୍ ବଜାୟ ରଖିଥାଏ। ଏହି ସ୍ନାୟୁ ଆବେଗଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସମଗ୍ର ଶରୀରରେ ଅତି ଶୀଘ୍ର ପଠାଯାଇପାରେ, ଯାହା ଶରୀରକୁ ଯେକୌଣସି ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ବିପଦରୁ ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ ରଖିବାରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରେ।
question: ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଯଦି ସ୍ନାୟୁ ଆବେଗଗୁଡ଼ିକ ସମଗ୍ର ଶରୀରରେ ଶୀଘ୍ର ପଠାଯାଇ ନ ପାରେ, ତେବେ ଏହାର ପରିଣାମ ସ୍ୱରୂପ କ'ଣ ଘଟିବାର ସର୍ବାଧିକ ସମ୍ଭାବନା ରହିଛି?
mc_answer1: ଧୀର ସ୍ନାୟୁ ସଙ୍କେତର ଭରଣା କରିବା ପାଇଁ ରକ୍ତ ପ୍ରବାହ ସ୍ୱୟଂଚାଳିତ ଭାବରେ ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇବ
mc_answer2: ବିଳମ୍ବିତ ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଯୋଗୁଁ ଶରୀର ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ବିପଦ ପ୍ରତି ଅଧିକ ଅସୁରକ୍ଷିତ ହୋଇପଡ଼ିବ
mc_answer3: ହୋମିଓଷ୍ଟାସିସ୍ ଉନ୍ନତ ହେବ କାରଣ ଧୀର ଆବେଗ ଅଧିକ ସ୍ଥିର ରକ୍ତ ପ୍ରବାହକୁ ଅନୁମତି ଦିଏ
mc_answer4: ସ୍ନାୟୁ ତନ୍ତ୍ର ସମ୍ପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଭାବେ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିବା ବନ୍ଦ କରିଦେବ ଏବଂ ରକ୍ତ ପ୍ରବାହ ବନ୍ଦ ହୋଇଯିବ

flores_passage_en: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights. The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee. Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.
question_en: If the airport fire vehicle had not rolled over while responding, which of the following would most likely have been a different outcome based on the passage?
mc_answer1_en: Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee would not have been identified as the pilot.
mc_answer2_en: The pilot would have escaped the explosion unharmed.
mc_answer3_en: The Gripen would not have exploded upon impact.
mc_answer4_en: Commercial flights could have resumed sooner, as emergency response efficiency would have improved.
flores_passage: ଜେଏଏସ୍ ୩୯ସି ଗ୍ରିପେନ୍ ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ସମୟ ପ୍ରାୟ ସକାଳ ୯:୩୦ (୦୨୩୦ ୟୁଟିସି) ରେ ଏକ ରନୱେ ଉପରେ ଦୁର୍ଘଟଣାଗ୍ରସ୍ତ ହୋଇ ବିସ୍ଫୋରିତ ହୋଇଥିଲା, ଯାହା ଫଳରେ ବିମାନବନ୍ଦରକୁ ବାଣିଜ୍ୟିକ ଉଡ଼ାଣ ପାଇଁ ବନ୍ଦ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା। ପାଇଲଟଙ୍କୁ ସ୍କ୍ୱାଡ୍ରନ୍ ଲିଡର ଦିଲୋକ୍ରିତ ପଟ୍ଟାଭି ବୋଲି ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରାଯାଇଥିଲା। ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ଗଣମାଧ୍ୟମ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ, ଘଟଣାସ୍ଥଳକୁ ଯାଉଥିବା ସମୟରେ ବିମାନବନ୍ଦରର ଏକ ଅଗ୍ନିଶମ ଗାଡ଼ି ଓଲଟି ପଡ଼ିଥିଲା।
question: ଯଦି ଘଟଣାସ୍ଥଳକୁ ଯିବା ସମୟରେ ବିମାନବନ୍ଦରର ଅଗ୍ନିଶମ ଗାଡ଼ି ଓଲଟି ପଡ଼ି ନ ଥାନ୍ତା, ତେବେ ପରିଚ୍ଛେଦ ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁଟି ଏକ ଭିନ୍ନ ପରିଣାମ ହେବାର ସର୍ବାଧିକ ସମ୍ଭାବନା ଥାନ୍ତା?
mc_answer1: ସ୍କ୍ୱାଡ୍ରନ୍ ଲିଡର ଦିଲୋକ୍ରିତ ପଟ୍ଟାଭିଙ୍କୁ ପାଇଲଟ୍ ଭାବେ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରାଯାଇ ନ ଥାନ୍ତା।
mc_answer2: ପାଇଲଟ୍ ବିନା କୌଣସି କ୍ଷତିରେ ବିସ୍ଫୋରଣରୁ ବର୍ତ୍ତି ଯାଇଥାନ୍ତେ।
mc_answer3: ଧକ୍କା ହେବା ମାତ୍ରେ ଗ୍ରିପେନ୍ ବିସ୍ଫୋରିତ ହୋଇ ନ ଥାନ୍ତା।
mc_answer4: ବାଣିଜ୍ୟିକ ଉଡ଼ାଣ ଶୀଘ୍ର ପୁନରାରମ୍ଭ ହୋଇପାରିଥାନ୍ତା, କାରଣ ଜରୁରୀକାଳୀନ କାର୍ଯ୍ୟାନୁଷ୍ଠାନର ଦକ୍ଷତା ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇଥାନ୍ତା।

length_matched_passage: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights. The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee. Local media reports an airport fire
judge_errors_in_loser: Wrong aircraft model (GS/Griffin), added unrequested fire details.

flores_passage_en: Virtually all computers in use today are based on the manipulation of information which is coded in the form of binary numbers. A binary number can have only one of two values, i.e. 0 or 1, and these numbers are referred to as binary digits - or bits, to use computer jargon.
question_en: If computers had been designed to operate using a ternary system (using three values: 0, 1, and 2) instead of a binary system, which of the following consequences would most likely follow based on the passage's description of how modern computers function?
mc_answer1_en: The fundamental nature of information manipulation would remain unchanged, but the system would be slower due to increased complexity in switching between three states.
mc_answer2_en: Computers would require fewer physical components to represent the same amount of information, as each digit could carry more data than a single bit.
mc_answer3_en: Computers would be unable to process any information at all, because the passage states that all current computers rely exclusively on the two-value binary system.
mc_answer4_en: The binary digits would become irrelevant, and computers would need to develop a completely new type of information code that is unrelated to numerical values.
flores_passage: ଆଜି ବ୍ୟବହାରରେ ଥିବା ପ୍ରାୟ ସମସ୍ତ କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର ବାଇନାରୀ ସଂଖ୍ୟା ଆକାରରେ କୋଡ୍ ହୋଇଥିବା ସୂଚନାର ପରିଚାଳନା ଉପରେ ଆଧାରିତ। ଏକ ବାଇନାରୀ ସଂଖ୍ୟାର କେବଳ ଦୁଇଟି ମାନ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ ଗୋଟିଏ ଥାଇପାରେ, ଯଥା ୦ କିମ୍ବା ୧, ଏବଂ କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର ଭାଷାରେ ଏହି ସଂଖ୍ୟାଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ବାଇନାରୀ ଡିଜିଟ୍ — ବା ବିଟ୍ ବୋଲି କୁହାଯାଏ।
question: ଯଦି କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଏକ ବାଇନାରୀ ସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତେ ଏକ ଟର୍ନାରୀ ସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ (ତିନୋଟି ମାନ: ୦, ୧ ଏବଂ ୨ ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି) ବ୍ୟବହାର କରି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ଡିଜାଇନ୍ କରାଯାଇଥାନ୍ତା, ତେବେ ଆଧୁନିକ କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟରଗୁଡ଼ିକ କିପରି କାର୍ଯ୍ୟ କରେ ସେ ସମ୍ପର୍କରେ ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦର ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା ଉପରେ ଆଧାର କରି ନିମ୍ନଲିଖିତ ମଧ୍ୟରୁ କେଉଁ ପରିଣାମଟି ଘଟିବାର ସର୍ବାଧିକ ସମ୍ଭାବନା ଅଛି?
mc_answer1: ସୂଚନା ପରିଚାଳନାର ମୌଳିକ ସ୍ୱରୂପ ଅପରିବର୍ତ୍ତିତ ରହିବ, କିନ୍ତୁ ତିନୋଟି ଅବସ୍ଥା ମଧ୍ୟରେ ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ କରିବାରେ ଜଟିଳତା ବୃଦ୍ଧି ପାଇବା ହେତୁ ସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ ଧୀର ହୋଇଯିବ।
mc_answer2: ସମାନ ପରିମାଣର ସୂଚନା ଉପସ୍ଥାପନ କରିବା ପାଇଁ କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟରଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ କମ୍ ଭୌତିକ ଉପାଦାନ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ ହେବ, କାରଣ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଅଙ୍କ ଏକକ ବିଟ୍ ତୁଳନାରେ ଅଧିକ ତଥ୍ୟ ବହନ କରିପାରିବ।
mc_answer3: କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟରଗୁଡ଼ିକ କୌଣସି ସୂଚନା ପ୍ରକ୍ରିୟାକରଣ କରିବାକୁ ଆଦୌ ସମର୍ଥ ହେବେ ନାହିଁ, କାରଣ ଅନୁଚ୍ଛେଦରେ କୁହାଯାଇଛି ଯେ ବର୍ତ୍ତମାନର ସମସ୍ତ କମ୍ପ୍ୟୁଟର କେବଳ ଦୁଇ-ମାନ ବିଶିଷ୍ଟ ବାଇନାରୀ ସିଷ୍ଟମ୍ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରନ୍ତି।

flores_passage_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam. flores_passage_en: Twentieth century research has shown that there are two pools of genetic variation: hidden and expressed. Mutation adds new genetic variation, and selection removes it from the pool of expressed variation. Segregation and recombination shuffle variation back and forth between the two pools with each generation.
question_en: Based on the passage, what would most likely happen to the pool of expressed genetic variation if mutation ceased to occur while selection continued to remove variation?
mc_answer1_en: The pool of expressed variation would shift entirely into the hidden pool without affecting selection.
mc_answer2_en: The pool of expressed variation would gradually diminish until no new variation was available.
mc_answer3_en: The pool of expressed variation would increase as recombination creates new variants.
mc_answer4_en: The pool of expressed variation would remain constant over time.

flores_passage_en: "Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau. No immediate reports of damage have been received by the United States Geological Survey (USGS) and its National Earthquake Information Center. The earthquake was centered about 20 km (15 miles) north-northeast of Dillon, and about 65 km (40 miles) south of Butte.
question_en: If the earthquake had not occurred at 10:08 p.m. on Monday, which of the following outcomes would most likely have been true regarding the United States Geological Survey (USGS)?

mc_answer2_en: The USGS would have sent emergency teams to Butte.
mc_answer3_en: The USGS would have immediately reported significant structural damage.
mc_answer4_en: The USGS would have received reports of damage from Montana residents.

flores_passage_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater. Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose. The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.
question_en: If the Luno had not broken down, which of the following outcomes would most likely have occurred?
mc_answer1_en: Officials would have known the vessel was going to break down before it happened.
mc_answer2_en: High winds and waves would have forced the ship to seek an alternate route regardless of the breakdown.
mc_answer3_en: The ship would have successfully picked up its fertiliser cargo without incident.
mc_answer4_en: The twelve crewmembers would have been rescued by helicopters immediately upon departure.

question_en: If Nigeria had not announced its intention to join the AfCFTA in the week leading up to the summit, what would most likely have been the consequence based on the passage's context regarding the framework's readiness?

mc_answer3_en: The rules of origin and tariff concessions would have been immediately agreed upon.
mc_answer4_en: The framework would not have been sufficient to start trading on July 1, 2020.

flores_passage_en: Romanticism had a large element of cultural determinism, drawn from writers such as Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel. In the context of Romanticism, the geography molded individuals, and over time customs and culture related to that geography arose, and these, being in harmony with the place of the society, were better than arbitrarily imposed laws.
question_en: According to the passage, what would most likely have been the result if Romanticism had not embraced cultural determinism from writers like Goethe, Fichte, and Schlegel?
mc_answer1_en: Customs and culture would have arisen independently of geographical influences and become superior to place-based harmony.
mc_answer2_en: Society would have developed arbitrary laws that conflicted with local customs and geography.
mc_answer3_en: Romanticism would have focused solely on individualism rather than collective cultural development.
mc_answer4_en: Geography would have ceased to influence individual development and cultural evolution.

flores_passage_en: Internal poisoning may not be immediately apparent. Symptoms, such as vomiting are sufficiently general that an immediate diagnosis cannot be made. The best indication of internal poisoning may be the presence of an open container of medication or toxic household chemicals. Check the label for specific first aid instructions for that specific poison.
question_en: If the open container of medication mentioned in the passage had not been present, what would likely be the most significant consequence regarding the diagnosis of internal poisoning?
mc_answer1_en: Diagnosis would likely remain uncertain due to general symptoms.
mc_answer2_en: Diagnosis could be made immediately without checking labels.
mc_answer3_en: The symptoms would disappear and no treatment would be needed.
mc_answer4_en: First aid instructions would be found on the medication label.

flores_passage_en: "Widespread looting reportedly continued overnight, as law enforcement officers were not present on Bishkek's streets. Bishkek was described as sinking into a state of ""anarchy"" by one observer, as gangs of people roamed the streets and plundered stores of consumer goods. Several Bishkek residents blamed protesters from the south for the lawlessness."
question_en: Based on the passage, what would most likely have occurred if law enforcement officers had been present on Bishkek's streets during the reported looting?
mc_answer1_en: Looting would have continued overnight regardless of law enforcement.
mc_answer2_en: Gangs of people would have likely been deterred from plundering stores of consumer goods.
mc_answer3_en: Residents from the south would have immediately been blamed for the lawlessness.
mc_answer4_en: The state of anarchy would have intensified despite police presence.

flores_passage_en: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle. On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.
question_en: If a traveler were to board a cross-border train without a valid ID, what would likely happen according to the passage?

mc_answer2_en: The conductor would collect their passport during the journey.
mc_answer3_en: They would be allowed to board but fined upon arrival.
mc_answer4_en: They would be denied boarding or face inspection issues upon departure.

flores_passage_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway. While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat. He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died. Zayat was unhurt in the accident.
question_en: If Peter Lenz had not fallen off his motorcycle during the warm-up lap, what would most likely have been the outcome for both riders?

mc_answer2_en: The medical staff would have intervened before the race even began.

mc_answer1: ପରିବେଶ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥା ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ସୂଚନା ଅଧ୍ୟୟନ କରିବାରେ ଆଗ୍ରହୀ ଲୋକମାନଙ୍କ ପାଇଁ ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ବନ୍ୟଜନ୍ତୁଙ୍କ ବିଷୟରେ ଜାଣିବାର ସୁଯୋଗ କମିଯିବ।
mc_answer2: ପରିଦର୍ଶକମାନେ ଆଉ ଓରାଙ୍ଗୁଟାନମାନଙ୍କର ଫଟୋ ଉଠାଇବାରେ ନିୟୋଜିତ ହେବେ ନାହିଁ।
mc_answer3: ପର୍ଯ୍ୟଟକମାନେ ଶିକାର ଏବଂ ମାଛ ଧରିବା କାର୍ଯ୍ୟକଳାପ ବନ୍ଦ କରିଦେବେ କିନ୍ତୁ ପକ୍ଷୀ ନିରୀକ୍ଷଣ ଜାରି ରଖିବେ।
mc_answer4: ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ସୌନ୍ଦର୍ଯ୍ୟ ଉପଭୋଗ କରିବା ପାଇଁ ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ଅଞ୍ଚଳ ପରିଦର୍ଶନ କରିବାର ମୁଖ୍ୟ ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ସମାପ୍ତ ହୋଇଯିବ।
